INTRO_KR: About us Our Heritage: A Foundation Built on Excellence Founded on the principle that exceptional fragrance deserves exceptional presentation, Abely Perfume Packaging has evolved into a cornerstone of the global luxury beauty supply chain. For years, we have dedicated ourselves exclusively to the art and science of high-end perfume packaging. Our journey began with a simple vision: to transcend the ordinary and become the premier partner for luxury brands seeking to create not just a packaging, but an integral part of the sensory experience. From our initial focus on precision craftsmanship, we have expanded our mastery to encompass every facet of perfume packaging, serving a prestigious clientele across Europe, the Middle East, and North America. Our longevity is a testament to our unwavering commitment to quality, innovation, and deep, collaborative partnerships. Our Craft: Where Vision Meets Precision We believe the bottle is the first tangible interaction a customer has with a fragrance; it is the silent ambassador of the brand's soul. Our process is a meticulous symphony of design, engineering, and artisan craftsmanship. Design & Conceptualization: Our in-house design team works shoulder-to-shoulder with your creative visionaries. We specialize in translating abstract brand stories into breathtaking, tangible forms. Whether you bring us a detailed blueprint or a nascent idea, we provide expert guidance on materials, ergonomics, trends, and market-specific aesthetics. Engineering & Prototyping: Beauty must be functional. Our engineering team ensures that every design is not only stunning but also manufacturable, leak-proof, and user-friendly. We employ state-of-the-art 3D modeling and rapid prototyping to bring concepts to life quickly, allowing for perfect refinement before production. Artisan Manufacturing: This is where magic happens. We control the entire manufacturing process, utilizing: Premium Glass: From delicate, hand-blown crystal-like clarity to bold, heavyweight molded glass with complex curves. Metallic Excellence: Precision-crafted caps, collars, and accessories in polished gold, palladium, antique brass, and more, using techniques like die-casting, spinning, and electroplating. Specialty Materials: Expertise in luxurious ceramics, advanced polymers, and exotic wood accents. Surface Finishing: The final touch of luxury. We excel in applied techniques such as silk-screen printing, hot stamping with foils, sophisticated lacquering, satin and matte textures, and intricate engraving. Our Global Reach: Intimate Understanding of Diverse Markets Our export focus on the discerning markets of Europe, the Middle East, and America has endowed us with unique cultural and commercial insights. We understand that luxury is perceived differently across the globe. For our clients in the Middle East , we appreciate the appetite for grandeur, opulence, and intricate detail. We create pieces that embody majesty through bold silhouettes, high-quality gilding, deep embossing, and designs that reflect heritage and prestige. For the European market, we emphasize timeless elegance, minimalist chic, and sustainable innovation, often focusing on classic forms with a modern twist. For the American market, we blend innovation with brand-driven storytelling, creating packaging that is both visually striking on a retail shelf and instantly iconic. This cultural fluency allows us to be true advisors, ensuring your packaging resonates powerfully with your target audience, wherever they are. Our Promise: A Partnership from Concept to Delivery Choosing Abely is choosing more than a supplier; it is choosing a partner. We integrate seamlessly into your supply chain, offering: End-to-End Service: From the initial spark of an idea to the final shipment arriving at your destination, we manage the entire process. Uncompromising Quality Control: Every single component is rigorously inspected against the highest standards to ensure flawless consistency across small or large production runs. Reliability & Transparency: We understand the critical path of product launches. You can count on our professional project management, clear communication, and on-time delivery. Innovation as Standard: We continuously invest in new technologies, materials, and finishing techniques to keep our clients at the forefront of packaging trends. Invitation to Collaborate As we prepare to meet the world at the Dubai Beauty Expo, we invite you to experience the Abely difference. Let's discuss how we can transform your next fragrance project into a timeless object of desire. Visit us at Booth P-G18 to see and feel the quality for yourself, and together, let's define the future of luxury fragrance packaging.

INTRO_KR: About us Aco Perfumes & Cosmetics LLP, the Indian arm of The Attarwala Group , is a privately held conglomerate with diversified operations across the manufacturing and distribution of perfumes and cosmetics . We are committed to world-class manufacturing, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and unmatched quality standards . Across India and the UAE, our group employs over 2,600 skilled professionals , each contributing to our mission of redefining modern perfumery. All our production facilities are ISO and GMP certified , adhering to the highest international benchmarks. Our portfolio proudly encompasses 20+ owned brands , including internationally renowned names such as Manasik , Al Fakhar Perfumes , BN Parfums , JD Collection , Maison De Milan , Fragrance Couture , and Aco . With exports to over 105 countries worldwide , we continue to expand our global footprint — driven by innovation, authenticity, and a deep passion for the art of fragrance.

INTRO_KR: About us AGI Greenpac Limited is a sustainable packaging solutions company that manufactures and markets various packaging products, including glass containers, PET bottles, injection moulding products, as well as anti-counterfeiting security caps and closures. Our design team collaborates closely with clients to create appealing packaging that tells your brand's story. Our decoration unit offers premium techniques like ceramic labels, printing, hot-foiling, masking, frosting, spray painting, lacquering, and more. Our diverse portfolio features customizable options to meet your unique brand needs. The company's team of experienced professionals leverages cutting-edge technology to deliver innovative packaging solutions that protect brands from counterfeiting and safeguard consumers. The products incorporate advanced security features such as safety ink, tamper-evident seals, and unique identifiers. This multi-layered approach ensures that products are authentic and traceable throughout the supply chain. The state-of-the-art manufacturing plant and focus on research and development enable AGI Clozures to stay ahead of emerging threats and provide its customers with the most advanced security solutions. The plant produces over 1 billion caps and closures annually, including both large and small sizes. AGI Plastek: is a leading supplier of high-quality PET packaging solutions, catering to a wide range of industries, including pharmaceuticals, alcoholic beverages, food and soft drinks, personal care, agrochemicals, and dairy. The company provides customized and innovative PET packaging bottles and products, particularly for the soft drinks, water, edible oils, and personal care sectors. With three strategically located plants in India and an annual capacity of 11,892 tonnes, AGI Plastek is well-equipped to meet the diverse needs of its customers.

Our founders' passion for combining the purest elements of nature with modern science laid the foundation for our company. Now, as the second generation, we proudly carry this legacy forward, blending the power of nature with innovative technology. AKTEN Cosmetics is committed not only to our customers and markets and also to making a positive impact on society and the environment. Every product is crafted in our own factory using unique formulations developed in-house, ensuring uncompromising quality. Our R&D laboratory continuously works to harness the natural power of botanical extracts in their most effective and purest forms. By extracting our own plant essences, we infuse our products with the raw power of nature. Each formulation reflects the perfect harmony between nature and science. Our R&D team is dedicated to innovation, providing our consumers with the most natural and effective solutions. Spreading Natural Beauty Across the World With our brands " THALIA ," " Beany ," and "Private Label," we are redefining the concept of natural beauty. Body Care: Refreshing and revitalizing body care products. Hair Care: Hair care solutions inspired by nature, such as Moringa & Ginger, Flaxseed, and Rosemary. Gift Sets: Share the gift of natural beauty with your loved ones. Perfumes: Elegant and lasting fragrances blended with natural essences. INTRO_KR: About us Founded in 1970, Al Wazir Group has grown into one of the Middle East’s largest and most reputable manufacturers of household detergents, soaps, disinfectants, and personal care products. From its beginnings in traditional soap manufacturing, Al Wazir has continuously expanded its portfolio to include a comprehensive range of products: toilet soaps, bath soaps, dishwashing liquids, laundry powders and liquids, surface cleaners, disinfectants, air fresheners, shampoos, shower gels, liquid hand soaps, body splash, and specialized cleaning products for kitchens, bathrooms, floors, and tiles. Our production facilities in Jordan, Turkey, Iraq, Syria, and Saudi Arabia are equipped with the latest high-tech machinery and laboratories, ensuring compliance with international standards (ISO 9001, GMP) and delivering consistent quality at competitive prices. We also specialize in Private Label solutions, offering flexible packaging, high-volume capacity, and tailored services for international retailers. With decades of expertise, state-of-the-art technology, and a dedicated team of chemists, engineers, and professionals, Al Wazir Group continues to innovate and develop products that meet global market needs. We don’t just manufacture detergents—we build profitable partnerships and deliver excellence.

INTRO_KR: About us American Dream Seeking to Expand Global Footprint at Beauty World 2025 London, UK – September 2025 – American Dream, a family-owned UK-based company with over 40 years of expertise in skincare, is proud to announce its participation at Beauty World 2025. Launched in East Africa just a few years ago, American Dream’s  Cocoa Butter creams have quickly risen to become some of the best-selling skin creams in the region, thanks to a network of dedicated distributors. The brand has since grown rapidly, evolving its skincare portfolio to include 11 unique fragrances and formulas of cocoa butter creams, luxurious body oils, advanced Miracle Serums, cocoa butter lotions, and an award-winning range of haircare products. Seeking Global Expansion With a strong foundation in East Africa, American Dream is setting its sights on new international markets. At Beauty World 2025, the company is actively seeking new distributors to expand its network further into West Africa, the USA, Canada, South America, and beyond. The company offers a generous profit-on-return percentage (POR%) to its partners, along with dedicated account managers who provide personalised support. Distributors are also equipped with an array of marketing tools, including product samples, posters, branded clothing, stationery, and more, ensuring their success in promoting the American Dream range. Don’t miss the opportunity to partner with a brand that’s synonymous with quality and innovation. Let’s work together to bring the American Dream to new customers worldwide.

INTRO_KR: About us The Love Co. – India’s First Fragrance-Led Body Care House Made in India. Loved Around the World. The Love Co. is a luxury self-care and fragrance brand redefining beauty through emotion and science. As India’s first Fragrance Hybrid House, we craft body care that blends fine perfumery with advanced skincare — transforming everyday routines into sensory rituals of love. Each creation is thoughtfully designed to hydrate, scent, and elevate mood, combining IFRA-certified fragrance oils, clean actives, and luxurious textures. Rooted in India and inspired by global artistry, The Love Co. celebrates the modern ritual of self-love — where fragrance becomes therapy, and care feels like luxury. The Love Co. is a modern fragrance and body care house born from a simple truth — love is the most powerful emotion we experience, and fragrance is how we remember it. Established in 2019 in India, The Love Co. was founded with a singular vision: to create world-class, fragrance-led body care that turns daily routines into sensory rituals of self-love. From its beginnings as a humble shower gel brand inspired by global perfumery traditions, The Love Co. has grown into one of India’s fastest-emerging names in beauty and wellness, offering a portfolio of over 150 products across bath, body, wellness, and home fragrance. At the heart of The Love Co. lies a belief that beauty should never be superficial — it should be sensorial, emotional, and deeply personal. Every product is designed not just to nourish the skin, but to awaken the senses and evoke memories, desires, and moments of joy. Philosophy: Feel the Love Love, in all its forms, is what makes us human. It inspires art, music, fragrance — and the quiet rituals that help us reconnect with ourselves. The Love Co. celebrates this universal truth through fragrance. Each collection is crafted to express a mood, a feeling, or a story — from the serenity of lavender fields to the allure of oud and amber. Our products are a reflection of India’s growing love affair with global perfumery, designed for those who see skincare as more than a routine — it’s a love language. We believe fragrance is not an accessory. It’s identity, emotion, and self-expression. Innovation & Craftsmanship Every Love Co. product is researched, developed, and manufactured in-house under strict quality standards and dermatological testing. Our laboratories focus on: Fragrance science: Partnering with top perfumers from Grasse and Dubai to design long-lasting, mood-enhancing scents. Active body care: Blending globally sourced actives — like niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin C — with indulgent textures for visible skin transformation. Multi-layered formulations: Shower gels, lotions, and body mists are engineered to complement each other — building fragrance that lasts all day. Constant innovation: Monthly launches inspired by world perfumery trends, from Japanese Cherry Blossom to Oud de Luxe. Each creation reflects a balance of art and science — intuitive, emotional, yet clinically validated. Sustainability & Conscious Luxury For The Love Co., luxury and responsibility coexist. Our promise extends beyond glowing skin — it’s about care for our planet, our animals, and our people. 100% cruelty-free and vegan-friendly formulas. Recyclable PET and glass packaging, moving toward post-consumer recycled materials. Local sourcing and low-waste production processes that reduce carbon footprint. Ethical partnerships and community initiatives, including animal shelter support in our hometown. Every Love Co. bottle is a reflection of conscious beauty — made with love, not compromise. Global Expansion From our home in India to shelves and hearts across the world, The Love Co. is fast becoming a name synonymous with sensorial self-care. With exports across the Middle East, Europe, and Asia, The Love Co. has emerged as a key representative of India’s modern beauty renaissance — blending fragrance artistry, scientific formulation, and cultural emotion. Our participation in leading global exhibitions such as Beautyworld Middle East (Dubai) and Gift Expo India underlines our international ambition and commitment to placing Indian craftsmanship on the global beauty map. Hero Collections Every Love Co. collection is a journey through scent, memory, and emotion. Fall in Love Collection → Romantic, floral, and timeless — inspired by first love and soft nostalgia. Oud of Love Collection → Bold, luxurious, and sensual — echoing Middle Eastern perfumery with a modern Indian soul. Aromatherapy Collection → Wellness-led blends of lavender, eucalyptus, and citrus designed for relaxation and balance. Body Philosophy Collection → Limited-edition fragrances capturing the essence of iconic global perfumes. Travel Edition → City-inspired shower gels that let you “travel through scent.” Each range is designed to layer beautifully — from body wash to body mist — so your fragrance feels alive, personal, and unforgettable. Awards & Recognition The Love Co. has quickly become one of India’s most admired homegrown beauty brands, recognized for its commitment to innovation and emotional storytelling. Featured at Beautyworld Middle East 2025 for product innovation and scent technology. Recognized in industry forums for pioneering fragrance-led skincare in India. Celebrated by consumers across 12 countries for long-lasting, affordable luxury. Our Vision The Love Co. isn’t just a beauty brand — it’s a movement to make people fall in love with themselves again. We are redefining what it means to care for your body — transforming a daily act into a moment of indulgence, reflection, and joy. As we continue to grow, our vision remains rooted in emotion, innovation, and India’s timeless love for beauty. Every bottle we create carries a story. Every fragrance, a memory. Every ritual, an act of love. The Love Co. — Feel the Love.

Brand Launch and Global Reach: - APLB was launched in 2018, and in 2023, the global product line featuring Glutathione Niacinamide was introduced. - The brand has been growing by 10-30% per month on average, exporting to over 60 countries including the USA, Europe, Russia, Southeast Asia, and Japan. 2. Patented Ingredient for Deep Hydration: - The patented ingredient (Patent No. 10-1332214) forms a moisture barrier to protect the skin and provide deep nourishment. 7. Centella 3x Complex™ for Soothing Sensitive Skin: - The inclusion of Centella 3x Complex™ helps soothe and hydrate skin that has been sensitized by external environmental factors, making it safe for sensitive skin. 8. Immediate and Long-Lasting Hydration: - APLB products provide an immediate refreshing hydration boost, keeping the skin moist for an extended period. - They brighten dull skin, promote a healthy glow, and safely manage sensitive skin concerns while firming and purifying the skin, and tightening enlarged pores. 9. Award-Winning Brand: - APLB has been recognized in Korea, winning the Popular Korean Brand Award in the cosmetics category for three consecutive years. 10. Regulatory Approval: - APLB products have obtained certification required in the USA (FDA Mocra), Europe (CPNP) and the UK(SCPN). We work together with our partner to obtain any necessary additional certification specific to certain market.

INTRO_KR: About us Argan De Vie was born in 2020 from the travel experiences of Silvia Sacco, the company’s founder, in Morocco. She has always been passionate about natural products with beneficial properties for the skin. Intrigued by the extraordinary effectiveness of argan oil, Silvia transformed her discovery of this precious elixir and other unique ingredients into a brand that embodies our vision of beauty, enriched by the excellence of Made in Italy. We purchase argan oil directly from a women’s cooperative near Essaouira. This choice allows us not only to ensure the utmost purity and sustainability of the raw material, but also to concretely support local communities, encouraging fair trade practices and promoting the values of female entrepreneurship in an inclusive and responsible corporate culture. In our partner laboratories, we constantly conduct research to identify the most effective combinations of argan oil with highly innovative ingredients and molecules, to create unique formulas that guarantee exceptional benefits for the skin. One of the main features of Argan de Vie is its ability to combine tradition with innovation. We choose environmentally friendly methods of extracting the raw material to preserve the properties of argan oil, and we rely on ongoing research, studies, and formula updates to ensure consistently high levels of quality. Our argan oil extraction method, in keeping with Moroccan tradition, allows us to preserve the characteristics of the material. At the same time, the innovation of Made in Italy allows us to develop cutting-edge products in line with the latest market trends. We are aware of the importance of protecting our planet. For this reason, we are committed to following a green philosophy as much as possible, choosing recyclable glass bottles and formulas with natural and sustainable ingredients.

INTRO_KR: About us Philosophy At Attar De Astana — also known as Attarastana or simply Astana — every fragrance is born from authenticity, craftsmanship, and quality . For us, perfume is not just a symbol of beauty, but a tale told through scent . Each creation carries with it the whispers of ancient traditions, the essence of culture, and the timeless connection between memory and fragrance. Founding & Heritage Our journey began with a simple yet powerful mission: to revive the ancient art of Attar-making and celebrate the regions whose perfumeries were admired for centuries across the Middle East and South Asia . These oils and natural perfumes were more than luxuries — they were heritage, identity, and ritual. Attar De Astana was born from this devotion to tradition, crafting perfumes that bridge the past with the present. Our Story In 1973 , in the lush landscapes of North-East India , Mr. Abdul Latif Agarwala planted the seeds of Attar De Astana. With little more than a small distillery, a few skilled artisans, and an unshakable dream, he began crafting attars from treasures of nature — agarwood, jasmine, and the rare Kopou Phool (Assamese orchid) . Inspired by the cultural richness of India and the soulful traditions of the Middle East, he shaped a brand rooted in simplicity, purity, and authenticity . By 1993 , the dream crossed borders. Attar De Astana opened its first showroom in the United Arab Emirates , carrying with it the soul of its Indian heritage and the warmth of Arabian traditions. Soon, the name “Astana” became recognized across the Middle East, Africa, and CIS countries — a symbol of heritage reborn through fragrance. A Legacy of Growth When Mr. Mohammad Qamar , son of the founder, took the helm, he carried forward not just a business, but his father’s vision and passion . With every step, the legacy deepened: In 2003 , he built a modern perfume manufacturing facility in Ajman , a place where tradition met innovation. By 2013 , the factory expanded — blending French perfumery expertise with Eastern artistry, creating scents that spoke a universal language. And in 2023 , the journey reached new horizons with a state-of-the-art facility in Ras Al Khaimah , spanning 250,000 sq. ft. , equipped with the most advanced machinery — yet still guided by the same timeless values. Today & Beyond Fifty years on, Attar De Astana is more than a perfume house — it is a living legacy . Every bottle carries within it the dedication of artisans, the wisdom of tradition, and the spirit of innovation. We remain true to our roots, yet fearless in embracing the future — ensuring that each fragrance we create does not just delight the senses, but tells a story worth remembering . ASTANA - "Not Just a Scent — A Vibe That Stays.” For an Unforgettable Presence: Our Oud Blends, Meticulously Crafted to Evolve Gracefully from Day to Night.

INTRO_KR: About us Atelier Fragranze Milano is a Fragrance House founnded in 2011, created from the hunch of Marco Maffei, reference figure of the European Essence Industry and the rising star of Italian Perfumery, Luca Maffei. The father/son combination is born with a clear vision: creating a company strongly rooted to the tradition of Made in Italy, with a particular attention to the Milan influence, able to mix creativity, style, love for beauty and care of details. Starting from 2020 the new head quarter in via Lucilio Gaio allows AFM to become a producer company and to follow the projects from the fragrance creation to the production. We aim at creating an olfactive story through Emotions. Atelier Fragranze Milano is born in an inspiring environment that upholds artisanal values of unparalleled craftsmanship, the use of superior materials, and a meticulous attention to details. We are proud to exemplify this Italian standard of excellence in the perfume industry. Perfume as art — not science. Creative dialogue — not analytics, between the brand designer and our perfumers — only those who work to enable and empower creativity. We know Bigger is not always better. We prioritize supporting the creative flow between designer and perfumer. The result? Perfumes that are daring, authentic, and truly express brand identity.

INTRO_KR: About us ATLANTIC COSMETIC ATLANTIC COSMETIC is an innovative brand founded in 2020, born at the pinnacle of 27 years of experience in the cosmetics and perfume industry. Shaped by its founders' deep expertise and passion, ATLANTIC COSMETIC has established a distinctive position in the beauty and care world with a modern vision. Embracing quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction as its core principles, ATLANTIC COSMETIC envisions becoming a leading brand in the global cosmetics market by offering cutting-edge products. Our Vision and Mission The vision of ATLANTIC COSMETIC is to be recognized as a trend-setting force in the beauty and care industry and to become a leading brand globally by delivering innovative products. Our mission is to support our customers in expressing themselves by developing products that exceed their expectations. Providing the highest quality and most reliable products is one of ATLANTIC COSMETIC's fundamental goals. Our Product Range At ATLANTIC COSMETIC, our products are manufactured to the highest standards, meticulously designed, and tested to meet the needs of our users. Our portfolio includes exclusive brands such as Memûzîn, which combines luxury and elegance. Memûzîn, inspired by the 15th-century Kurdish epic love story "Mem û Zîn," holds a unique place in the world of perfumery. Quality and Innovation For ATLANTIC COSMETIC, quality is an indispensable value. Each of our products is produced according to international quality standards and is supported by the latest technology. Innovation is the cornerstone of our dynamic brand. We constantly develop new formulas, closely follow industry innovations, and aim to offer the best to our customers. Memûzîn, a product of this philosophy, is meticulously crafted using the finest and most natural ingredients. Environmental and Social Responsibility At ATLANTIC COSMETIC, we place great importance on being an environmentally and socially responsible brand. We use eco-friendly materials in our product development processes and prefer sustainable production methods. We are committed to ensuring that no animal testing is conducted, and we rigorously apply this principle across all our processes. Memûzîn is also produced with this environmental awareness, presented through a production process that respects nature. Customer Satisfaction and Communication Customer satisfaction is a priority for ATLANTIC COSMETIC. We highly value our customers' feedback to best understand their needs and expectations. The open and honest communication we establish with our customers is one of the key factors that enhance our brand's reliability and loyalty. Memûzîn reflects this customer-centric approach, catering to those who wish to experience elegance and quality at the highest level.

INTRO_KR: About us At Diamond Henna , we’ve been redefining natural beauty since 1975. Founded in Faridabad, India, our journey began with a vision—to bring the purity of nature to the world through the finest henna-based products. Over the past five decades, we’ve evolved into a global market leader in herbal haircare and skincare, celebrated for our uncompromising quality, authenticity, and innovation. What began as a family legacy has transformed into a symbol of excellence—trusted by millions of customers across continents. Our world-class manufacturing facility blends the wisdom of tradition with the precision of modern technology. Every product—from the iconic Black Diamond Kali Mehandi and Khadi Herbal Mehandi to innovative formulations like Glam Aloe Vera Gel and Glam Hair Removal Cream —is crafted using 100% natural ingredients and refined through advanced, automated processes. Our laboratories ensure each batch meets international safety, purity, and performance standards , while our export-grade packaging reflects the elegance and quality that global consumers expect. As a fast-growing export powerhouse , Diamond Henna is expanding its presence across the Middle East, Africa, Europe, and Asia. We proudly offer OEM and Private Label manufacturing services , partnering with leading global brands to craft customized beauty products that embody excellence. With eco-friendly practices, cruelty-free formulations, and a relentless drive for innovation, Diamond Henna stands at the intersection of heritage and modernity— bringing India’s natural beauty legacy to the world with trust, technology, and timeless care.

INTRO_KR: About us Since 1962, Baralan Group is a consolidated player in primary packaging for the cosmetics industry. The company creates, designs, engineers, manufactures, and customizes glass and plastic containers with related accessories for the beauty industry. The Group’s motto, Cosmetic Packaging Solutions, emphasizes the company’s support of its worldwide customer base with a global organization and a strong integration of the value chain. Baralan is committed to providing high quality products, largely available in stock and in various locations worldwide, to satisfy the ever-increasing needs for immediate and personalized packaging.  Baralan has its commercial headquarters in Italy along with four manufacturing facilities, including U.S. branches in New York, California, Florida, a decoration facility in New Jersey, and a Chinese branch in Shanghai. For 60 years, Baralan has been synonymous with quality and 360° customer service from the initial concept phase to research and development and in production, to quality control and logistics. Baralan thus positions itself in the market as a historical Italian company with a dynamic vision, and an international presence with widespread distribution of its products in more than 50 countries. The Group brings Made in Italy to the world, understood as a symbol of beauty, design and impeccable taste, combined with a high level of quality and service.

INTRO_KR: About us Coolifting is the most spectacular and fast face lifting treatment to defy the passing time. A revolutionary facial treatment that delivers a powerful blast of CO₂ combined with a high concentration of active ingredients at a very high pressure and low temperature. In just minutes, it visibly hydrates, plumps, and rejuvenates the skin—leaving you with a radiant, youthful glow without any downtime. Simple, effective, non-invasive and fast treatment: 5 minutes open a new future for rejuvenation. Symbiosis between a large concentration of anti-aging actives and an efficient activation of the epidermis allows it to penetrate as it was never attained before. The Coolifting treatment consists of different types of vials that are applied with the Coolifting gun in each treatment for different needs: COOLIFTING: Mature skin that needs an anti-aging effect and illumination with hyaluronic acid and firming elements. It nourishes the skin, smoothing wrinkles from the first session. COOLSHINE: Provides radiance and nourishment to young skin that wants a glow. Vitamin cocktail of natural origin. Hyaluronic acid, bio-illuminating peptides, kombucha, honey extract, or aloe vera, also tensing elements. COOLCLEAR: Especially indicated for skins with pigmentation differences. This vial has a clarifying effect and tone unification. With anti-aging base + kojic acid, Vitamin C, and glycolic acid, including or antiaging base. COOLTAN: To achieve a tanned and radiant face, without makeup, even in winter. Self-tanning effect with a matte finish. Bronzing effect, coloring effect due to being a sugary compound that reacts with the amino acids in the outermost layer of the skin, adding our tensing elements. Coolifting ist die spektakulärste und schnellste Lifting-Behandlung für das Gesicht, um dem Zahn der Zeit zu trotzen. Eine revolutionäre Gesichtsbehandlung, bei der ein kraftvoller CO₂-Strahl mit einer hohen Konzentration aktiver Wirkstoffe bei sehr hohem Druck und niedriger Temperatur appliziert wird. In nur wenigen Minuten wird die Haut sichtbar mit Feuchtigkeit versorgt, aufgepolstert und verjüngt – für einen strahlenden, jugendlichen Teint ganz ohne Ausfallzeit. Einfach, effektiv, nicht-invasiv und schnell: 5 Minuten eröffnen eine neue Zukunft der Hautverjüngung. Die Symbiose aus einer hohen Konzentration an Anti-Aging-Wirkstoffen und einer effizienten Aktivierung der Epidermis ermöglicht ein Eindringen, wie es bisher nicht möglich war. Die Coolifting-Behandlung besteht aus verschiedenen Arten von Wirkstoffampullen, die mit der Coolifting-Pistole je nach Hautbedürfnis angewendet werden: COOLIFTING: Für reife Haut mit Bedarf an Anti-Aging-Effekt und Ausstrahlung – mit Hyaluronsäure und straffenden Elementen. Pflegt die Haut und glättet Falten bereits nach der ersten Sitzung. COOLSHINE: Verleiht junger Haut Strahlkraft und Nährstoffe – ein Vitamincocktail natürlichen Ursprungs. Hyaluronsäure, bio-illuminierende Peptide, Kombucha, Honigextrakt oder Aloe Vera, ebenfalls mit straffenden Wirkstoffen. COOLCLEAR: Besonders geeignet für Haut mit Pigmentunterschieden. Diese Ampulle hat einen aufhellenden Effekt und sorgt für einen ebenmäßigen Teint – mit Anti-Aging-Basis + Kojisäure, Vitamin C und Glykolsäure. COOLTAN: Für einen gebräunten, strahlenden Teint – ganz ohne Make-up, selbst im Winter. Selbstbräunungseffekt mit mattem Finish. Bräunungs- und Tönungseffekt durch eine zuckerbasierte Verbindung, die mit den Aminosäuren der obersten Hautschicht reagiert, ergänzt durch unsere straffenden Inhaltsstoffe.

INTRO_KR: About us Company Introduction – BE&BI Tech Co., Ltd. BE&BI Tech Co., Ltd. is a specialized manufacturer of High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) devices, with a primary focus on the development of medical-grade HIFU equipment for clinical use. Our flagship product, UCOS HIFU , is a high-performance HIFU system designed for hospitals and medical institutions, based on advanced High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound technology. The UCOS HIFU device is primarily used for anti-aging treatments , including wrinkle reduction, skin lifting, and tightening , delivering noticeable improvements in skin elasticity and firmness without invasive procedures. These features make it highly suitable for both dermatological and aesthetic medical practices. What sets BE&BI Tech Co., Ltd. apart is that our CEO is also an engineer who personally developed and launched the UCOS HIFU device. With deep technical expertise and hands-on leadership, the CEO has guided the continuous enhancement of the product over the past eight years, incorporating real-time feedback from customers and medical professionals. This reflects our unwavering commitment to responsibility, innovation, and growing together with our clients. We strives to provide the best customer support and to build long-term partnerships with all stakeholders. We have obtained various certifications and reports that validate both the safety and performance of our products, including: KFDA (Korean Food and Drug Administration) KGMP (Korean Good Manufacturing Practice) ISO 13485 CE Report EMC Report Clinical Reports In addition, we hold 9 technology patents related to our HIFU systems, demonstrating our innovative strength in this field. Our products are currently exported to 13 countries worldwide , and our global presence continues to expand. At BE&BI Tech Co., Ltd., we are committed to advancing HIFU technology and delivering high-quality medical devices that healthcare providers can trust.

INTRO_KR: About us Bee Factor Natural Cosmetics is a dynamic, vertically integrated skincare brand from Greece, harnessing the purity of nature and the precision of science to deliver visible, proven results. Established in 2016 in Trikala, Greece, the company was born from an authentic story and has since evolved into a fast-growing global presence with over 100 innovative products. At the heart of Bee Factor lies a simple yet powerful philosophy: self-care is empowerment . We believe that skincare should be clean, effective, and a celebration of nature’s intelligence. Our formulas combine high-performing botanical actives, bee-derived ingredients, and cutting-edge biotechnology , always at the highest legally permitted concentrations, to ensure visible, trusted, clinically proven resultsInnovation & R&D Excellence. All Bee Factor products are researched, developed, and manufactured in-house under strict EU GMP standards. Every step — from ingredient sourcing and R&D to formulation, packaging, and global distribution — is handled with precision and integrity. Our laboratories focus on: Actives at maximum efficacy levels for real, visible results. Monthly new launches , ensuring constant innovation and trend leadership. Clinically supported formulas , designed to meet the evolving needs of modern consumers. Next-generation technologies , such as marine biotechnology, retinol alternatives, plant-derived collagens, and exosome-based skincare. Sustainability & Responsibility For Bee Factor, sustainability is not a trend but a foundational principle . We are committed to protecting both skin health and the planet: FSC-certified recyclable paper packaging. Reduction of plastic use and investment in eco-conscious materials. Clean, cruelty-free, and biodegradable ingredients. Low-waste production and fully traceable supply chain. Respect for biodiversity, bees, and natural ecosystems. Global Expansion From a local Greek story, Bee Factor has become a fast-growing international brand . Today, our products are present in 12 countries , with exports across Europe, North & South America and Canada . Exclusive distribution partnerships and niche collaborations support our global expansion strategy , which also includes tailored private label offerings for select partners. Our participation in leading trade shows such as COSMOPROF Bologna and North America - Las Vegas and now Beautyworld Middle East underlines our readiness to expand into new regions with confidence, agility, and scalability. Awards & Recognition Our vision and excellence have been repeatedly recognized: Gold & Bronze Awards at the Aesthetic Awards 2025 . Finalist at the Pure Beauty Global Awards . Nominations at the Cosmoprof Awards 2025 . Prix de Beauté 2025 recognitions for innovation and clean beauty. Bee Factor has also been celebrated in international media, with features in British Vogue (June, July, August issues 2025) and Vanity Fair UK (September 2025) , reinforcing its status as a global rising star. In our home country, Bee Factor proudly stands among the Top 3 cosmetics companies in Greece , reflecting both our national strength and our international ambition Hero Products Our portfolio includes over 100 products, but some have become true global heroes: DD Cream SPF50 → Multi-award-winning 5-in-1 daily essential combining hydration, SPF50 protection, anti-aging technology, smart color adaptation, and blue light defense. Anti-Gravity Face Serum → A high-performance firming serum powered by marine biotechnology and antioxidants to lift, sculpt, and restore density. Silky Collagen Serum → Lightweight hydration and elasticity booster with plant collagen, hyaluronic acid, and silk extract for radiant, supple skin. Skin Rebirth Eye Cream → Advanced eye care with CycloRetin™, a next-generation retinol alternative, clinically proven to outperform Vitamin A and bakuchiol. Ageless You™ Face & Neck Cream → A luxurious anti-aging cream with stem cells from Japanese orchid and diamond peptides for visible firmness and wrinkle reduction. Each formula embodies our DNA: heritage-inspired, science-refined, results-driven . Our Vision Bee Factor is more than a skincare company — it is a movement in modern beauty . With innovation as our compass and authenticity as our foundation, we continue to expand globally while staying true to our Greek roots. Every Bee Factor product is proudly Made in Greece , blending centuries-old remedies with cutting-edge science to deliver skincare that is luxurious, effective, and sustainable. Bee Factor Natural Cosmetics – Made in Greece. Celebrated worldwide.

INTRO_KR: About us Founded in 1978 in Ciriè (Turin, Italy), Beinat S.r.l. has been at the forefront of safety and environmental monitoring technology for more than four decades. As a family-owned Italian company with strong roots in innovation, we design and manufacture a wide range of gas detection, air quality monitoring, fire prevention, and safety control systems that protect lives and improve wellbeing in residential, commercial, industrial, and healthcare environments. Our mission is simple yet vital: to make every environment safer, healthier, and more sustainable through precise, reliable, and intelligent detection solutions. Innovation Made in Italy All Beinat products are conceived, engineered, and manufactured in Italy , ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance with European and international regulations. Our in-house R&D team continuously develops new solutions that combine cutting-edge sensor technology with ease of use, compact design, and long-term reliability. With more than 40 years of experience, Beinat has become a trusted partner for safety professionals, engineers, and facility managers worldwide. Our solutions are installed in thousands of homes, offices, industrial facilities, hotels, and public buildings across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. Our Expertise and Product Lines Beinat’s portfolio covers a wide spectrum of safety and environmental monitoring needs : Gas Detection Systems : Centralized panels, detectors, and probes for civil, commercial, and industrial applications. Designed to identify explosive, toxic, and flammable gases (methane, LPG, CO, CO₂, VOCs, refrigerant gases etc..). Air Quality Monitoring : Compact devices that track pollutants and harmful substances, ensuring healthier environments for both workers and visitors. Portable Detectors: User-friendly handheld devices such as amiCO , our compact CO detector for both medical and civil use. Smart Technology : Innovative systems like PURA Doprâ with real-time air quality monitoring, detects CO2, humidity and room temperature Fire Prevention and Safety Controls : Advanced instruments for early detection and system integration with alarms and ventilation. Instrumentation & Measurement: High-precision devices for temperature, pressure, and environmental control. Why Beinat at Beautyworld Middle East Although Beinat is best known in industrial and safety markets, our technology also plays a vital role in the beauty, wellness, and hospitality industries . In spas, salons, aesthetic clinics, and luxury hotels, customers and professionals are exposed daily to vapors, fragrances, solvents, and chemicals. These substances can compromise wellbeing and the overall customer experience if not properly monitored. By introducing our air-quality and gas detection solutions into these environments, Beinat helps operators to: Ensure clean, safe, and pleasant indoor air for clients and staff. Eliminate risks from harmful vapors and gases (CO, VOCs, solvents). Enhance the quality perception of beauty and wellness services. Demonstrate commitment to safety, health, and premium customer care. At Beautyworld Middle East 2025, we showcase how safety technology can become an invisible yet essential element of the beauty experience. Featured Solutions at the Show PURA Doprâ –A smart purifier with advanced sensors that constantly monitor air quality, detecting CO2, humidity and room temperature. Ideal for spas, wellness centers, salons, hotels, and medical beauty clinics. amiCO – A compact and precise portable CO detector that guarantees protection in environments where combustion or chemicals are present. Integrated Systems – Central units, detectors, and probes adapted for civil and commercial spaces, ensuring safe operations and clean environments. Global Reach and Commitment Beinat operates internationally through a network of distributors and partners across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and Latin America . Our participation at Beautyworld Middle East demonstrates our commitment to bringing Italian excellence in safety technology to the heart of the global beauty and wellness industry. We are committed to: Reliability : Products designed for continuous protection and tested to the highest standards. Sustainability: Technology that improves indoor environments while reducing energy waste. Innovation : Constant research to meet the evolving needs of modern lifestyles and industries. Customer Support : A dedicated team providing technical training, after-sales service, and customized solutions. Our Vision At Beinat, we believe that wellness equals safety plus clean air . Beauty is not only what you see, but also what you breathe. By combining decades of expertise in safety with modern environmental awareness, we bring unique value to the beauty industry: technology that protects, reassures, and enhances customer experiences . Our vision for the future is to continue integrating safety and environmental monitoring into everyday life—making homes, workplaces, and wellness spaces healthier, safer, and more enjoyable. Beinat S.r.l. – Innovation, Safety & Air Quality Solutions since 1978. Visit us at Beautyworld Middle East 2025 to discover how our technology can transform your beauty and wellness environment into a truly safe and sustainable space.

INTRO_KR: About us Bellboy Studio is an infant and children’s safe cosmetics brand founded by a mom who’s a children’s book author and a dad who’s a cosmetics expert, built on the philosophy of being “the first skincare for a child.” Combining nature-inspired storytelling and character-driven emotional content with rigorously verified ingredients and technological expertise, we deliver both “safety” and “delight.” Bellboy Studio goes beyond simply making skincare — we care about a child’s emotional development and daily habit formation as well. The direction we pursue is not just “functional efficacy” but an “emotional experience.” We want to convey the warmth parents wish to share with their children and to accompany them in their very first moments of learning about the world. Emotive Illustrations and Storybooks Each product is linked to a storybook, and when you purchase a product, it expands into related content such as picture books or sticker books. Through this, our products serve not just as cosmetics, but as “tools for play and learning,” contributing to emotional development and the formation of daily habits. The Story of Lili and Her Bellboy Friends Bellboy Studio’s product lineup is organized according to each character’s personality and role, boasting a design that reflects both functional features and emotional elements. The products are designed not only to address children’s skin concerns but also to take into account usage habits, bringing together fun and care in everyday life. The protagonist, Lili, meets her Bellboy friends in the birch forest and learns about various habits of the world. When it’s time to wash the face, she goes with Rob; when moisture is needed, she seeks Cooper; when the sun is strong, Lumi helps her out. In this way, the products and stories are organically connected in a single universe, designed so that children using the products can emotionally empathize with each character. Major Product Lines Rob (Cleansing line): · Gentle Rob All-in-One Wash — Hair, face and body in one, low-irritant, mildly acidic formula Cooper (Moisturizing line): · Daily Lotion & Cream — fast absorption, keeps you moisturized without stickiness Zen (Derma care): · Derma Lotion & Cream — soothing line for sensitive skin, contains centella and panthenol · Calming Gel — gel type to reduce heat and calm breakouts · Powdery Cream — prevents diaper rash, gives a fresh finish Kyle (Body care): · Milk Body Lotion — moisture from milk protein–derived ingredients for supple body care · Soothing Gel — cooling gel formula, popular in summer Shiloh (Hair care): · Shampoo — naturally derived cleansing ingredients, mildly acidic formulation · Conditioner — non-sticky, soft finishing feel Lumi (Sun care): · Mild Sun Lotion — low-irritant, contains centella, applies smoothly like water Hipong (Hand & Hip care): · Hand Wash — low-irritant antibacterial ingredients / design encourages children to learn hand-washing by themselvesn · Hip Cleanser — A diaper-area wash designed exclusively for infants — a gentle cleanser for the Y-zone / post-toilet cleansing. It’s also popular in a portable size for travel.

INTRO_KR: About us Blust On – Where Professional Hair Innovation Begins Blust On is more than a professional haircare brand — it’s a global movement redefining what hair color and treatment mean for the new generation of stylists. Born from over 20 years of expertise in professional hair coloring and salon innovation, Blust On was created to solve the challenges that colorists, salon owners, and distributors face every day. Every product, formula, and decision comes from a simple philosophy: innovation must serve performance, simplicity, and trust. From the very beginning, the vision was clear — to bridge the gap between artistry and science, creating a professional range that delivers outstanding results with minimal effort and maximum creativity. Developed in Italy by top laboratories with decades of experience, Blust On merges technical precision with emotional connection. It’s a brand built by professionals, for professionals — and now, it’s taking over the world. A Brand Built on Expertise and Passion Behind Blust On stands a team of international experts: formulators, chemists, educators, and celebrity hairstylists who shared a single mission — to rethink how hair color and treatment should perform. At the heart of the brand lies Enrique Guzman , Miami’s renowned celebrity color master, whose years of salon experience inspired the creation of faster, safer, and more efficient color systems. His expertise, combined with the entrepreneurial drive of Samuel Zekri , turned Blust On into a brand that challenges the norms of the professional industry. Together, they didn’t just build a product line — they built a promise. A promise of purity, performance, and progress . Every formula was tested, perfected, and adjusted repeatedly until it met the highest professional standards. Each product has a story — of research, trial, and refinement — until it earned its place in the Blust On lineup. Made in Italy. Perfected for the World. Every Blust On product is crafted in Italy, where technology and tradition meet. Partnering with a factory that has served top global brands for decades, the brand ensures that every ingredient is traceable, every batch is tested, and every result is consistent. From raw materials to final packaging, Blust On’s commitment to quality defines every step of production. The formulas are vegan, cruelty-free, and enriched with active natural ingredients carefully chosen to preserve the integrity of the hair while delivering exceptional performance. The Italian production not only ensures top-tier formulation standards but also guarantees the brand’s long-term scalability and reliability — a key factor for distributors and partners worldwide. The Professional Range Blust On’s professional portfolio is designed as a complete system — each product works synergistically to empower hairdressers to create, transform, and repair with confidence. 1. Fast Action Color – The revolution in hair coloring. Permanent color that works in just 10 minutes with full coverage. Perfect for root touch-ups, beards, and fast salon services. A true time-saver that maintains the same durability and vibrancy as standard permanent colors. 2. Long Lasting Color – The reliable classic reinvented. Formulated with active ingredients that treat the hair while coloring, it offers long-lasting brilliance, smooth texture, and deep conditioning results. Its 1:2 mixing ratio delivers more product per tube, increasing profitability for salons. 3. Proactive Color (Demi-Permanent) – The professional’s favorite tool. No ammonia. Enriched with jojoba and avocado oils. Perfect for toning, refreshing, color correction, or shine enhancement. It’s not just color — it’s care in motion. 4. Bleaching Line (Pink, Blue, and Green Vegan) A complete range for every bleaching need: Pink Bleaching Powder – Ammonia-free, pleasant scent, and gentle on the scalp. Blue Bleaching Powder – Anti-yellow formula, lifts up to 9 tones with precision. Green Vegan Bleaching Powder – Eco-friendly, dust-free, infused with argan and macadamia oils, with X-Bond hair protection technology. 5. Treatments – Science for healthy, luminous hair. From the Hair Reborn pre-treatment spray that protects hair before chemical services, to the PH2 Mask , which restores pH balance and closes the cuticle, and the Ultimate Repair and Blonde Masks , which bring life and strength back to damaged or bleached hair — Blust On treatments are where science meets luxury care. Where Education Meets Innovation – The Blust On Academy In the heart of Dubai, on Al Wasl Road , stands the Blust On Academy — a space dedicated to education, artistry, and professional growth. Here, stylists from across the Middle East gather weekly to learn new techniques, explore product innovation, and master the art of color. The Academy reflects the brand’s commitment to training the next generation of stylists and distributors, offering live demonstrations, workshops, and certification programs. For Blust On, education isn’t an option — it’s the foundation of lasting success. A Brand Empowered by Its Ambassadors Blust On proudly collaborates with passionate, skilled ambassadors who embody its spirit and excellence. Among them is Victor Keyrouz , celebrity hairstylist and creative ambassador for the Middle East. His artistry and expertise bring the brand’s philosophy to life — precision, beauty, and respect for every hair type. As Victor often says, “Blust On perfectly suits the needs of professionals in the Middle East — powerful results, adapted formulas, and a brand that truly understands hair.” Through global ambassadors, the brand builds a bridge between continents, cultures, and creative visions — uniting professionals under a shared language of innovation and results. Expanding Worldwide After its success in the United States and Latin America , Blust On is now expanding rapidly across the Middle East, Europe, and Asia . Its presence at international beauty exhibitions — including the recent Abu Dhabi show and the upcoming Dubai event — marks a new era for professional distributors and partners seeking a brand that combines excellence, innovation, and integrity. Each market adapts Blust On’s global philosophy to local realities, offering tailored solutions for salons and clients alike. The brand’s scalable model, flexible logistics, and education-driven approach make it an ideal choice for distributors seeking long-term partnerships. Blust On’s mission is simple yet powerful: to make high-performance professional products accessible, understandable, and profitable for every salon in the world. Why Distributors Choose Blust On Strong Identity: A clear, modern, and elegant brand built for the professional market. Italian Manufacturing: Top-quality production with European standards and regulatory compliance. Diverse Portfolio: Full color, bleaching, and treatment systems that work together flawlessly. High Profit Margins: Cost-effective ratios and fast-performing formulas that reduce salon time. Education Support: Regular training and marketing materials provided to distributors. Marketing Power: A dynamic, digital-first brand supported by global PR campaigns, social media presence, and ambassador-driven storytelling. Sustainability Commitment: Vegan, cruelty-free, and eco-conscious packaging. Growth Potential: Supported expansion in key territories with flexible partnership models. Blust On isn’t looking for distributors who just sell products — it seeks partners who share its mission to elevate the industry and inspire professionals worldwide. A Global Vision, Rooted in Professional Trust Every color mixed, every tone achieved, and every strand treated with Blust On reflects a deeper purpose: to empower professionals and redefine what performance means in beauty. The brand’s vision is rooted in authenticity, not marketing slogans. It’s built by those who know the daily challenges of the salon — time pressure, client expectations, and the constant search for innovation that actually works. Blust On answers that call. It delivers what professionals truly need: results, reliability, and respect for their craft . And as it continues its global journey — from Miami to Milan, Dubai to Riyadh, Madrid to São Paulo — Blust On carries the same message everywhere it goes: Innovation should be simple. Beauty should be powerful. Performance should be effortless. Visit Our Booth – SR H 27 Meet the Blust On team, discover the full professional range, and experience firsthand why salons around the world are switching to Blust On. Learn about partnership opportunities, educational programs, and distribution models tailored for your region.

INTRO_KR: About us The perfume house By Bortnikoff was founded in 2018 in Thailand. From then on, the house has produced the finest perfume compositions made of the most rare and precious natural ingredients in the world. Many of the oils are distilled by the house itself, which makes the fragrances By Bortnikoff truly unique. Each composition contains between 95 and 100% of natural ingredients. Dmitry Bortnikoff, the founder of the brand, is an architect by profession and a perfumer by vocation. In 2013, he co-founded Feel-Oud, a company which distilled oils from the world’s most expensive agarwood and sandalwood. The result of that experience was the creation of his own perfume brand, which combines traditional distillation techniques, used in the 19th century, with innovations to create modern masterpieces that have both exceptional strength and beautiful sillage to delight their owners as well as those around them. The fragrances By Bortnikoff offer an exquisite olfactive experience, a genuine touch of the raw beauty of nature, expressed in pure oils of the highest quality.

INTRO_KR: About us What if there was a place that could change everything you thought you knew about hair? A place where the future of hairdressing has already begun, where hair is not simply cut or coloured, but lives, breathes, and grows. Imagine haircare that means more than outer beauty. It is the deep feeling of health, the gentle power of healing within every strand, the flow of energy in every movement, and the radiance that blooms from within. It is entering a world where every touch carries meaning, every technique is born from knowledge, and every result is made to last. Welcome to the most sustainable and unique hairdressing concept in the world, where true transformation begins within, becomes visible in the hair, and creates beauty that grows, evolves, and lives with you. Under the guiding principle ORGÆNIC transformation, pure, genuine hair longevity – ORGÆNIC Lifestyle pursues beauty that emerges from within and flows outward. Hair, body, and soul are seen as inseparable. When the inside is healthy, the outside can flourish. True hair quality begins in the balance of the scalp, in the rhythm of one’s own nature, and in a state where body and mind exist in harmony. It is a company where ancient science and timeless wisdom blend seamlessly with modern technology and world-class hairdressing. This unique fusion creates an environment that champions wealth and the natural beauty of hair, promoting harmony, vitality, and positive energy. The combination of precise craftsmanship, individually tailored designs, and nature-connected methods, inspired by Ayurvedic principles, goes far beyond aesthetics. Every technique, every detail, and every product are created with the intention to preserve the hair’s natural vitality, maintain its health, and ensure its beauty endures. The patented ORGÆNIC Haircutting technique embodies this philosophy to perfection. It respects the hair’s internal structure and movement, creating forms that evolve instead of ageing – bringing hair, body, and soul into alignment. The company is led by Petra Brockmann and Thomas Brockmann-Knödler, visionaries and pioneers in the global hairdressing and beauty industries. With decades of experience, they continually develop innovative, efficient, and sustainable services, products, and locations. Deeply customer-focused and driven by a shared vision for the future, they embody the belief that only the best is good enough. ORGÆNIC Lifestyle’s presence is deeply connected to its vision: to inspire through powerful energy and a shared belief in what is to come. This presence brings light, positivity, and intention to every future relationship, every salon, and every creative endeavor. It stands as a beacon for transformation, not only in the way hair looks, but in the way it feels and lives over time. With a strong international footprint in Europe and the Middle East, ORGÆNIC Lifestyle continues to inspire, expand, and set new benchmarks in holistic, high-level hairdressing. Everywhere it appears, it carries the same unmistakable signature: a fusion of masterful artistry, global knowledge, and a deep commitment to authentic, health-focused beauty. Here, transformation becomes more than a change in appearance. It becomes a living process that strengthens hair from within, restores balance to body and soul, and creates beauty that is tangible, visible, and built to last.

INTRO_KR: About us Since 1829, Gmund Paper produces premium and sustainable design papers that are continuously further developed to ensure the highest quality. The papers are manufactured with the utmost care and passion at the company's production site in Gmund at Lake Tegernsee. Sustainability is a core part of the company's culture. Gmund uses eco-friendly processes, renewable and alternative materials, as well as state of the art tech to make paper with a special look and natural feel. Staying true to its values, the company unites outstanding quality with sustainable production methods. Gmund Paper stands for innovation, speed, flexibility, and availability. For customers, this means a range of over 100,000 different types of paper. A variety of textures, colours and materials offer almost unlimited possibilities for brand communication. With sustainable production methods in mind, exceptional materials such as hemp, cotton and other fast-growing fibres are used in Gmund's paper collections. Further examples of Gmund's extensive range include papers made from 100% recycled paper, such as the Gmund Used collection and the popular Gmund Colors collection, which is Cradle to Cradle® (C2C) Silver certified. To this day, we sell our products in more than 50 countries, guaranteeing the best possible quality and service.

INTRO_KR: About us CELIM BioTech is a skincare company specializing in sensitive and inflammatory skin conditions, founded in 2015. Based on over a decade of research into natural fermentation technology, the company developed its functional skincare brand, ATOMU, designed to help manage inflammatory skin issues such as acne, atopic dermatitis, eczema, and psoriasis. ATOMU’s key ingredient, CeBiNES , is a patented, naturally derived substance produced using CELIM’s unique ERBA extraction and fermentation process. CeBiNES holds patents in Korea for both atopic dermatitis and acne, and an acne-related patent in the United States. All major ATOMU products—essences, moisturizers, and cleansers—are steroid-free and have undergone clinical testing for both safety and efficacy. Notably, ATOMU Cream 17, which contains 17% CeBiNES , was published in the SCI-indexed journal Pharmacognosy Magazine, where its effects on improving skin barrier function and relieving itchiness were scientifically validated. CELIM BioTech also maintains a close R&D partnership with Pusan National University School of Korean Medicine, continuously verifying the functional benefits and safety of its formulations. Over the past 10 years, ATOMU has earned the trust of Korean consumers through its strong presence in online communities focused on skin disorders. Today, ATOMU is expanding into domestic and overseas markets through beauty salons, skin aesthetics, pharmacies, and general distribution channels. In particular , it is recommended for home care use after laser treatments at aesthetic clinics to help soothe and recover the skin. ATOMU is a suitable brand for global partners seeking naturally derived, high-functional skincare.

INTRO_KR: About us Ceriotti, an Italian story like many others, where dedication, curiosity, commitment, risk, and effort create a shared set of values, expectations, and satisfactions. A story rooted in the family environment, in the post-war period, where the imperative was "to do", to the present where what matters is "how to do", acting in an increasingly competitive, globalized, and challenging market. Growing up, you understand that quality pays off, that seriousness pays off, even though nothing is guaranteed or immediate, That relationships with people are fundamental, that you can dream without creating false illusions, and that accepting a defeat is the best way to start again, always raising the bar a little higher.It’s important to understand that a lean crew is not a limitation, but can make navigation faster, decisions more immediate, and problems solved simply by sitting around a table, eliminating dead time and inconclusive discussions. We continue to be this way simply because we know no other way, and with a bit of poorly concealed pride, we think that our story, in the end, has proven us right, thanks to everyone who has shared it. TECHNOLOGY Understanding what is behind every single product is not easy, how much work, research, and commitment it took to create it. The end user buys it simply because they like it and believe it is valid. The trust in our brand, acquired over time, is the result of deep knowledge of production processes and constant attention to everything that is innovation to always remain at the highest quality levels in our sector. Technology helps us live better, waste less energy, and achieve ever better results. And this is precisely what a Ceriotti product transmits to those who use it daily year after year, making it a reliable and indispensable partner even without knowing exactly what is behind it. DESIGN Most of the time, it starts with a pencil and a sheet of paper, usually A4 size, and with simple strokes, an idea begins to take shape. Behind this simple gesture, however, lies a set of knowledge ranging from the production processes necessary for its realization, the multifaceted language of forms, the emotional and characterizing aspect, the functionality and ergonomics of the product itself, with an eye on marketing dictates. Then there is creativity, which without all this is of little use, but creativity, unbeknownst to itself, is nothing but the soul, the catalyst of the whole process.Ceriotti has always believed and invested in the added value of design, without following momentary fashions, trying to define a style that could give identity not only to its product but to the brand itself, recognized worldwide as a direct expression of Italian excellence.

INTRO_KR: About us Cesare Quaranta is an Italian company specialized in the design and production of professional aesthetic and medical devices. For over 39 years, our mission has been to combine research, engineering, and design into technologies that deliver visible, reliable, and long-lasting results. All our devices are 100% Made in Italy , entirely developed, engineered, and manufactured in our factory in Turin , under strict quality control and ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 certifications. Each product represents the excellence of Italian technology and design, with continuous innovation and attention to professional needs. Our patented MYA technology is a total-body, hands-free system that combines six synergic technologies - including electrostimulation, ultrasound, low-level laser therapy, and photobiomodulation - to redefine body contouring and facial care. Its latest evolution, MYA 7.0 , represents the most advanced generation of bioquantic synergy for body and face treatments, offering measurable results and a fully digital user experience. To complete the MYA experience, the LED Mask enhances skin vitality and luminosity through red light photobiostimulation, stimulating collagen production and improving texture and elasticity — an ideal complement to MYA’s body treatments. Combined with LED Mask, our Activa40 Anti Age Serum , rich in natural nucleotides, produces an immediate smoothing of superficial wrinkles, nourishing and returning elasticity and thickness to the skin. A TNT mask previously sunk in the serum is applied onto face and décolletée and left in place for 20 minutes . The Flash 2020 (Plasma Pen) is our compact, medical-grade system for non-invasive skin ablation and rejuvenation. Designed for maximum precision and safety, it offers outstanding results in dermatology and aesthetic medicine through a controlled plasma effect that corrects imperfections and stimulates natural dermal regeneration. HPL is our professional photobiomodulation device, featuring triple-wavelength handpieces for facial and body biostimulation. It promotes tissue regeneration, collagen synthesis, and the visible reduction of wrinkles, hyperpigmentation, and skin laxity. Our devices are the result of continuous collaboration between engineers, biologists, and universities, ensuring scientifically validated, cutting-edge technologies that merge beauty and science. At Beautyworld Middle East 2025 , Cesare Quaranta presents the future of professional aesthetics, a world where Italian innovation meets precision engineering, bringing excellence, performance, and design to every treatment.

More than skincare, we’re committed to education and partnership: through our online platform (Circadia University) and our professional network, we empower clinics, spas and distributors with the tools, training and business support they need to thrive. With a global presence and a strong reputation among skincare professionals, Circadia offers a compelling proposition for exhibitors, spa and clinic partners, and distribution opportunities.

INTRO_KR: About us 🌍 COSMELAB CO., LTD. – Global Beauty Innovator from Seoul, South Korea Cosmelab Co., Ltd. is a leading total beauty solution company based in Seoul, South Korea, providing a full spectrum of services from cosmetic planning, R&D, manufacturing, design, and marketing to global distribution . Since its foundation, Cosmelab has established itself as a trusted partner for K-beauty export and innovation, supplying clinically proven, trend-driven cosmetic products to over 50 countries worldwide . Guided by the philosophy of “Creative Science for Beautiful Skin,” Cosmelab’s mission is to merge scientific research, natural ingredients, and aesthetic sensibility to create effective, sustainable, and inspiring beauty solutions. The company currently manages four distinctive global brands— BERRISOM, G9SKIN, AMILL, and COSCELL —each tailored to meet different consumer needs and market demands across skincare and makeup categories. 💄 BERRISOM – The Original Tattoo Makeup Brand of Korea BERRISOM is Cosmelab’s flagship brand, recognized as Korea’s first and original developer of tattoo-type makeup products . Launched with the aim of offering innovative, long-lasting beauty solutions, Berrisom has become a pioneer in the category of peel-off lip and brow tints . The brand’s hero product, the Lip Tattoo Tint Pack , delivers vivid, transfer-proof color that lasts up to 32 hours , outperforming traditional lipsticks and tints. It uses fruit-based natural ingredients to protect the lips while providing a non-drying finish. The success of this innovation positioned Berrisom as a global hit , with sales exceeding 1 million units and distribution expanding across Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Americas . Other signature items, such as the Oops My Brow Tattoo Pack and Peel-Off lip tattoo continue to define the brand’s identity as a fun, functional, and trend-leading makeup label loved by K-beauty enthusiasts worldwide. 🥛 G9SKIN – Urban Skin Detox and Milk Skincare Line G9SKIN is designed for consumers living in modern cities—those exposed daily to fine dust, pollution, and stress that harm the skin barrier. The brand focuses on urban skin detoxification , providing gentle yet powerful solutions to purify, hydrate, and brighten skin affected by environmental factors. The best-selling Milk Line uses milk protein extract to soften, brighten, and moisturize the skin. Its White In Whipping Cream and White In Milk Toner have achieved cult status, thanks to their instant tone-up and soothing effects. Packaged in eco-friendly, milk-carton-style designs , the products visually reinforce the brand’s identity—clean, youthful, and refreshing. Another popular product range, the Self Aesthetic Magazine Mask Series , includes eight types of masks covering every beauty need—from facial care to hair and foot masks. Each pack is designed like a fashion magazine, appealing to younger audiences through engaging visuals and bilingual (Korean/English) content. Loved in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, and Western Europe , G9SKIN embodies the spirit of trendy, youthful K-beauty. 🌾 AMILL – Korean Rice-Based Clean Beauty Brand AMILL captures the essence of traditional Korean beauty rituals through modern science. Inspired by the practice of washing with rice water for bright and healthy skin, AMILL uses rice extract from Icheon, South Korea , a region renowned for its premium-quality rice. The brand’s core identity centers around clean, gentle, and effective cleansing that supports skin’s natural balance. The Rice Cleansing Foam , Cleansing Oil , and Rice Bubble Foam Cleanser are formulated with natural surfactants, free from parabens and artificial colorants. They gently remove impurities and makeup without stripping moisture, making them ideal for sensitive skin. AMILL’s minimalist packaging and K-FOOD-inspired storytelling have helped the brand gain traction in the Middle East and Southeast Asia , where natural skincare is in high demand. ⚗️ COSCELL – Clinical Derma Brand for Anti-Aging Innovation COSCELL represents the most advanced R&D achievement of Cosmelab—an anti-aging derma brand built on clinical evidence and innovative delivery systems. Each product in the COSCELL line is developed through dermatological research and in-vivo testing , ensuring both safety and visible efficacy. The brand’s hero product, the Retinol Volume Galvanic Serum , is a breakthrough anti-aging solution combining retinol-coated micro-spicules and microcurrent technology . Clinically tested to reduce skin age by up to 9 years in just 4 weeks , it visibly lifts and firms the skin while enhancing elasticity. The micro-spicules—smaller than skin pores—ensure deeper penetration and more effective absorption without irritation. Another best-seller, the Retinol Volume Eyebag Cream , delivers visible wrinkle reduction within just 1 minute , proven by clinical trials. Its precision formula uses micro-needle technology to reduce puffiness, fine lines, and dark circles instantly. The Vita C Line , featuring stabilized vitamin C capsules that resist oxidation, provides brightening and antioxidant effects while maintaining its vibrant yellow color. COSCELL has rapidly expanded in Japan, Europe and the Middle East , and is now recognized as one of Korea’s most promising premium derma brands. 🌐 Global Expansion and Partnerships Cosmelab exports to more than 50 countries across Europe, North America, the Middle East, CIS, and Asia-Pacific . Our strong network of exclusive distributors and strategic alliances allows us to localize our marketing and ensure long-term brand sustainability in each region. The company operates a branch in Japan , supplying K-beauty products directly to retail chains and aesthetic clinics. In Europe, Cosmelab collaborates with partners in germany,spain,italy,greece,bulgaria,romania,hungary,poland etc , while in the Middle East, we distribute through key partners in the GCC region . Cosmelab also participates annually in major global exhibitions, including Cosmoprof Bologna, Beautyworld Dubai, K-Expo New York, and Cosmoprof Hong Kong , strengthening its global visibility and network.

INTRO_KR: About us Cross Reach Trading LLC is a global trading company connecting Japan to the Middle East through innovation and quality.
