Our cosmetics portfolio includes skincare, hair care, pore care, and beauty devices, all carefully selected to match the Middle East’s demand for authentic, premium, and innovative products. Founded in 2013, Cross Reach built strong expertise by bringing Japanese food products to the Middle East. Today, we are leveraging that network and experience to deliver the most promising Japanese cosmetics brands, helping retailers and distributors grow with unique products that stand out in the market. In addition to distribution, we also provide private label solutions for partners who wish to create exclusive brands with trusted Japanese quality. We are committed to building strong collaborations with distributors to expand these brands across the Middle East. At Beautyworld Middle East 2025, Cross Reach Trading LLC will showcase some of the top-performing brands in Japan, widely available across beauty stores there, and now entering the UAE and the Middle East • Face masks: Quality First (7-sheet packs – Japan’s latest trend) and Posh Kosh (30-sheet monthly packs). • Acne care: an innovative pimple patch gel solution — unique in covering pimples while allowing makeup application. • Hair care: some of Japan’s most popular shampoos such as Pluseau and Clayge, along with Unlabel Lab, Salon Link, and Ahalo. • Skincare ranges: Cica Method, PS Series, Retinol Method, Santa Marche, Reihaku, and Derma Laser. • Pore care: advanced keratin-removing solutions. • Beauty devices: from Brioss, including face-lifting, neck-lifting, and cleansing brushes. • Foot care: a wide selection of Japanese-quality products. Cross Reach Trading LLC is committed to bridging Japan and the Middle East through reliable partnerships and innovative brands.We look forward to meeting distributors and retailers across the UAE and the region to build successful collaborations and bring these exciting Japanese products to local markets.

INTRO_KR: About us Dalton Marine Cosmetics NATURAL, GENTLE AND EFFECTIVE The name DALTON stands for 50 years of experience in the field of marine cosmetics. We stick with our credo „Sea the beauty of your skin“, meaning to combine tradition and experience with the latest scientific knowledge and natural efficacy. It has a scientifically proven effect, stimulating the body’s own regenerative properties and giving the skin a rejuvenated, youthful appearance. An independent biophysical and dermatologically controlled study* proves that the Celumer Marine Extract achieves the following results after just four weeks. 48% increase of hyaluronic acid for a multiple boost of the skin’s moisture levels. The skin appears plump and supple. 43% increase of collagen for an intense strengthening of the connective tissue. The skin appears firmer and more youthful. 19% increase of cell activity for an improved cell metabolism. The skin appears vitalized and refreshed. 17% increase of UV protection due to strengthened cells. Counters oxidative stress and premature skin aging.

INTRO_KR: About us 🌿 Careless Beauty – Tradition, Nature & Innovation in Authentic Skincare With over 30 years of expertise on the Romanian market, Careless Beauty is a premium 100% natural dermato-cosmetic brand , founded by Elena Oancea , a chemist and aesthetician, who continued her family’s centuries-old tradition of studying medicinal plants. Careless Beauty represents nature, performance, and elegance in a holistic beauty concept. We are now ready to bring this unique experience to the UAE market, together with partners who share our values: authenticity, excellence, and a deep respect for nature .

INTRO_KR: About us B'iota Laboratories B'iota Laboratories, founded in 2002, combines the power of nature with scientific innovation to create high-quality dermocosmetic and dietary supplement products. Our mission is to deliver natural and effective solutions for beauty and health, using ingredients derived from the rich botanical diversity of Anatolia. With a strong focus on R&D, we continue to expand our reach, serving consumers in over 50 countries and maintaining our commitment to sustainability and excellence . brands : NUTRAXIN : leading brands, utilized its expertise in plants to introduce the Nutraxin Dietary Supplement Series to the market in 2009. BIOXCIN : To be a global leader in dermocosmetics and dietary supplements, pioneering sustainable and natural products that enhance the wellbeing of people and the planet. PRODUCTION / COSMETICS : In our factory, we can produce 60 tons of shampoo simultaneously with three 20-ton shampoo production vessels. We have three 20-ton, one 6- ton, and one 3-ton shampoo production vessels, supported by five 20- ton and six 8-ton storage tanks. Using cream production vessels of various sizes (ranging from 25 kg to 2700 kg), we produce all creams, lotions, gels, serums, waxes, and extracts. Alongside two fully automatic homogenizer-equipped cream vessels of 250 kg and 400 kg, there are other cream vessels with mixers and heating systems of various sizes. With a 1200 kg production vessel, we manufacture jar wax and strip wax. Our liquid filling processes run continuously on five line stations. The daily filling capacity of our shampoo filling lines is 140,000 units per shift. Additionally, we perform sachet, stick, plastic tube-cream, jar cream, and ampoule fillings using modern machinery PRODUCTION / SUPPLEMENT : In our factory, we conduct production using three different granule mixing and manufacturing vessels with capacities of 30 kg, 150 kg, and 350 kg. Additionally, we have dough vessels and ovens for wet productions. Our capacity is significant, with four tablet presses that produce between 40,000 to 150,000 tablets per hour, one capsule filling machine, and two tablet coating machines. We perform packaging using blister and tablet counting machines, ensuring a hands-free process. Moreover, we produce and fill liquid products using three manufacturing vessels, each with a capacity of 550 liters. For hygiene purposes, we use glass materials as primary packaging or our products. R&D CENTER : Biota R&D Laboratories is an R&D Center certified by the Ministry of Science, Industry, and Technology, operating in the fields of cosmetics, dermocosmetics, and dietary supplements. Biota R&D Center operates in an 800 m² area, with six independent laboratories, including a Cell Culture Laboratory, Plant Research Center, Cosmetic Product Development Laboratory, Dietary Supplement Laboratory, Instrumental Analysis Laboratory, Packaging R&D Laboratory, and Product Performance Laboratories. The R&D Center is equipped with advanced analytical instruments, including HPLC-MSMS, GC-MS, and devices for molecular biology such as Real-Time PCR and DNA-RNA protein imaging systems. INTRO_KR: About us 🌿 About D.K Industries | www.dkihenna.com Established in 1990 by Mr. Dinesh Kumar Garg , D.K Industries is a leading Indian manufacturer and exporter of natural hair color and Ayurvedic personal care products. Based in Ghaziabad, near Delhi , the company has built a strong global reputation for excellence, purity, and innovation. Over the past three decades, D.K Industries has grown from a traditional family enterprise into an internationally recognized brand with a strong presence in more than 40 countries across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. Guided by the dynamic leadership of Mr. Sarvagya Garg , the second generation of the founding family, the company continues to expand its reach while staying rooted in its core philosophy — “Stay Young, Naturally Beautiful.” Our company is one of the few genuine manufacturers in India that manages the complete production process in-house — from sourcing raw materials directly from farms to blending, milling, quality testing, and final packaging. With over 125 skilled professionals , including 40+ experts in R&D, quality assurance, sales, and marketing, D.K Industries ensures consistent quality, timely deliveries, and product innovation that meets international expectations. Our advanced manufacturing facility integrates traditional Ayurvedic wisdom with modern processing techniques, ensuring that each batch reflects the purity and potency of nature. D.K Industries specializes in a diverse portfolio of natural and herbal products , catering to professional salons, cosmetic brands, and wellness distributors around the world. Our major product range includes Natural Henna Powder (Lawsonia inermis) , Indigo Powder (Indigofera tinctoria) , and Cassia Obovata (Colorless Henna) , as well as Herbal Hair Colors in a wide variety of natural shades such as Soft Black, Light Brown, Medium Brown, and Dark Brown. We also offer 100% Plant-Based Hair Colors that are completely free from harmful chemicals like PPD, Ammonia, and Peroxide. Alongside these, our Ayurvedic portfolio features Herbal Hair Care Powders , Ayurvedic Shampoos , and Natural Soaps enriched with ingredients such as Amla, Shikakai, Bhringraj, and Brahmi. Each formulation is crafted to provide safe, effective, and sustainable hair and skin care solutions for global consumers who seek authentic natural alternatives. Beyond product excellence, we are also trusted worldwide for our flexible manufacturing and packaging services . D.K Industries offers complete solutions under one roof, including Private Labeling , Third-Party Manufacturing , Customized Packaging , and Bulk Supply . Whether our partners require small private-label batches for boutique brands or full-scale production for multinational companies, we deliver with precision, confidentiality, and adherence to international quality standards. We support various packaging formats such as zipper pouches, vacuum-sealed packs, drums, and jars, ensuring that every product arrives in perfect condition and reflects the client’s brand identity. Our commitment to natural purity, sustainability, and ethical sourcing is at the heart of everything we do. The herbs used in our production are cultivated in chemical-free soil, carefully sun-dried, and processed under strict quality supervision to maintain their natural properties. We follow environment-friendly manufacturing practices and avoid synthetic additives, ensuring that our entire product line remains 100% natural, safe, and eco-conscious . Through continuous R&D, we are developing new herbal blends and natural coloring solutions to meet evolving global trends and regulatory requirements. D.K Industries has been an active participant in major international beauty and cosmetics exhibitions , proudly representing India’s natural heritage on the world stage. Our participation includes Beautyworld Middle East (Dubai) , Cosmoprof Bologna (Italy) , Cosmoprof Asia (Hong Kong) , Beauty Eurasia (Istanbul) , CosmeWeek Tokyo (Japan) , and InterCHARM Moscow (Russia) . These global platforms help us connect with distributors, brands, and professionals who share our passion for sustainable and plant-based beauty. With more than three decades of manufacturing excellence, D.K Industries continues to set new benchmarks in quality, authenticity, and innovation. Our mission is to promote the natural beauty of individuals through products that are safe, effective, and environmentally responsible. Every product we create is a reflection of India’s rich botanical tradition — blended with modern technology and global quality standards. We invite distributors, importers, private-label brands, and cosmetic professionals to partner with us and experience the power of truly natural hair and body care solutions. At D.K Industries, we don’t just manufacture products — we build trust through quality, transparency, and long-term partnerships . For more information, please visit www.dkihenna.com or contact us at dki.henna@gmail.com . D.K Industries – Stay Young, Naturally Beautiful.

INTRO_KR: About us Dongdonggurimu Co., Ltd. is a South Korean cosmetics company best known for its skincare brand LEBELAGE . The company, located at 171 Gukhoe-daero 7-gil, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, operates under business registration number 109-86-50780 . It holds an official e-commerce license (No. 2014-Seoul-Gangseo-1048) and is managed by CEO Soo Hyun Ju and other executives. Dongdonggurimu has positioned itself as a comprehensive beauty manufacturer and brand developer with a growing presence both domestically and abroad. The name “LEBELAGE” derives from French, symbolizing “youth” and the everlasting pursuit of beauty. The brand’s philosophy draws inspiration from the mythical image of goddesses who maintain eternal youth and elegance. LEBELAGE emphasizes the concept that “You have your own beauty – be more beautiful with LEBELAGE,” reflecting a mission to help consumers discover and enhance their natural beauty through trustworthy, high-quality skincare. LEBELAGE’s product lineup covers a full range of skincare and body care items, including cleansing foams, toners, essences, ampoules, eye creams, moisturizers, sleeping packs, masks, and sun protection products. The brand features specialized lines formulated with popular K-beauty ingredients such as collagen, hyaluronic acid, centella asiatica (cica), peptides, snail mucin, vitamin complexes, and gold extracts . These collections target different skin concerns — hydration, elasticity, soothing, brightening, and anti-aging — appealing to a wide spectrum of customers. Dongdonggurimu has also introduced products like the LEBELAGE Collagen + Green Tea Moisture 2 Set and the Hyaluronic Derma Cream (50 ml) , which showcase its focus on ingredient quality and functionality. The latter, for instance, uses eight types of hyaluronic acid with varying molecular weights to provide deep, long-lasting moisture and improve skin texture. Such products have been listed on international B2B platforms such as BuyKorea , reflecting the company’s export-oriented strategy. In addition to its domestic operations, Dongdonggurimu has been expanding into overseas markets, especially across Southeast Asia , including Indonesia and Myanmar , where Korean beauty products continue to gain popularity. The company has participated in international exhibitions such as InterCHARM Korea , presenting its products to global distributors and buyers. Through these efforts, LEBELAGE has been strengthening its brand recognition and building relationships with importers and retail partners worldwide. The corporate name “Dongdonggurimu” itself has cultural and historical significance in Korea. The term originates from early 20th-century Korea, when “cream” (구리무, gurimu) was borrowed from the Japanese pronunciation of the English word, and “dongdong” described the sound of drums or footsteps used by street vendors promoting beauty creams. Naming the company “Dongdonggurimu” symbolizes a nostalgic connection to the roots of Korea’s beauty industry, blending tradition with modern innovation. This clever use of a historical name helps the company stand out among contemporary cosmetic manufacturers. LEBELAGE products emphasize affordability, effective formulation, and everyday usability . The brand positions itself as a practical yet reliable skincare solution suitable for a wide audience. With a design philosophy that favors clean aesthetics and functional packaging, LEBELAGE appeals to both young consumers and mature users seeking trustworthy Korean beauty products without excessive luxury pricing. The company’s official websites — www.ddcos.co.kr and en.lebelage.co.kr — present the brand in both Korean and English, demonstrating its intention to engage a global audience. Certifications and product compliance listings, including those referencing CPNP (Europe) and NMPA (China) , suggest an awareness of international regulatory requirements, supporting Dongdonggurimu’s ambition to expand further into foreign markets. Despite its growing presence, Dongdonggurimu remains a mid-sized enterprise within the competitive K-beauty landscape. Public data about its financial performance, R&D capabilities, and production facilities remain limited, indicating that much of its production may rely on OEM/ODM partnerships with established Korean cosmetic manufacturers. However, its consistent participation in international trade fairs and its use of export platforms highlight an active effort to globalize the brand. The company’s key strengths lie in its diverse product range, balanced pricing strategy, and appealing storytelling that connects cultural heritage with modern skincare science. The LEBELAGE brand aligns with global trends focusing on natural ingredients, multi-step skincare routines, and youthful radiance. As K-beauty continues to thrive worldwide, Dongdonggurimu’s commitment to accessible quality positions it well for sustainable growth, especially in markets seeking cost-effective yet proven skincare solutions. Challenges ahead include the need to build stronger brand differentiation , ensure consistent quality control , and enhance marketing transparency to compete with larger Korean brands and global beauty giants. Strengthening digital marketing, influencer collaborations, and eco-friendly packaging could further increase international appeal. Overall, Dongdonggurimu Co., Ltd. represents a modern reinterpretation of Korea’s cosmetic heritage through its LEBELAGE brand. With its fusion of traditional identity, affordable innovation, and global aspirations, the company continues to embody the dynamic evolution of the Korean beauty industry — where history, culture, and science meet to create accessible beauty for all.

The name “LEBELAGE” derives from French, symbolizing “youth” and the everlasting pursuit of beauty. The brand’s philosophy draws inspiration from the mythical image of goddesses who maintain eternal youth and elegance. LEBELAGE emphasizes the concept that “You have your own beauty – be more beautiful with LEBELAGE,” reflecting a mission to help consumers discover and enhance their natural beauty through trustworthy, high-quality skincare. LEBELAGE’s product lineup covers a full range of skincare and body care items, including cleansing foams, toners, essences, ampoules, eye creams, moisturizers, sleeping packs, masks, and sun protection products. The brand features specialized lines formulated with popular K-beauty ingredients such as collagen, hyaluronic acid, centella asiatica (cica), peptides, snail mucin, vitamin complexes, and gold extracts . These collections target different skin concerns — hydration, elasticity, soothing, brightening, and anti-aging — appealing to a wide spectrum of customers. Dongdonggurimu has also introduced products like the LEBELAGE Collagen + Green Tea Moisture 2 Set and the Hyaluronic Derma Cream (50 ml) , which showcase its focus on ingredient quality and functionality. The latter, for instance, uses eight types of hyaluronic acid with varying molecular weights to provide deep, long-lasting moisture and improve skin texture. Such products have been listed on international B2B platforms such as BuyKorea , reflecting the company’s export-oriented strategy. In addition to its domestic operations, Dongdonggurimu has been expanding into overseas markets, especially across Southeast Asia , including Indonesia and Myanmar , where Korean beauty products continue to gain popularity. The company has participated in international exhibitions such as InterCHARM Korea , presenting its products to global distributors and buyers. Through these efforts, LEBELAGE has been strengthening its brand recognition and building relationships with importers and retail partners worldwide. The corporate name “Dongdonggurimu” itself has cultural and historical significance in Korea. The term originates from early 20th-century Korea, when “cream” (구리무, gurimu) was borrowed from the Japanese pronunciation of the English word, and “dongdong” described the sound of drums or footsteps used by street vendors promoting beauty creams. Naming the company “Dongdonggurimu” symbolizes a nostalgic connection to the roots of Korea’s beauty industry, blending tradition with modern innovation. This clever use of a historical name helps the company stand out among contemporary cosmetic manufacturers. LEBELAGE products emphasize affordability, effective formulation, and everyday usability . The brand positions itself as a practical yet reliable skincare solution suitable for a wide audience. With a design philosophy that favors clean aesthetics and functional packaging, LEBELAGE appeals to both young consumers and mature users seeking trustworthy Korean beauty products without excessive luxury pricing. The company’s official websites — www.ddcos.co.kr and en.lebelage.co.kr — present the brand in both Korean and English, demonstrating its intention to engage a global audience. Certifications and product compliance listings, including those referencing CPNP (Europe) and NMPA (China) , suggest an awareness of international regulatory requirements, supporting Dongdonggurimu’s ambition to expand further into foreign markets. Despite its growing presence, Dongdonggurimu remains a mid-sized enterprise within the competitive K-beauty landscape. Public data about its financial performance, R&D capabilities, and production facilities remain limited, indicating that much of its production may rely on OEM/ODM partnerships with established Korean cosmetic manufacturers. However, its consistent participation in international trade fairs and its use of export platforms highlight an active effort to globalize the brand. The company’s key strengths lie in its diverse product range, balanced pricing strategy, and appealing storytelling that connects cultural heritage with modern skincare science. The LEBELAGE brand aligns with global trends focusing on natural ingredients, multi-step skincare routines, and youthful radiance. As K-beauty continues to thrive worldwide, Dongdonggurimu’s commitment to accessible quality positions it well for sustainable growth, especially in markets seeking cost-effective yet proven skincare solutions. Challenges ahead include the need to build stronger brand differentiation , ensure consistent quality control , and enhance marketing transparency to compete with larger Korean brands and global beauty giants. Strengthening digital marketing, influencer collaborations, and eco-friendly packaging could further increase international appeal. Overall, Dongdonggurimu Co., Ltd. represents a modern reinterpretation of Korea’s cosmetic heritage through its LEBELAGE brand. With its fusion of traditional identity, affordable innovation, and global aspirations, the company continues to embody the dynamic evolution of the Korean beauty industry — where history, culture, and science meet to create accessible beauty for all.

INTRO_KR: About us EdenFarm is a Korean OEM and ODM cosmetics manufacturer providing complete one-stop solutions for global beauty brands. We specialize in skincare, cleansing, hair care, and body care products, combining scientific innovation with sustainable production practices. Certified under ISO 22716 (GMP), ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and EVE VEGAN, EdenFarm ensures safe, high-quality, and ethically produced cosmetics that meet international standards. Our advanced manufacturing system integrates strict quality control, precise formulation, and flexible production capacity to support both small and large-scale projects efficiently. Our in-house R&D laboratory is at the center of innovation. The team develops high-performance formulations using cutting-edge ingredients such as PDRN, exosomes, spicules, peptides, ceramides, and natural extracts. These technologies are applied across diverse product types including powder-to-foam cleansers, jelly pads, glass-skin wrapping masks, and capsule ampoules. Beyond formulation, EdenFarm offers full design and packaging support through close collaboration with specialized partners. We create tailored solutions that align with each client’s target concept, price point, and brand identity. EdenFarm’s flexibility allows us to work with emerging indie labels and established international companies alike. Our team provides customized concepts that reflect global beauty trends and regional preferences. Through consistent participation in international exhibitions such as Beautyworld Japan, Cosmoprof North America, InterCHARM Korea, and K-Beauty Expo Taiwan, we continue to expand our global presence and partnerships. Our philosophy emphasizes sustainability, reliability, and innovation. We strive to reduce environmental impact through responsible material sourcing and eco-conscious packaging. At EdenFarm, we believe that true beauty is achieved through harmony between science, nature, and integrity. EdenFarm is more than a manufacturer. We are a creative partner dedicated to transforming ideas into successful market-ready products with speed, precision, and trust.

Since the beginning of its activity ELDAN has cooperated with international experts not only in the cosmetic industry but also in all other disciplines to which cosmetology is strictly connected. By developing highly-sophisticated skin care products they have significantly contributed to the prevention of the precocious skin aging process and to the preservation of its integrity. The achievement of Eldan Cosmetics is the developement and marketing of a complete lines of cosmetic treatments based upon new and updated product concepts. The approach is designed to give consumers an overall sense of personal well-being, health and beauty. Eldan product claims address the needs of the consumers ensuring safe, effective high quality cosmetic treatment products that keep the skin healthy and delay the visible signs of ageing. ELDAN has created 3 cosmetic treatment lines for Eldan Cosmetics Italia srl which have been distributed for several years in various countries.

INTRO_KR: About us Brand Concept We consider scents as a universal language that tells us about your feelings, moods, personalities, tastes, lifestyles and more. Among our wide range of fine fragrances, you will find your signature perfume that will perfectly match with your needs for every occasion. Thus, Infinite Love was born with the desire of designing the most exclusive fragrances that will be surrounding you in every aspect of life. Love is encapsulated as a Keynote in Infinite Love perfume bottle INFINITE LOVE Our perfumes are long lasting like Infinite and similarly, they are made of pure perfume oils such as True Love. These two distinctive characteristics of our perfumes gave us inspiration for the brand name, Infinite Love. To achieve designing a fragrance that lasts longer and made of pure perfume oils is rooted in expertise, harmony and balance. Basically, there are three main components while creating a fragrance oil blend. Fragrance experts name them as top notes, middle notes and base notes. Our fragrance experts work diligently to ensure there is the perfect composition of notes to present the ideal fragrance harmony and balance. But, the delicate part of composing the finest and most precious perfumes is hidden in our Keynote Ingredient, LOVE, with all other olfactory notes. It helps evoking senses, memories, moods, emotions of the Infinite Love wearer.Scents are triggers for our everlasting senses and memories! INFINITE LOVE Even if a beautiful scent itself may be finite, the moment you smell it will be infinite as a golden moment in your memory that you always want to remember. According to studies, scent has a great effect on recalling of our memories. Also, your perfume is the bridge between you and people around you. It is like an invisible mark that you leave behind. It is reflections of your soul, emotions and body. If you want to be remembered from time to time, find your signature perfume from among our premium and rich perfumes and wear it. Then let the people who smell your scent remember you for a lifetime.Minimalist and Bold Design INFINITE LOVE Infinite Love presents its products with packaging of a modern, attractive and expressive style. Our design elements are originated from Infinite Love Philosophy which is eternal, boundless, bold, and pure. So, snow white and outer space black are definitely perfect match by colours to illustrate infinite love. Black colour has the feature of absorbing the light and thanks to that black is ideal to get a balanced contrast for eye-catching designs. To emphasize the bold, strong, dark, and charismatic characteristics of a man, we mainly use black in design of men fragrances packaging. On the other end of the spectrum, white colour reflects the light and so that luminous snow white colour provides a harmonized look with black. White has always been our first choice for the packaging of women fragrances thanks to its visual effect of describing pure elegance and feminine sensuality.

INTRO_KR: About us The Art of Storytelling Through Scent Epicò is an Italian artistic perfumery brand born from the desire to transform every fragrance into a story to be lived. Founded in 2018 by Federico Gucciardi , artist and emotion-narrator, Epicò bridges poetry, imagination, and the sense of smell. Federico, born in Bologna, is known as “The Poet of Perfume” for his unique ability to compose scents as if they were words—creating true olfactory poems. From an early age, Federico showed a rare sensitivity to scents, perceiving them not just as sensations but as stories to be told. After studying art and working for years in top Italian beauty companies, he created Epicò—his creative laboratory, where every perfume begins with a handwritten story. “Every drop is a word. Every perfume is a chapter of our story.” PHILOSOPHY To Epicò, perfume is far more than an accessory: it is a creative act, a poetic gesture, a personal statement. The goal is not to follow trends, but to give voice to individuality. We believe in the power of imagination, the beauty of kindness, and the freedom to turn dreams into wearable art. “Feel good with yourself. Follow your dream and make it even more beautiful than you imagined.” THE EDP COLLECTION An art to wear. A journey to live. Our Eau de Parfum collection is a sensory journey that blends emotion, memory, and artistry. Each fragrance is born from a real inspiration: a walk in the summer rain, the memory of a never-forgotten book, a fleeting moment that left a mark. We don’t just create fragrances—we sculpt atmospheres, paint memories, and compose invisible poems that reveal themselves on the skin. Our creative process is unique: we collaborate with emotional artists—photographers, painters, writers, sculptors—people who may not be perfumers, but who deeply understand emotions. Through this approach, we bring to life fragrances that speak to the soul and evoke distant worlds and personal memories. Each perfume is crafted like a symphony: every note is carefully selected to discover a hidden harmony and give it a voice. THE ESSENCE OF EPICÒ Our fragrances are intimate, bold, and timeless. Designed for those who seek to stand out with authenticity, each scent tells a unique story—a silent dialogue between the perfume and the wearer. Among our most iconic creations is Vanì Charnel , a perfume that narrates a deep, unforgettable love story between two souls who touch the most intimate part of one another—the place where no one ever reaches. Each Epicò fragrance comes with a written tale by Federico himself, revealing the heart of the scent and the emotion behind it. HOME FRAGRANCE The scent that changes the heartbeat The scent of home is identity, emotion, and comfort. Our Epicò Ambience line was born with the same poetic spirit: to make each space a unique sensorial experience. This is more than just a home fragrance—it’s an invitation to live your home as a place of memory and beauty. A simple gesture becomes a ritual, an emotion, a daily story. “Close your eyes. Let your heart take over. Nothing awakens memory more than scent.” WHY EPICÒ Epicò is not a brand to be understood. It is a brand to be felt. It speaks a language that blends poetry, design, and perfumery—turning every bottle into a story, every spray into a journey. Our mission is noble: to make the invisible unforgettable. To turn every fragrance into a tale to be lived, cherished, and shared. EPICÒ We don’t just create perfumes. We create emotions that smell like eternity.

INTRO_KR: About us Eurobio Lab is European company specializing in the production of natural and organic cosmetic products that are manufactured in accordance with the highest European standards and yet boast affordable pricing. INTRO_KR: About us Real Science. Real Results. Real People. Facetheory was founded with a simple belief: effective skincare shouldn’t require compromise. Not on results. Not on ethics. Not on price. From our base in Sheffield, England, we’ve built a global community who believe that science-led skincare should be accessible, sustainable, and genuinely transformative. Our Philosophy We’re driven by one principle: high-performance skincare, powered by science, proven by results. Every formulation starts with active ingredients at clinically studied levels - not just trace amounts for marketing claims. From our award-winning Retinal collection to our barrier-strengthening Ectoin range, every product is developed to deliver visible change you can measure, not just feel. The Facetheory Difference Performance without sensitivity: We focus on barrier-first innovation, ensuring potent results without irritation. Accessible luxury: Premium performance at a fraction of traditional prestige pricing - because good skin shouldn’t be a privilege. Planet-conscious from the start: Vegan, cruelty-free, and formulated under strict EU cosmetic regulations. Clinical Innovation Meets Real Life Our product development philosophy sits at the intersection of clinical science and everyday usability . We formulate in-house with a focus on: Efficacy: Every ingredient is there for a reason, backed by peer-reviewed research. Simplicity: Streamlined routines that deliver maximum impact with minimal steps. Inclusivity: Tested on real people across skin types, tones, and concerns — because results should work universally. From acne-prone to mature skin, our formulas adapt to your life - not the other way around. Hero Collections Ectoin BarrierBuild Milk – Clinically proven barrier-care powered by Ectoin, a natural stress-protection molecule that strengthens and soothes skin exposed to urban and environmental stressors. Retinal Collection – Next-generation Vitamin A treatments designed to deliver clinical-grade results without redness or downtime. Glow-C Vitamin C Range – Antioxidant-powered brightening that evens tone, fades hyperpigmentation, and restores luminosity. Clarifying Line – Niacinamide, Salicylic Acid, and Azelaic Acid formulas that reduce breakouts, congestion, and inflammation while respecting your microbiome. Hydration & Repair – Ceramide-rich moisturizers and cleansers designed to fortify skin’s barrier and lock in long-lasting comfort. We believe clean beauty means more than what’s not inside the formula; it’s also about how we treat the planet and the people behind our products. Our Mission To change what people expect from skincare. We believe that everyone deserves access to honest, effective, and sustainable products that deliver clinically validated results - without the inflated price tag or empty promises. Let’s Redefine Real Facetheory isn’t a trend brand - it’s a movement toward clarity over chaos in skincare. Our community values results, not perfection. And our mission is simple: to make the science of skincare make sense again.

INTRO_KR: About us General information Farmec S.A. stands as the largest and one of the most influential cosmetics producers in Romania and Europe, boasting a rich legacy of success in the cosmetic industry. With 100% Romanian capital and more than 700 employees, Farmec S.A. has seen impressive growth in recent years, with sales turnover rising from €57 million in 2021 to over €81 million in 2024. The company operates an efficient nationwide distribution network with 9 regional representatives across Romania and a strong presence in over 2,000 locations, complemented by its own network of over 30 branded stores in major cities and online presence through several market places and own on-line stores. In addition to its extensive distribution channels, it has successfully implemented its own franchising system. Renowned for its multi-brand portfolio with over 30 product lines and more than 600 items under various brands, Farmec S.A. offers a wide range of high-quality products in the face care, hair care, aerosols and household cleaning categories. Its flagship brands, including Gerovital H3 - Prof. Dr. Ana Aslan, Gerovital, Aslavital, and Farmec, are well-regarded for their effectiveness and innovation competing alongside renowned global names. Company’s products are currently available across 30 countries spanning North America, Asia, the Middle East and Europe via distributors and online channels. A Legacy Rooted in Innovation Farmec S.A.’s story is closely tied to Professor Dr. Ana Aslan, who made history in 1952 by establishing the world’s first Geriatric Institute in Bucharest. In her pursuit of anti-aging solutions, she developed Gerovital H3, a revolutionary anti-aging and globally unique formula. In 1967, Professor Dr. Aslan entrusted this groundbreaking anti-aging solution to Farmec S.A., leading to the creation of the first Gerovital H3 cream in company’s laboratories. Mission Continuing the legacy set up by Prof. Dr. Ana Aslan, Farmec S.A.’s mission is to inspire women to preserve their natural beauty, offering them innovative, effective products with carefully selected ingredients, created by specialists with a tradition in the cosmetic field. Values The company is guided by a well-defined strategy that focuses on the following pillars: Innovation: creates effective products by harnessing the power of the world’s most advanced scientific ingredients, ensuring top performance and cutting-edge results. Tradition: honors the legacy and feels a moral responsibility to continue the pioneering work initiated by Prof. Dr. Ana Aslan, preserving her vision of exceptional skincare and anti-aging solutions. Research: Farmec S.A.’s state-of-the-art laboratory is one of the most efficient in Eastern Europe, backed by decades of expertise. The Research Department is dedicated to advancing skincare innovation through meticulous scientific inquiry. Responsibility: Farmec S.A. is committed to the well-being of its employees, consumers, partners, and the environment. It prioritizes natural, sustainably sourced ingredients, developing products that are both effective and eco-friendly, contributing to a healthier planet. Market Leadership Farmec S.A.’s commitment to excellence has solidified its position as a market leader in Romania, even amid competition from major multinational cosmetic brands. For the 2022-2024 period, the Gerovital brand achieved remarkable results: Gerovital Face Care led both in value (19.4% market share) and volume (16.4% market share) within the face care category (AC Nielsen, March 2022-February 2023). Gerovital Face Care led in value (16.7% market share) within the face care category (AC Nielsen, March 2023-February 2024). Gerovital Anti-Acne Treatment dominated the Anti-Acne segment, with 31.2% market share in value and 35% in volume (AC Nielsen, March 2022-February 2023). Certifications Farmec S.A.’s commitment to excellence is reflected in its certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 22716:2007 (GMP). While the Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standard is not mandatory for cosmetic companies in Romania, Farmec S.A. voluntarily adheres to this pharmaceutical-grade standard, showcasing its dedication to quality. Quality and Recognition Farmec S.A.’s product development relies on continuous market research and effectiveness testing in both national and international laboratories (Spain, Greece, Poland, etc.). The company has developed collaborative relationships with national universities and clinics (Babeș-Bolyai University in Cluj-Napoca, "Iuliu Hațieganu" University of Medicine and Pharmacy) for research, market studies, but also for testing and obtaining international accreditations. Annually, the company modernizes its cosmetic products lines to excel in an industry known for its high rate of innovation. As a result of its excellence in the beauty industry, the company has earned numerous prestigious awards, further affirming its status as an industry leader. Some of the awards received in 2025 & 2024: 🏆 Gerovital – „Cultural Heritage Award”, BrandRO 2025 🏆 Gerovital H3 Prof. Dr. Ana Aslan Equilibrium – Best SPA Supplier 2025, Annual Conference SPA Romania 2025 🏆 Gerovital Plant Cleansing Balm – BEST NEW NON-FOOD PRODUCT, Progresiv Awards 2025 🏆 Gerovital Kids – bronze medal, Effie Awards Romania 2025 🏆 Farmec – Consumer Superbrand, Superbrands Gala 2025 🏆 Farmec – Business Superbrand, Superbrands Gala 2025 🏆 Farmec – second place, BEST VERTICALLY INTEGRATED BUSINESS, Progresiv Awards 2025 🏆 Gerovital H3 Prof. Dr. Ana Aslan Equilibrium – Best SPA Product 2024, Annual Conference SPA România, 2024 🏆 Gerovital – BRAND OF THE YEAR, Progresiv Awards 2024 🏆 Gerovital Kids – BEST NEW NON-FOOD PRODUCT, Progresiv Awards 2024 🏆 Farmec – BEST LOCAL FMCG SUPPLIER, Progresiv Awards 2024 🏆 Gerovital H3 Prof. Dr. Ana Aslan Equilibrium – „The best face cosmetics brand”, Cosmobeauty 2024. Future Strategy Farmec S.A. is continually seeking to expand its local and global footprint through strategic partnerships and market expansion initiatives. If you are interested in learning more about the company and exploring business opportunities, please contact Export Department at email address: depexport@farmec.ro. Export team will be happy to provide detailed information and discuss potential collaboration.

INTRO_KR: About us Farmskin Inc is actualizing FARM DOES A SKIN GOOD by using FARM ingredients to make our skin better. For this to come true, we will work hard to deliver the healthy and refreshing value of the farm to people, like a farmer’s market which makes life richer and healthier. Also, we are going to work hard to make products appropriate for Clean Beauty, Eco-friendly Beauty, and Ethical Beauty for those who seek a healthy lifestyle inside the city. For Clean Beauty, we are not going to use Phenoxyethanol, talc, etc., which are harmful to the human body and we will not use ingredients that do not pass the strict ingredient standards of the company. For Eco-friendly Beauty, we will work hard to decrease the use of plastic as much as possible, to use soy ink instead of chemical ink, to refuse excessive packaging, and to use recycled paper and plastic. For Ethical Beauty, we will prohibit animal testing related to cosmetic products unless it is inevitably required or enforced by another country or by law, we will not only purchase crops from farms but also work hard to promote the farms for the co-prosperity of farmers and we will work hard not to use GMO plants. Farmskin Eco Active Lab is a Farmskin lab which studies the ways to make the skin better with ingredients from the Farm. We are working hard to draw out the potential of familiar ingredients by continuously investing 50% of the budget. With independent technology, we are working hard to develop safer and better products. Farmskin Space is a Farmers beauty market and pursues ‘More than farmers’ market.’ It should look like a Farmers’ market and should be a place to express our products. Farmskin Team are the people working at Farmskin HQ and are ‘the people who create things from nothing.’ They made and registered base ingredients that the world had never seen before, surprised people with designs that had never been seen before, entered the market in a way that had never been seen before and are approaching consumers in a way that the world has never seen before. Farmskin SNS not only publicizes our products but aims to actualize ‘Beauty Education With Farm.’ We will work hard to find ways to use the things from Farm for the beauty business, to let the world know why those things are good, etc. The full version Brand Story that can be shown on the website, etc.

Today, we manage four in-house brands—KOCOSTAR, Mania Holic, Amaholic , and Memory Planner—and export to over 70 countries worldwide. Each product is developed in collaboration with leading CGMP-certified manufacturers in Korea, ensuring safe, effective, and high-quality formulations. At Firstmarket , we deliver innovative beauty solutions that combine trusted Korean technology, thoughtful design, and a deep understanding of global trends. [ Brand Introduction ] KOCOSTAR delivers K-Beauty through innovative masks and wraps, offering targeted care for hair, face, eyes, lips, neck, hands, feet, and more—bringing effortless, joyful moments to your daily routine. Mania Holic offers clean skincare and daily essentials designed to soothe stressed skin and address specific concerns, making self-care simple and effective. Amaholic blends flaxseed’s time-honored benefits with modern science, creating antioxidant-rich skincare and haircare that strengthen the skin and hair barrier and redefine natural care.

INTRO_KR: About us Blanc Nature – Find the Answer to Breakouts. Blanc Nature began from one young boy’s struggle with breakouts and his determination to find a real solution. Founded on the belief that every person deserves clear, healthy skin, Blanc Nature has grown into a trusted Korean derma skincare brand specializing exclusively in acne-prone skin. Our philosophy is simple: we believe that breakouts can only be solved by specialists who truly understand the pain behind acne. That’s why every Blanc Nature product is developed through years of dermatological research, blending clinical expertise with the healing power of nature. Nature-Derived Science, Clinically Proven Results Blanc Nature’s formulas are built on advanced scientific research and naturally derived ingredients. The brand’s signature ingredient, 4-Terpineol , is a highly pure (98%+) antibacterial component extracted from tea tree oil — proven to deliver up to five times stronger results than standard tea tree formulations. Combined with key soothing ingredients such as Centella Asiatica , Camellia Sinensis Leaf , and Houttuynia Cordata , Blanc Nature provides effective relief for troubled, sensitive, and acne-prone skin. Every formula undergoes clinical and dermatological testing to ensure safety and efficacy for acne-prone skin, earning multiple certifications and industry recognition across Asia. Sustainability is a core value at Blanc Nature — we strictly oppose animal testing and adhere to environmentally responsible production standards. Award-Winning, Globally Loved Blanc Nature’s excellence has been recognized with top industry awards, including: HwaHae Beauty Awards – No.1 in multiple categories (Cleanser, Body Wash, Facial Oil, Cushion Foundation) Musinsa Beauty Awards – No.1 Cushion (2025) Glowpick Consumer Awards – Winner for Cleansing Foam & Tea Tree Oil Our bestsellers — such as the Magic Tea Tree Oil, Acne Cleansing Foam, Snail Moisturizer Cream, and Sebum-Zero Airfit Cushion — continue to top charts across Korea, Japan, Singapore, and Taiwan. Global Expansion and Success Blanc Nature is rapidly expanding its presence worldwide, exporting to over 10 countries , including the United States, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Taiwan . The brand has achieved #1 sales rankings on major global e-commerce platforms , including Qoo10 Japan , Shopee Taiwan , and Coupang Korea . With continuous annual sales growth exceeding 100% , Blanc Nature is on track to become the next leading global brand in acne care. Our ambition is to deliver safe, effective skincare solutions to customers across Asia, North America, and beyond. Commitment to Innovation Our R&D team continues to innovate with patented technologies and natural actives that target acne at its root — soothing inflammation, balancing sebum, and repairing post-acne marks. The PUREFIX-DC , Anti-Sebum P , and T-CA Complex are among our proprietary ingredients proven to restore skin clarity and resilience. Each product embodies Blanc Nature’s promise: gentle yet powerful solutions that bring visible results without irritation. Trusted by Experts, Loved by Customers For over 14 years, Blanc Nature has built strong trust with both dermatologists and consumers. Over 50% repurchase rate on major online platforms 97% satisfaction score on HwaHae reviews Thousands of verified customer testimonials across Korea and global markets This long-term loyalty reflects the consistent quality and reliability of Blanc Nature’s skincare. Our Mission Blanc Nature strives to lead the global acne-prone skincare category by offering clinically proven, nature-inspired solutions that bring confidence back to people struggling with troubled skin. Our vision is to become “The No.1 Global Acne Solution Brand” — combining Korean dermatological expertise with clean, sustainable beauty. INTRO_KR: About us Innovating the Future of Shaving: Experience, Quality, and Value Flip Razor, Inc. is a dynamic and innovative force in the beauty and personal care industry, built on a foundation of over 35 years of unparalleled entrepreneurial experience. Product Spotlight: The Flip Razor We are thrilled to introduce our latest innovation, the Flip Razor , to the Middle Eastern market at Beautyworld Middle East. Designed to challenge the status quo of the shaving industry, the Flip Razor is a patented, dual-cartridge system engineered to deliver exceptional performance and a revolutionary value proposition. Key Features & Benefits: Patented Dual-Cartridge Technology: Each razor head features two full-size, high-performance cartridges. This innovative design effectively doubles the life of the razor, providing consumers with twice the number of shaves per cartridge. Uncompromising Performance: The Flip Razor is meticulously engineered to provide a smooth, close, and comfortable shave, rivaling the performance of premium market leaders like Gillette. Our commitment to quality ensures a superior shaving experience every time. Superior Consumer Value: By extending the life of each cartridge, we offer consumers an exceptional cost-effective solution without sacrificing quality. This unique value proposition can be effectively marketed as: "Our 2-pack is equivalant to a 4-pack of ordinary razor cartridges, and a 4-pack is equivalant to an 8-pack of ordinary razor cartridges". Sustainable Shaving Solution: With fewer cartridges needed over time, the Flip Razor offers a more sustainable and environmentally conscious choice for consumers. Why Partner with Flip Razor, Inc.? Beautyworld Middle East is the ideal platform for us to connect with strategic partners who share our vision for growth and innovation. We are actively seeking distributors, retailers, and B2B buyers to help us bring the Flip Razor's clear competitive advantage to consumers across the region. Our extensive experience in launching and scaling successful brands, coupled with a product that offers a demonstrable increase in consumer value, makes us a prime partner for driving market success in the thriving Middle Eastern beauty and personal care market. We offer: A high-margin product with a clear, consumer-friendly value proposition. Marketing and sales support backed by decades of industry expertise. A scalable business model designed for rapid market penetration. Our Mission: To innovate and disrupt traditional personal care categories with smarter, more effective, and more valuable products that delight consumers and drive market success for our partners. INTRO_KR: About us Japan-born. 　A ‘Well-being Luxury Fragrance’ expressing Japanese aesthetics and spirit. “　The World of FLORALUXE PORTRAIT　” Japan Beauty ---- An eternal spirit, traditions, culture, and nature. The essence of beauty handed down through generations now quietly blossoms on the global stage. FLORALUXE. A fragrance brand that elevates Japanese aesthetics and spirit into scent. Founded by floral artist Masami Wake , the brand is imbued with her very name—embodying harmony, serenity, elegance, and beauty. These qualities define our philosophy. Our fragrances go beyond flowers and plants. They are born from the fabric of Japanese culture—tradition, art, and language. Each creation is not simply a fragrance, but an art form, a philosophy, and a narrative of beauty . To wear fragrance is to awaken memory, harmonize the heart, and reflect the essence of the self. PORTRAIT reveals a brilliance that transcends outward appearance—an inner radiance of spirit. When flowers and people come together in harmony, a new dimension of beauty emerges. That is our raison d’être — our very reason for being Crafted with the generous use of natural ingredients, our fragrances distill the power of flowers and plants into a luminous clarity—bringing healing, sensuality, harmony, and light. FLORALUXE. From Japan, a Well-being Luxury fragrance brand. Delivering serene and graceful aesthetics to the world. ABOUT : Founder & Creative Director, FLORALUXE Masami Wake, AIFD Accredited Floral Designer and International Judge, American Institute of Floral Designers (AIFD) Education • Bachelor’s Degree, Ochanomizu University (Japan) • Master’s Degree, Graduate School of The University of Tokyo (Japan) • Graduate, Parsons School of Design (New York, U.S.) Professional Experience During her tenure at Shiseido, Masami Wake collaborated with renowned creators, including Serge Lutens —often referred to as a modern French philosopher of fragrance—and worked alongside Jacques Cavallier-Belletrud , one of today’s three master perfumers, currently serving as Master Perfumer at Louis Vuitton. These experiences provided her with a unique foundation in luxury fragrance development, bridging artistry, culture, and innovation. • Company Name: FLORALUXE Inc. • Head Office: 3-9-10-#603, Minato-ku, Tokyo 105-0022, Japan • Establishment: January 2009 • Capital: JPY 9.9 million •About FLORALUXE : FLORALUXE is a flower design company founded in New York by Masami Wake, an accredited floral designer of the American Institute of Floral Designers (AIFD) — an internationally renowned association recognized in the U.S. for creating floral decorations for prestigious occasions, including White House Presidential Inaugurations. Since its founding, FloraLuxe has specialized in New York–style wedding and event floral design, bespoke gift flowers, and also operates the New York Flower Schools. The brand name FLORALUXE derives from the concept of expressing spiritual richness (LUXE) through the beauty of flowers (FLORAL). INTRO_KR: About us Creative atmospheres, b ohemian lifestyle, t he ecstasy of creation. An intimate universe among studios, ingenuity and an unstoppable passion for creation. Genius people with an unusual capacity to interpret the world in a different manner. A bohemian style, austere, away from social standards. Visionaries, brave, challengers. We owe them the progress and the real creation. Genyum is an homage to geniuses and their bohemian way of life. It explores and joyfully celebrates the creativity, originality and brilliance of that way of life. It allows the free spirit embodied by artists, poets, writers, dancers, musicians and idealistic intellectuals to be shared through a fragrance. A spirit of free thought. Genyum fragrances are the culmination of an olfactory study of the world seen with the crystal-clear vision of these privileged observers. It expresses the rituals that make up the artist’s work, their way of life and the aromas of their creative spaces. Purity, art and creation are the values upon which top class perfumers have developed their creative universes. The creator Genyum was born in a sculptor’s studio, a space in which examples of the strength of raw materials and the taming of the sculpted form abound. Iron, copper, metals tamed by fire, guided by the artist’s skillful hand. These surroundings speak to us of the process by which a work of art is created, a process containing the essence, the final intent. It is from this essence that Genyum perfumes are born. Anna Torrents passion for the olfactory world is an inherent part of her nature. Her curiosity about the world of art, one that has always run in the family, has drawn her so close to artists that she has been able to feel and capture the scents that emanate from their creative spaces, to observe their rituals and that fetishism that stimulates them. She has been able to live and feel like them, breathing in the smell of their workshops. Ethics & Sustainability Our commitment to people and the planet is a principle that governs our lives and our work. We can’t imagine contributing to the environmental stability of our planet in any other way. We are mindful of this when we create our scents. We follow strict standards regarding sustainability, ethics, transparency in production and supply chain while developing them. Our perfumes are vegan and are not tested on animals. The ingredients we use primarily come from nature. Occasionally, out of respect for nature, we turn to synthetic sources that recreate components from the animal world. The fragrances do not contain sulphates, PCMs, parabens or phthalates. Our packaging is made of recyclable materials and produced by local suppliers. The ingredients we use are grown, harvested, extracted and created under sustainable conditions and contributing to the wellbeing of local communities. All our suppliers strictly follow the Good Manufacturing Practices standards

INTRO_KR: About us GERMAPLAST : From design to manufacturing For over 40 years, Germaplast helps you in your creative process, listening to your needs. Our goal is to offer you specific and tailor-made solutions in the field of injection and to bring added value to your projects. For this, we put at your disposal specific skills: - A multidisciplinary , reactive development team, recognized for its technical know how and expertise in materials, innovative and strong proposal. - A "product sensitivity" as a guarantee of quality. Our teams have acquired over the years a sensitivity and ability to perceive the requirements of the profession. These skills enable us to meet the high standards of the perfumes, cosmetics, tableware, drugstore and spirits sectors. GERMAPLAST : More than 40 years of know how Germaplast was created in Oyonnax in 1974. The company then worked in subcontracting for plastics industry. In the mid-1980s, Germaplast focused its business on the injection of plastic parts with a high level of requirements and, for the big brands, produced bespoke pieces for the perfume sector. In 1990, the factory moved to Izernore to improve its production capacity. At the end of the 90s, a new extension of the factory is realized. In 40 years, Germaplast is gradually strengthening its position in the luxury market , particularly in the following sectors: - perfumery and cosmetics - tableware - health-care - spirits GERMAPLAST works today for the biggest brands . We are a human-sized company that can count on our involved and experienced staff. We are vigilant about the quality of human relations and the working conditions within our units. We have therefore decided to implement a CSR approach in order to strengthen our ethical and ecological values. Our injection molding machines are cooled by a closed water systems. Industrial waste is sorted and recovered, which has enabled us to obtain the MORE Label (MObilised to REcycle), Ecovadis Silver Medal & Gold medal in decarbonation. GERMAPLAST works today for the biggest brands .

INTRO_KR: About us I was born with atopic skin and have struggled with skin troubles since childhood. Despite that, my desire to feel beautiful grew stronger, and at the age of 20, I participated in the Miss Korea competition . Back then, I used concealer to hide my skin problems, but that experience made me realize that true beauty is not about covering flaws, but about healing the skin itself. Later, while working as a flight attendant, the dry cabin air made my skin even more sensitive, causing both dryness and acne at the same time. From the question, “Why does dry skin still suffer from acne?”, I decided to create skincare that could solve dryness, aging, and breakouts all at once. That was the beginning of Golden Hour Cosmetic a brand founded with the belief in “the golden time to protect your skin.” I established this company to help those who suffer from sensitive and troubled skin, just as I once did. Inspired by nature and the French word for “plant,” I created the brand PLONTE to embody natural and sustainable beauty. PLONTE uses Heartleaf (Houttuynia cordata) grown on Ulleungdo Island and a fatty-acid-free gentle formula to minimize irritation and restore the skin barrier. We also utilize upcycled ingredients such as brewer’s spent grain (BSG) to create sustainable hair care lines. At PLONTE, our mission is to soothe, hydrate, and rejuvenate the skin while minimizing irritation , delivering sustainable beauty that respects both people and nature.

Through initiatives promoting responsible agriculture and the development of local supply chains, the organization supports growers, encourages eco-conscious practices, and enhances the competitiveness of regional production. By fostering strong connections between producers and industry players, Grasse Expertise plays a strategic role in structuring a sector that is both traditional and forward-thinking , where excellence and environmental responsibility go hand in hand.

INTRO_KR: About us Guinot, a leading brand in the beauty and skincare industry, has a captivating story that traces back to its founding in the early 1960s. The brand's journey began with the vision and passion of a French biochemist named René Guinot, who had a profound fascination with the science of skincare and a desire to revolutionize the industry. The Rene Guinot Company was set up in 1963, to supply his wife, a Beauty Therapist, with quality products. Driven by the belief that every individual should have access to high-quality skincare products and professional treatments that truly deliver visible results, René Guinot founded Laboratoires Guinot in Paris in 1963 with the brand focusing on merging scientific expertise with innovative formulations, all while harnessing the power of natural ingredients to enhance the skin's health and beauty. One of the key moments that cemented Guinot's position as a trailblazer was the introduction of the iconic "Hydradermie" facial treatment in 1972 – a revolutionary treatment, also known as the "Star Treatment," was the first-ever machine-based facial that combined cutting-edge technology with customized skincare products. The Hydradermie treatment became an instant success and remains a cornerstone of Guinot's extensive treatment offerings to this day. Over the years, Guinot continued to expand its range of skincare products and treatments, always staying at the forefront of scientific advancements and incorporating the latest research into their formulations. The brand's dedication to innovation and efficacy, along with a commitment to personalized skincare solutions, has earned Guinot a loyal clientele and the trust of beauty professionals worldwide. As a result of its success, Guinot has grown into a global brand, with a presence in numerous countries and a network of esteemed beauty salons and spas that offer its signature treatments and products. Today, Guinot remains true to its founding principles, upholding René Guinot's legacy of combining science, nature, and professionalism to provide exceptional skincare solutions. With its continued commitment to research, innovation, and education, Guinot remains a beacon of excellence in the beauty industry, empowering individuals to achieve healthy, radiant, and ageless skin. Guinot is distributed by Nazih Group throughout the Middle East.

INTRO_KR: About us HEMANI GROUPS COMPANY PROFILE Hemani, established since 1949, has a vast experience in the field of herbal trade. This has been transferred in the production of herbal products to benefit the consumers in the most natural way. The production takes place under strong quality control to provide the best quality essential for a healthy living. Since moving its Head Office in Dubai in 1995, the products have already earned a huge market reputation in MENA region, USA, Europe, Australia and other countries around the world. Currently there are over 1800 products being sold in over 85 countries around the world. The company has been acknowledged as the Best Exporter of Herbal Products by the Government of Pakistan on numerous occasions, while Hemani has been awarded as the Brand of the year in 2006, 2007, 2009, 2013, 2015, 2016, 2020, 2022, 2023. The products are ISO 9001,14001,18001 Certified, Halal Certified, GMP certified and ESMA Certified. The company also remains the only Pakistani company to be EQM certified. Recently, the CEO of Hemani, Mustafa Hemani, was also awarded for Presidential Gold Medal Award of the Businessman of the Year in 2019 by the President of Pakistan, Mr. Arif Alvi. The products are also available in leading retail chains in UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia and other Arab countries. Currently the company offers products under the categories of - Herbal Tea - Herbal Oils - Fragrances - Personal Care - Hair and Body Care - Healthcare The group has also partnered with some well-known celebrities of Pakistan and has launched products under the brands of Wasim Badami, Aijaz Aslam and Aiysha Omar.

INTRO_KR: About us Founded in 1998 in Wuhan, Jrppacking is a national high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, production and sales of aerosol filling equipment. Since its establishment, we have made brilliant achievements in the three major fields of aerosol products, especially cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and food. Now we have three production bases (Hubei Wuhan main factory, Hubei Huanggang branch factory and Guangdong Zhongshan branch factory), with a plant area of more than 25,000 square meters, a total of about 120 employees, including more than 40 R & D and after-sales service team, and the annual output value has exceeded 80 million. We always focus on technological innovation and quality excellence, and have accumulated more than 20 years of valuable experience. We understand the stringent requirements for precision and consistency in aerosol production, and because of this, our equipment has become the preferred choice for many well-known companies around the world. Jrpacking aerosol filling equipment is designed and engineered to meet the needs of small batch to large scale industrial production. Our equipment covers a wide range of models, from fully automated high-efficiency production lines to flexible semi-automatic systems, which can be adapted to meet the diversified needs of industries such as pharmaceutical, cosmetic, food and chemical. We pay attention to every detail, using precision dosing and sealing technology to ensure consistent quality and consistent performance in every bottle of aerosol products. In the field of aerosol filling, there is no one solution for all customers. That's why we offer a full range of customized services, working closely with our customers from equipment design to installation and commissioning. Whether it's a complex product formulation, a changing production environment, or special packaging requirements, our team of engineers can customize the most appropriate line solution for you. We believe that every customer is unique and that only customization can truly meet your needs. We have supplied aerosol filling equipment to thousands of customers around the world, from small and medium-sized enterprises to multinational giants, on all five continents. Every machine delivered is a fulfillment of our commitment to quality and service. We grow with our customers, helping them to improve productivity, reduce operating costs and ultimately achieve market breakthroughs. In collaboration, we not only provide equipment, but also a long-term partnership that grows with our customers. At Jrpacking, we understand the importance of stable equipment operation to production. That's why our after-sales service team is always on hand to respond to our customers' needs. Wherever you are in the world, we can ensure that your equipment is always in top condition through remote support, online monitoring and on-site service. We provide not only routine maintenance, but also line optimization advice and technology upgrades to ensure that your equipment remains industry-leading throughout its life cycle. In the face of the future, Jrpacking will continue to uphold the three core values of innovation, quality and service to promote the continuous progress of aerosol filling technology. We will continue to invest in research and development to explore more intelligent and environmentally friendly production solutions. Thank you for your trust and support, let us work together to create a new brilliant aerosol industry!

INTRO_KR: About us ABOUT AVGERINOS Born in 1964 from a family pharmacy's compounding lab in Athens, Avgerinos represents three generations of pharmaceutical expertise channeled into luxury skincare. What started as scientific curiosity evolved into something bigger—a mission to prove that natural beauty products don't have to sacrifice performance for principles. We saw an opportunity where others saw impossibility: creating vegan, scientifically-backed skincare that delivers the indulgent experience typically reserved for conventional luxury brands. Our pharmaceutical background gave us the knowledge to make it happen. Today, Avgerinos stands as Greece's premier natural cosmetics brand, transforming daily skincare routines into moments of genuine self-care. Our products speak to everyone—regardless of age, gender, or skin type—because beauty should never be exclusive. WHAT SETS US APART Pure Performance : Every formula is certified vegan and gluten-free, without compromising on results. We believe natural ingredients can outperform synthetic alternatives when properly formulated. Luxury Redefined : Premium packaging meets accessible pricing. Self-care shouldn't be a privilege—it should be a daily ritual everyone can afford. Inclusive Beauty : Our range works for women, men, and everyone in between. Great skin knows no boundaries. Scientific Heritage : Six decades of pharmaceutical knowledge ensures every product is backed by real science, not marketing claims. OUR EXPANDING PRESENCE From our first Athens location, we've grown to 7 flagship stores across Greece and Cyprus, plus partnerships with over 800 retail locations nationwide, plus our self owned pharmacies. Our growth continues across multiple markets—building strong networks both domestically and internationally with partners who share our vision for accessible luxury. Our customers return again and again, creating the kind of loyalty that speaks louder than any marketing campaign. That's what happens when you consistently deliver on your promises. OUR PRODUCTS: * Certified vegan & gluten-free formulations * Natural ingredients & effectiveness without compromise * Luxurious packaging with strong aesthetic identity * Self-care experiences at accessible prices * Suitable for everyone: women, men, all ages Avgerinos represents a new standard in skincare—where natural ingredients meet scientific excellence and luxury meets accessibility.

INTRO_KR: About us INGR: Pioneering the Next Green Revolution through Natural Bio Innovation INGR is a green bio venture company dedicated to leading the next green revolution. Since its foundation, INGR has built a natural bio-material platform that provides functional ingredients and technical services for cosmetics and food industries. Based on this technology, we launched our own beauty and health brand “Vegetology” , realizing the full potential of our natural bio-material platform through a line of functional cosmetics. One of our key innovations is “Viniferin” , a high-value natural bio compound discovered in grape blossoms and commercialized as “Vino Chocolate (Grape Flower Cell Extract)” . If grapevines are a gift from nature and wine is known as the “drop of the gods,” Viniferin can be called the “tear of the gods” — the miracle molecule at the heart of wine. Through INGR’s proprietary molecular switch and cell culture technologies , we have succeeded in mass-producing this rare and valuable compound, which exists only in trace amounts in grape stems and flowers. Scientific reports indicate that Viniferin demonstrates whitening efficacy 62 times greater than Vitamin C and 13 times greater than Arbutin , as well as antioxidant activity 22 times higher than Quercetin and 28 times higher than Tocopherol . Our Vegetology line currently offers six functional skincare products featuring Grape Flower Cell Extract as a core ingredient. Each product contains a high concentration of Viniferin, setting us apart from European competitors and strengthening our position as a leading innovator in Viniferin-based cosmetics. The signature Viniferin Brightening Ampoule (50ml) contains 200,000 ppm of Grape Flower Cell Extract , while the Viniferin Water Essence (150ml) and Viniferin Brightening Mask (25g) each include 100,000 ppm , providing powerful brightening and anti-aging benefits.

Renowned for its exceptional quality and meticulous attention to detail, INHALE offers a curated selection of perfumes tailored for those who seek individuality, luxury, and olfactory distinction. Drawing inspiration from classical Viennese architecture, the brand integrates this aesthetic into its boutique design and packaging, creating a multi-sensory experience that goes beyond the fragrance itself. Today, INHALE operates 9 branches worldwide , including three in Vienna , as well as locations in Turkey, Bahrain, Jordan, Iraq, and the West Bank . The brand is also preparing to launch new branches soon in Germany, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates . With a firm commitment to innovation and excellence, INHALE has become a leading Austrian name in the world of high-end perfumery, expanding its reach across international markets.

INTRO_KR: About us A Global Leader in Professional Haircare Established in 1987, Intercosmetics Milano (IEMME srl) is an indipendent family-owned Italian company dedicated to the professional haircare industry. With manufacturing plants and commercial offices in Milan Italy, with distribution of 100% italian made products and services to over 40 countries around the world. Expertise and Innovation Intercosmetics Milano specializes in manufacturing high-quality hair and scalp care, styling, and finishing products. Intercosmetics Milano prides itself on its innovative spirit and ability to anticipate market trends. They invest heavily in research and development to create cutting-edge formulas and technologies made possible by their flexible and efficient corporate structure. Global Presence and Recognition Intercosmetics Milano’s commitment to expansion and success is evident in their consistent presence at leading trade fairs and industry events worldwide. They aim to strengthen their international standing and showcase their products and manufacturing services to a global audience. Achieving Excellence: Commitment to Quality Their unwavering dedication to quality drives Intercosmetics Milano to select the purest raw materials and incorporate ample specialized active ingredients into their formulas. This meticulous approach ensures exceptional performance and results that meet the most stringent European regulations and international standards. To guarantee the safety and efficacy of their products, they conduct rigorous university tests and studies, as well as microbiological checks throughout the development and production process.The Intercosmetics team of experts, including scientists, marketers, designers, and commercial staff, collaborates seamlessly to cultivate the expertise and innovation necessary to stay ahead of market trends and meet consumer needs. This collaborative approach fosters a culture of excellence and drives their commitment to total customer satisfaction worldwide. By continuously monitoring industry advancements and analyzing market demands, they develop products that cater to the technical, commercial, and solution-oriented needs of both professionals and consumers. In a groundbreaking move, Silvio Mora and Intercosmetics Milano have united to revolutionize the hair care industry, offering cutting-edge solutions tailored to diverse hair types and textures. Silvio Mora’s history of superior hair color products and Intercosmetics Milano’s innovative approach to hair care promise an unmatched level of expertise and specialization. This strategic alliance will fuel advanced research, development, and product specialization, positioning the companies as industry leaders prepared to meet the evolving demands of the global market. The partnership signifies a significant milestone in the industry, paving the way for innovative hair care and color solutions that cater effectively to customers seeking excellence and innovation. The hair care industry is a dynamic and ever-evolving market, with consumers constantly seeking innovative and effective solutions to maintain and enhance their hair’s health and appearance. In a recent development, two esteemed companies, Silvio Mora and Intercosmetics Milano, have joined forces to create a mutually beneficial alliance that promises to transform the industry landscape. This strategic union combines the expertise of two specialized companies, each with a strong foothold in their respective hair cosmetic categories.
