INTRO_KR: About us BOTANIKA MARRAKECH is a Moroccan skincare brand born from the rich natural heritage of Morocco and developed by the dermo-cosmetic laboratory IRCOS, known for its scientific expertise and ethical commitment. At the heart of BOTANIKA MARRAKECH lies the legendary argan tree — not only its precious oil but also its powerful, antioxidant-rich leaf extract — offering a unique fusion of traditional Moroccan beauty rituals and modern cosmetic innovation. Each product is carefully formulated with high-performance plant-based actives such as prickly pear seed oil, rose water, aloe vera, rhassoul clay, shea butter, vitamin C, and niacinamide, delivering real results while respecting the skin’s natural balance. BOTANIKA MARRAKECH celebrates the timeless wisdom of nature and the sensory richness of Moroccan rituals, offering a wide range of treatments for face, body, and hair — from soothing hydrating creams and illuminating serums to luxurious body butters, aromatic oils, and detoxifying scrubs. More than a brand, BOTANIKA MARRAKECH is an invitation to reconnect with nature, tradition, and self-care through elegant, eco-conscious formulations that are free from parabens, silicones, mineral oils, and artificial dyes. Every ingredient is selected for its purity, every formula is dermatologically tested, and every product is manufactured under GMP-compliant conditions in Morocco. With respect for biodiversity and local communities, especially through partnerships with women cooperatives who supply fair-trade argan oil and other native resources, BOTANIKA MARRAKECH is committed to sustainable, inclusive beauty. Its mission is to make the power of Moroccan botanicals visible and accessible to the world, uniting ancient remedies with scientific precision and luxurious textures. As an internationally expanding brand, BOTANIKA MARRAKECH reflects the vibrant spirit of Marrakech — warm, authentic, elegant — and redefines clean beauty through high-quality skincare that honors both people and the planet. From the first touch to the final glow, BOTANIKA MARRAKECH offers more than care — it offers a ritual, a story, and a return to the essence of natural well-being. INTRO_KR: About us Istanbul Chemicals and Chemical Products Exporters' Association (İKMİB) was established in 1991 as the leading representative of Turkish exporters in the chemicals and chemical products industry. The Association covers officially more than 20.000 exporters in chemical industry on a national scale and around 8,000 of them are active members and export around the world. Our association renders service as being allied with the Secretariat General of Istanbul Mineral and Metals Exporters’ Association under the Turkish Exporters Assembly (TİM), as being ultimately affiliated to Republic of Turkey Ministry of Trade. Our association continues the organizational work in Turkey with primary goals of being in close relationships with all the sub-sectors of the chemicals industry, following new developments and innovations in the sector closely and engaging new customers overseas. Our Vision is to direct and assist the Turkish chemicals and chemical products sector to become a leading country in the global chemicals trade. Our mission is to develop and implement strategies to increase the share of the Turkish chemicals and chemical products exporters in global markets and maintain a sustainable global competitive strength. INTRO_KR: About us Izzat Daouk is a leading Lebanese producer of personal care, home care, and professional salon products. Established in the early 1980s, the company has evolved from a modest operation into a modern, export-driven manufacturing hub serving over 25 international markets. Location and Infrastructure The factory is located in Choueifat – Dayr Qoubel , Lebanon, in a strategically positioned industrial area that facilitates efficient logistics and access to major export routes. The facility spans a substantial area and is equipped with advanced machinery to accommodate a wide range of production and packaging needs. Production Capabilities The manufacturing plant is structured to handle both high-volume and specialized production requirements. It includes multiple processing lines capable of producing: Liquid and gel-based products Creams, lotions, and emulsions Bulk filling and packaging for up to 5-liter containers Coloration Tubes Packaging capabilities range from travel-size formats to large-volume containers, offering flexibility across retail, institutional, and professional sectors. Research & Development Innovation is a core pillar of Izzat Daouk Manufacturing. In collaboration with specialized consultants and formulation experts, the company maintains a fully equipped R&D and quality control laboratory on-site. INTRO_KR: About us Jasmine is India’s largest manufacturer of floral extracts and one of the most trusted partners to the global fragrance, flavour, cosmetic, food, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical industries. For more than three decades, we have dedicated ourselves to the art and science of extraction, transforming nature’s gifts — flowers, fruits, roots, bark, seeds, gums, and resins — into pure, high-quality concretes, absolutes, essential oils, waxes, and oleoresins that inspire products and experiences across the world. Our origins are deeply tied to India’s farming heritage. Jasmine was born in the fertile flower belt of South India, where generations have cultivated the land with care and respect. This connection to the soil continues to guide our philosophy and operations. We believe that business begins not in factories or boardrooms, but in the fields. The philosophy we call “from tiller to user” reflects our long-term vision: to respect the farmer who nurtures the soil, to uphold transparency and fairness in every relationship, and to ensure that the extracts we deliver carry the essence of purity and sustainability. At the heart of our journey lies the bond we share with our growers. Farmers are not just suppliers to us but partners and stakeholders in our collective success. Over the years, we have established a way of working that is open, inclusive, and non-exploitative, ensuring that they benefit directly from the growth of our business. We support them across the entire crop cycle, offering guidance, resources, and financial stability while keeping them informed about market trends and choices. This close collaboration empowers them to make better decisions, withstand volatility, and embrace sustainable farming practices. It is a model built on trust, and trust, in turn, has become our strongest foundation. Sustainability is not a trend for us, it is our way of being. Organic farming has always been central to our growth, because we know that the well-being of our land and our farmers cannot be separated from the well-being of our business. We view sustainability not as an obligation but as an inherent responsibility — ensuring that every step we take today safeguards the soil, the crops, and the communities of tomorrow. This is why we continue to encourage organic methods, reduce environmental impact through eco-friendly production, and remain accountable to both nature and society. Our infrastructure reflects the same commitment. Jasmine operates two state-of-the-art and eco-conscious plants located in Madurai and Coimbatore, close to the regions where our raw materials are sourced. This proximity ensures freshness and potency by reducing the time between harvest and processing, while also optimizing yields and guaranteeing quality. In these facilities, traditional knowledge blends seamlessly with scientific precision. Our research and development teams constantly refine processes and explore innovations, while our stringent quality checks and certifications ensure that every extract meets the highest international standards. The products we create are used by leading global companies across diverse industries. In fine fragrances, they provide the subtle notes that shape emotions. In flavours, they enhance the taste and authenticity of food and beverages. In cosmetics and personal care, they bring natural purity to creams, lotions, and beauty products. In pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals, they form the basis of wellness and healing solutions that combine tradition with modern science. Each extract is more than an ingredient; it is a story of the soil, the farmer, the science, and the culture that went into its making. Innovation is another cornerstone of Jasmine. Our focus is not just on preserving traditional methods but on pushing boundaries to meet evolving global needs. Whether it is improving extraction efficiency, ensuring traceability, or developing new applications, we continue to invest in research and partnerships that allow us to stay ahead of the curve. At the same time, we remain conscious of our responsibility to minimize our footprint, which is why sustainability is embedded even in the way we innovate. Our people and culture are the invisible strengths behind our success. The values of integrity, collaboration, and responsibility are woven into the way our teams work. Employees at Jasmine are bound not only by professional goals but also by a shared purpose — to carry forward India’s agricultural heritage with respect and to build bridges between farmers in villages and markets across the world. As we look ahead, our vision remains steady: to strengthen our presence as a global leader in natural extracts, while continuing to protect the environment and empower the farming communities that form the bedrock of our journey. We aim to create value that lasts, for our partners, our growers, and our planet. From tiller to user, we remain committed to a model of growth that is inclusive, sustainable, and deeply respectful of nature’s balance. At exhibitions worldwide, Jasmine represents not just a business but a philosophy. We bring with us the story of a company that grew from the soil of India to serve industries across continents. We bring with us products that embody purity, sustainability, and innovation. Most of all, we bring with us a way of working that honours the past while preparing for the future. For every partner who chooses Jasmine, what they receive is not just an extract but a promise — a promise of quality, responsibility, and trust that endures.

INTRO_KR: About us Jijide is an avant-garde Italian perfumery maison, founded in 2016 and globally known for creating artistic fragrances that embody uniqueness and innovation. Jijide was born in 2016 from a conversation between three friends. As an artistic perfumery brand, it evolves over time through an olfactory and collective dialogue. Perfume becomes a means of universal expression and promotion of exchange between cultures, inclusion, respect, and integration. Jijide's creations are conversations in the form of fragrances: they tell the beauty that can be found in open, free, authentic, and conscious dialogue. They do this by choosing to work with emerging artists and offering a unique and unrepeatable experience, alive and unfiltered. They also refuse to limit themselves to creating separate perfumes for women or men. A Made in Italy brand, Jijide's entire production is limited to within a 50 km radius of the metropolitan area of Milan, reducing its environmental impact. The Personalità Collection is our pioneering debut, crafted in collaboration with the esteemed perfumer Maurizio Cerizza. Each fragrance in this collection captures a contemporary state of mind, born from a meticulous and thoughtful development process that involved rich and insightful dialogues with both Italian and Chinese audiences. This collaborative effort enabled us to create scents that truly resonate with the diverse ways people express themselves. The result is a collection of eight distinctive fragrances, each with a bold personality and unique character, celebrating diversity and individuality in a truly captivating manner. Designed to be universally appealing, the collection embodies a strong concept of inclusivity while maintaining a distinct and powerful character. Our fragrances are not only a testament to quality and craftsmanship but also a celebration of the beauty found in our differences. We believe that perfume is more than just a scent; it is an expression of one's identity and emotions. By embracing this philosophy, we have created a collection that invites everyone to explore and celebrate their unique essence. Each fragrance is a journey, an exploration of self, and a tribute to the richness of human experience. With the Jijide Personalità Collection, we aim to inspire a future where individuality is honored, and inclusivity is at the heart of every creation. The Dialogo Collection captures the very essence of our brand: individuals from diverse cultures coming together, engaging in meaningful dialogue, and creating beauty through their interactions. With the Dialogo line, Jijide is dedicated to nurturing new talent by exclusively investing in emerging perfumers who have never crafted a fragrance before. This revolutionary approach results in unique, deeply evocative scents that authentically convey the ideas, emotions, and exceptional skills of these new talents. Each fragrance in the Dialogo Collection is the culmination of a year-long development process, during which these new perfumers explore and refine their creations. The dialogue and collaboration between different cultures not only enrich the fragrances but also foster an environment of inclusivity and mutual respect. The Dialogo Collection celebrates diversity and innovation, offering perfumes that tell compelling and unique stories, reflecting the beauty of cultural encounters. Our commitment to inclusivity is at the heart of the Dialogo Collection. By investing in new talents, we aim to break barriers and provide opportunities for fresh voices in the world of perfumery. Each fragrance is a testament to the power of collaboration and the richness that comes from embracing different perspectives. The scents are not only unique but also deeply personal, capturing the essence of the creators' journeys and the cultural dialogues that shaped them. The Dialogo Collection is more than just a series of perfumes; it is a celebration of human connection and the beauty that arises from it. It invites you to experience the world through the lens of diverse cultures, to appreciate the artistry of emerging talents, and to embrace the inclusivity that defines Jijide . Each fragrance is a story waiting to be discovered, a journey into the heart of creativity and cultural exchange.

INTRO_KR: About us 1. Introduction JLU Co., Ltd. is a professional beauty equipment manufacturing company. Established in 2013 in Busan, South Korea, our company is dedicated to revolutionizing the beauty industry by developing innovative, non-invasive skin care devices. At JLU Co., we believe that beauty should be accessible to everyone, and pursue beauty, valuable life, and a healthy lifestyle for our customers. From our humble beginnings, we have grown into an international presence, exporting our products across the globe. 2. Our Products At JLU Co., Ltd., we take pride in our diverse range of professional beauty equipment. Our technologies, including ultrasound, HIFU, radio-frequency, and cryotherapy, empower our customers to achieve remarkable results without the need for invasive procedures. This year, we are expanding our product line to include homecare devices. HiSONIC.S : It cross outputs of 2 ultrasound frequencies(3,10MHz), reaching various skin layers, it is used for skin elasticity, hydration, glow, and anti-aging treatments. HiSONIC.M : It is a multifunctional home beauty device that lets you easily switch between Ultrasound and HIFU heads, all within a single unit.The Ultrasound cross outputs 2 frequencies(3,10MHz) to improve skin elasticity, glow, and lymph treatments. Meanwhile, the HIFU function simultaneously outputs 2 focused shots at depths of 1.5&4.5mm, which are effective for skin lifting and facial contouring. Lymfit.Plus: It is a versatile homecare skincare device combining 3/10MHz ultrasound technology with 1way HIFU (3.0mm) functions for powerful and non-invasive skin treatments. EX-MODE : It is a personal Kegel exercise device that assists with self-exercise by inducing contraction and relaxation of the external anal sphincter. It measures the contraction and relaxation state of the pelvic floor muscles through the dedicated app. 3. Global Expansion JLU Co., Ltd. has not only become a household name in South Korea but has also successfully expanded its reach to international markets including: USA China Vietnam Singapore Malaysia Japan Hong Kong Lithuania 4. Certifications and Quality Assurance Quality and safety are at the core of our operations. All our products hold CE, FCC, J-MIC, and ISO13485 certifications, attesting to our commitment to meeting the highest international standards. We take pride in delivering reliable and effective solutions to our customers, ensuring their trust in our brand. 5. Digital Transformation In keeping with the times, we are excited to announce the launch of our official website. This digital platform serves a dual purpose: Customer Accessibility : general customers can now easily access product information and prices, making informed decisions at their convenience. Distributor Partners : for our valued distributors, becoming a member of our online platform offers a seamless way to access wholesale products and prices without the need for traditional communication channels like phone calls or emails. Both general customers and distributors can easily order the desired product from the website to any distination around the world. Additionally, we continuesly  provide informative videos on product installation, basic after-sales methods, and practical usage of our products on Youtube Channel. Website: www.jlu.kr Youtube Channel: @jlu_korea_official Instagram: @jlu_korea_official "Better Tech, Better You" JLU. With our upgrading technologies,we will create a better lifestyle for you.

INTRO_KR: About us JMC specializes in unique and multifunctional fillers, including bio-stimulators and bioactive complex injectables, as well as mesotherapy solutions. We offer two distinct brand lineups: Ve age and MESOVERA. Ve age (Medical Device & Advanced Injectables) Ve age PLLA – An injectable biostimulator composed of Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), designed to restore skin volume naturally by stimulating collagen production over time. Certified as a medical device (CE, MFDS/KFDA approved). Ve age Lip – A targeted bioactive injectable with Hyaluronic Acid (HA) and Anthocyanin, providing both hydration and antioxidant protection. (Cosmetic registration only) Ve age EXOSKIN – Formulated with exosomes derived from ginseng berry extract, delivering exceptional benefits for skin regeneration, antioxidant protection, and soothing care. (Cosmetic registration only, CPNP) Ve age PN+ – A multifunctional bioactive skin booster combining PDRN, Hyaluronic Acid (HA), and Glutathione to promote regeneration, hydration, and antioxidant brightening. (Cosmetic registration only, CPNP) Ve age CA+ – A next-generation bioactive skin booster formulated with CaHA (9%), Hyaluronic Acid (HA), Glutathione, and an Amino Acid complex. (In development / Designed only / Cosmetic registration only) Ve age MESO – A liquid-type PLLA mesotherapy solution with HA and PDRN, offering collagen stimulation, hydration, and cellular repair. INTRO_KR: About us Kemon Group is an Italian professional cosmetics company with a three generations of family heritage and more that 60 years of history. Headquartered in San Giustino, in the heart of Italy between Umbria and Tuscany, we combine science, innovation, and sustainability to create high-quality products for hair professionals worldwide. Our facilities include 3 R&D laboratories with more than 30 scientists, and a production capacity exceeding 80 million units per year. Kemon Open Lab, a 28-hectare open-air laboratory, is dedicated to studying native and medicinal plants, experimenting with upcycling processes, and developing sustainable resources for cosmetics. To ensure the highest standards of safety and performance, we conduct extensive in vivo, in vitro, dermatological, and consumer tests, following our ‘Effective Security’ protocol. With a strong commitment to sustainability, we operate with 100% green energy, advanced water purification, eco-friendly packaging, certified processes and products. In 2023, we became a Benefit Corporation, reinforcing our mission to generate shared value for people, society, and the environment. Present in over 60 countries, we stand for quality, trust, and responsibility, supporting the professional beauty industry with research-driven, high-effective and sustainable solutions. Our business is structured into three divisions: Professional Hair Salons, with the Kemon Hair Expert and Actyva lines dedicated to salon professionals; Multichannel, through the Lucens Umbria brand, which brings a holistic approach to a broader beauty community; and Private Label, with K Lab, our innovation hub that develops tailored solutions for partners worldwide.

INTRO_KR: About us Discover the Essence of Our Saudi Heritage through Reef and Osma Perfumes As a leading Saudi brand with a presence in over 360+ locations across the region, we pride ourselves on bringing you a unique and diverse fragrance journey that blends tradition with modern artistry. At the heart of our offerings are two exceptional perfume lines: Reef and Osma — each reflecting different facets of the rich Middle Eastern perfume heritage. Reef Perfumes: Bold Tradition Meets Timeless Power Reef is the embodiment of classic Arabic perfumery, known for its bold, long-lasting scents that celebrate the heritage of the Gulf and broader Middle East. These fragrances are crafted for those who want to make a statement—whether it’s through the deep, resinous aroma of oud, the warmth of amber, or the sophisticated smokiness of leather and spices. Signature Notes: Oud, amber, leather, musk, spices, and rich floral undertones. Performance: Reef perfumes are praised for their strong projection and excellent longevity , often lasting 10-12 hours or more on the skin. Popular Fragrances: Reef Obaiah, Reef 33, Reef 11, and Reef 19 are some of the most beloved — with many comparing Reef 33 to iconic international scents like Dior Sauvage, but with a distinctive Middle Eastern twist. Audience: Although many Reef scents are unisex, their heavier, traditional notes often appeal to those who enjoy classic masculine or deeply oriental profiles. Value: Reef delivers premium-quality scents at affordable prices , making it accessible for everyday use or special occasions without compromising on richness or character. Reef perfumes have carved a loyal following among perfume enthusiasts who appreciate authenticity, power, and a connection to the region’s scent traditions. Osma Perfumes: Modern Elegance with a Story to Tell Osma represents the new wave of Saudi perfumery — where storytelling and creativity meet craftsmanship . The fragrances offer a modern, refined take on scent , blending fresh, fruity notes with creamy florals and musky bases. Osma is designed for those who want a signature scent that is elegant, approachable, and versatile enough for daily wear. Signature Notes: Peach, pear, vanilla, coconut, tuberose, amber, musk, and subtle spices. Performance: Osma fragrances are known for their balanced projection and smooth longevity , offering a confident presence that’s not overpowering. Popular Fragrances: Osma A (noted for its tropical peach and vanilla blend), Osma O (pear and tobacco), Vanilla S (tuberose and amber), Fruity O (mandarin and rose), and Breeze (coconut and praline). Audience: With many gender-neutral scents, Osma appeals to a younger, trend-conscious audience looking for modern yet meaningful perfumes that complement their lifestyle. Value: Osma offers exceptional quality at competitive prices , often outperforming more expensive international brands in both originality and performance. Each Osma fragrance tells a story, capturing moments, emotions, and memories in scent form, making every bottle a personal journey. A Complete Fragrance Experience Under One Brand Together, Reef and Osma perfumes allow us to offer a full spectrum of Middle Eastern perfumery — from the rich, intense, and traditional scents of Reef to the fresh, sophisticated, and narrative-driven creations of Osma. For lovers of powerful, long-lasting oriental perfumes, Reef provides a wide selection of bold options that stay with you throughout the day and into the night. For those seeking modern elegance with a soft but confident presence, Osma delivers versatile and expressive scents perfect for any occasion. Both lines feature unisex fragrances , reflecting the evolving trends in perfumology and the growing preference for gender-neutral scents. By combining the best of both worlds, we celebrate the diversity and depth of Saudi and Gulf perfumery, catering to every preference and lifestyle. Our Commitment to Quality and Accessibility With over 360 locations , we ensure that these exquisite fragrances are easily accessible to perfume lovers across the region. Our commitment is to provide high-quality, unique perfumes that carry the essence of Saudi Arabia’s rich scent heritage while embracing innovation and global trends. Whether you’re discovering your first Reef or Osma scent or expanding your collection, we guarantee an exceptional olfactory experience grounded in tradition, creativity, and authenticity.

INTRO_KR: About us Ladaz : Your Strategic Partner for the Booming GCC Skincare Market Welcome, future partners ! At Ladaz, we're not just offering skincare products; we're presenting a strategic opportunity to capture a significant share of the high - growth GCC beauty market . Our brand is uniquely positioned to meet the evolving demands of modern consumers, and our business model is designed for mutual success . Ladaz is Thai skincare, engineered for tropical living with Natural Oils and Scientific Innovation. Our lightweight, non-greasy formulas offer a luxurious ritual that protects and restores skin from heat, UV, pollution, and blue light, keeping it radiant and fresh. Positioned as "Affordable Premium," we compete on efficacy with luxury brands while remaining accessible. A Market on the Rise : Why Ladaz is the Right Brand, Right Now Ladaz is uniquely positioned to capture two of the fastest-growing segments in the GCC's cosmetics market. • Halal Market: The GCC Halal Cosmetics market is growing at a 15.92% CAGR. Ladaz is Halal-ready with a Clean Beauty formula, offering an immediate competitive edge. • Climate-Responsive Market: This segment is soaring with a 25.5% CAGR. Ladaz's lightweight, non-greasy products are engineered for warm, humid climates, directly meeting local consumer demand for protection against heat and pollution. Ladaz is the brand built for the GCC's future. Our " Affordable Premium " Strategy : A Win - Win for Distributors Our pricing strategy offers distributors and retailers a clear advantage : • Higher Sales Volumes : Our accessible price points encourage customer trials and repeat purchases, driving higher sales volumes compared to high - priced luxury brands . • Attractive Margins : We offer premium quality and innovative formulations at a price point that is significantly more attractive than luxury competitors . For instance, our Facial Essence is priced to be approximately 3 - 4 times more accessible than comparable luxury serums . • Strong Value Proposition : You can confidently offer your customers a product that competes on efficacy and performance with luxury brands, but at a price that makes them a more compelling choice . Brand Review 01 Brand Differentiation? Ladaz is an Oil-Based Specialist targeting hot climates (Heat/UV/Blue Light Protection) — a market few address. We combine researched actives (Blue Oleoactif®, Astaxanthin, etc.) with a Clean & Conscious philosophy. 02 Why Oil - Based Products Specialist? This establishes a clear brand identity and builds loyalty. The niche market is rapidly growing as consumers increasingly seek natural, clean, and functional products. 03 Uncopyable Strength? Our Uncopyable Strengths are built on four dimensions of authenticity: 1. Founder’s Journey: Inspired by the founder’s self-care experience, driving a philosophy of self-love. 2. Real Tropical Expertise: Born from tropical living, providing deep understanding of local skin pain points (humidity, stickiness, pollution) that global brands cannot replicate. 3. Purpose-driven: Champions self-love and conscious living, fostering genuine trust. 4. Affordable Premium: Competes on efficacy with luxury brands while remaining accessible. 04 The Untapped Space : Tropical Positioning While global brands focus on Clean Beauty or ingredients, few own skincare specifically for tropical living. Hot-climate consumers (SEA, GCC, LatAm) have high purchasing power but lack a relevant brand. Ladaz Advantage: • Born from real tropical conditions, not cold-climate adaptations. • Deeply understands tropical challenges: oiliness, stickiness, UV, and pollution. • Formulas directly address pain points: fast-absorbing, non-greasy, offering full protection and recovery. Partnership Built on Trust and Expertise We are a Thai brand from the " world's wellness capital " , bringing a unique blend of naturalness and efficacy . Our founder's story from an industrial engineer to a wellness advocate provides a powerful and authentic narrative that builds trust with a skeptical consumer base . Ladaz is a registered Thai company with FDA - approved products . Our trusted manufacturing partner, Garguar Lab Co . , Ltd . , is GMP and ISO 9001 : 2015 certified . We can provide a Certificate of Free Sale ( CFS ) for all products to facilitate international export . We've already successfully tested our concept in premium multi - brand stores in Bangkok and luxury resorts in Koh Samui . Now, we're ready to expand with a strategic partner in the GCC . By partnering with Ladaz, you are not just distributing a product; you are becoming a key player in a brand that is poised for explosive growth and prepared to meet the needs of a modern, conscious consumer . We are confident that together, we can achieve remarkable success . Our brand is built on a " Ladaz Trinity " of core principles . "Ladaz Trinity" of core principles, harmonizing body and mind for true self-care: 💖 HEARTFUSION (Our Philosophy) : The integration of compassion ("Heart") with beauty and self-care. We are "the empathetic friend." We believe true beauty reflects inner peace, so we offer a deeper experience beyond just skincare. 🧠 MINDFORCE (Our Expertise) : The power of knowledge ("Mind") that drives innovation. We are "the expert." We specialize in skincare for people living in warm climates worldwide, creating innovative solutions for specific challenges like heat, humidity, and sun exposure. 🌐 SOULBOUND (Our Community) : The connection and unity that links people together. We are "the community builder." We aim to create a warm, safe space that welcomes diversity in all its forms, looking beyond customers to build genuine Brand Commitment Clean & Conscious Beauty : Clean, safe, and environmentally conscious . Vegan & Cruelty - Free : Free from animal - derived ingredients and not tested on animals . Safe for All Skin Type : Gentle and suitable for all skin types "Care for Skin, Glow for Soul" Product Philosophy “ Oil - based Skincare for Tropical Life ” Ladaz combines natural oils, plant extracts, and scientific innovation for tropical skin. Addressing concerns about heavy oils, our Tropical Life line features a light, fast-absorbing texture that provides full nourishment without stickiness. It also refreshes the senses with an invigorating peppermint and floral scent. This passion gave rise to the “ Skinergy Oil ” concept : power of Skin + Energy + Oil LaDaz believes that “ Beauty is a journey, ” not just a result . We create products that combine the brand ’ s four core values TropiOil Care • InnovOil Skin • SustainaOil Glow • Self - care Journey Empower and awaken your skin with the power of natural oils and modern scientific innovation, for skin that glows, feels vibrant, strong, and healthy in tropical climates . INTRO_KR: About us Plant Stem Cells in Cosmetics - La DeRMa, The Answer to the Skincare You've Been Looking For. 'La DeRMa '  is a skin science solution developed by a dermatologist, based on medical experience, dermatology knowledge, and research papers. Our website features detailed information about each ingredient in our products, including its source, purpose, and safety profile. This empowers our customers to make informed choices about their beauty regimen. Sustainability Commitment In addition to our focus on quality ingredients, we are deeply committed to sustainability. We strive to minimize our environmental impact through eco-friendly packaging, responsible sourcing, and ethical production practices. Our products are cruelty-free and we continuously seek innovative ways to reduce waste and energy consumption.

INTRO_KR: About us Loretta is a startup using enhanced AFM and in-house AI to offer fast, precise, non-invasive, inclusive biometric skin analysis for cosmetics labs and clinical trials. It aims to support dermatologists and pharmacists with diagnosis and prevention. AFM – Atomic Force Microscopy – works by placing a sample inside the machine, which will scan it using a nanoscopic tip. The tip, called a cantilever, touches the sample very lightly and records the shape of its surface, creating a topographical map – a 3D image of the sample. Using these images, our AI model, trained on over 20 000 annotated images, will search for specific patterns related to skin health and various parameters, such as barrier function, NMF, or UV exposure. This method is completely quantitative, granting objective and accurate results. As it it not an optical method, Loretta's AFM technology works on skins of all tones, ages and health conditions, without any need for invasive sampling: we use simple d-squame skin tapes to collect corneocytes, the outermost cells of the skin, which can be stored for long periods of time at ambiant temperatures, reducing storage costs. Using this test method, you will be able to accurately tell the efficiency of your cosmetic product by directly evaluating the response of your patient's skin cells. Loretta can speed up your testing phases without losing precision, with the guarantee of a scientifically proven method.

Using advanced research and cutting-edge technology, MÁDARA turns nature’s gifts into biologically active ingredients that visibly transform the skin. Some of the most unique ingredients are rejuvenating birch water found in the brand’s bestselling Time Miracle Hydra Firm Hyaluron Jelly, antioxidant-rich plant stem cells from Northern dragonhead that are a key ingredient in MÁDARA mineral sunscreens, as well as hair-growth-stimulating Northern chanterelle mushrooms. The brand’s biologically active skincare addresses the most common skin concerns with dermatologically proven effectiveness, whereas the MÁDARA makeup range cares as it beautifies with potent skincare actives. The brand is especially recognised for its expertise in tinted complexion products, including the award-winning City CC Hyaluronic Anti-Pollution CC Cream SPF15 and Skin Equal Soft Glow Foundation SPF15, which are loved by users, beauty editors and makeup artists worldwide. MÁDARA was founded by Lotte Tisenkopfa-Iltnere in quest of natural skincare that works. Looking for natural alternatives to synthetic beauty products, she found that nothing delivered the results she wanted. Having spent her childhood summers at the Latvian countryside, she knew the healing powers nature holds. And so, MÁDARA was born. Lotte is still deeply involved in the creative process, Northern plant exploration and new product development, and is the brand’s key spokesperson. Entrepreneur, innovator, activist, mom of 3. “At first being charmed by Asian Beauty, starting MÁDARA I realised that there is a huge potential in the ingredients coming from my own region. I love to call it Northern Beauty.” — Lotte Tisenkopfa-Iltnere, MÁDARA founder Sustainability is at the core of MÁDARA — from ingredient sourcing and production process to packaging materials and social responsibility policies. The brand prefers environmentally friendly packaging, including post-consumer recycled, plant-based, and recyclable materials since 2006. With 95% of plant-based ingredients coming from organic farming, MÁDARA supports organic agriculture and biodiversity, restricting the use of chemicals. All skincare and makeup products are exclusively developed and manufactured at the MÁDARA own laboratories and production facility in Riga, Latvia, which is one of the most advanced cosmetic production plants in Northern Europe.

INTRO_KR: About us Our passionate journey into this magical world of perfumes, which evoke different emotions in every nuance, is one of the ways we express ourselves in our daily lives and even reflect our character with our choices, has been going on since 1999. In this pleasant journey of nearly 25 years, we take our inspiration from the beauty of life and the aesthetics of nature while opening the door to dizzying experiences with our unique fragrances in different locations. Believing that the fragrance is the signature of the body, we strive to leave unforgettable traces in your memories and make you unique in everyone's memories with every new perfume we create. We work with the world's leading fragrance producers in the formulation of our perfumes, and also we produce a wide range of products from men's and women's perfumes to ambient fragrances, hair perfumes, and colognes in accordance with international quality standards. As Mad Parfüm, we invite you on a magical journey to discover our different perfumes, each of which will awaken brand new emotions in you while taking you on an endless journey in the charming world of fragrances. Our Vision To transform the world of perfume, creating original fragrances that inspire people to express themselves, create emotional connections, and discover their beauty. By harnessing the power of perfume to transform emotions, we strive for a world full of people who love themselves, are confident, communicate well and develop strong bonds. Our Mission Personal Connection : Help our clients reflect on their unique identities and personal stories, helping them to strengthen their connections with themselves and others. Artistic Expression : Seeing perfume making as an art, freely expressing our creativity and aesthetic sense, and pushing the boundaries to design unique fragrances. Quality & Innovation : Delivering superior fragrance experiences by using the highest quality natural and synthetic ingredients, adopting the latest technologies and most innovative methods in the industry. Sustainability and Respect for Nature : Acting with environmental sensitivity, striving to protect natural resources, and using sustainable production processes. Social Change : Creating social impact in the perfume industry, helping to make positive changes in people's lives, and raising awareness in society. Our Values Creativity : Pushing the boundaries, creating new and impressive perfume combinations, reflecting our artistic vision in perfumes. Customer Satisfaction : Paying attention to our customers' needs, listening to them, and providing unforgettable experiences for them. Respect for People : Respecting our employees and customers, valuing differences, and embracing diversity. Quality : Committed to the excellence of our products, delivering products that meet the highest quality standards. Team Spirit : Emphasizing the importance of working together and achieving success through teamwork. Social Responsibility : Taking responsibility towards society, showing sensitivity to social problems, and increasing social awareness. Our Goals ; Short-Term Goals : To increase customer satisfaction by creating creative and sensory perfume collections. To strengthen social media and digital marketing strategies, increase brand awareness and bring perfume experiences to digital platforms. Achieve sustainability goals by adopting eco-friendly production methods. Medium-Term Goals : To collaborate with creative perfume experts and artists to create original perfumes. Create a global presence by expanding into international markets and appealing to different cultures. Long-Term Goals : To revolutionize perfume technology and become a pioneer in the industry by offering innovative products. Invest in social responsibility projects and educational initiatives to contribute to society. Support research and development to preserve natural ingredients and become an industry leader in sustainability.

INTRO_KR: About us laCabine Group, Premium Skincare Inspired by Professional Aesthetics Founded over a decade ago in Barcelona, laCabine Group has established itself as a global leader in innovative cosmetics. From the very beginning, we have grown into an international brand specializing in premium skincare formulations inspired by medical aesthetics and the latest advances in dermocosmetic science. Our mission is to transform high-performance professional experiences into home-use daily beauty routines . Our flagship brand, laCabine , delivers salon-quality treatments through effective, safe, and results-driven products designed to meet every skin need. Each product reflects our commitment to innovation, efficacy, and scientific research, offering solutions to prevent, correct, and treat signs of aging while maintaining skin health and radiance. At the heart of our approach is laCabine Method , a targeted skincare system that combines personalized products based on skin type and intrinsic and extrinsic aging factors. This method allows every costumer to tailor their routine for maximum effectiveness, providing professional-grade treatments that are accessible, easy to integrate into daily life, and designed to deliver visible results. laCabine Group firmly believes that beauty should not be a luxury, it is a right. We offer products that combine scientific excellence, technological innovation, and a deep commitment to skin health, ensuring that everyone can enjoy high-quality cosmetic solutions without compromising safety or efficacy. Our portfolio includes well-aging treatments, intensive hydration, radiance-boosting solutions, firming care, deep cleansing, and protective skincare. Each formula is the result of rigorous research and development by a multidisciplinary team of experts, and advanced formulation, ensuring professional results with every application. With a growing international presence, laCabine Group continues to expand globally, delivering innovation, quality, and professional expertise in every product. Our dedication to safety, and innovation has made us a trusted brand, recognized by both skincare professionals and discerning consumers seeking visible, long-lasting results. In summary, laCabine Group is more than skincare, it is a complete concept that combines science, aesthetics inspiration, and a passion for beauty, bringing professional treatments to everyday routines in a personalized, effective, and accessible way.

INTRO_KR: About us Les Folies du Parfum – A Masterpiece by Maison Esthétique Group Maison Esthétique Group has been shaping the future of beauty since 2006, creating professional products and protocols for aesthetics, skincare, and body wellness. Through innovation, research, and uncompromising quality, the Group has built a portfolio of prestigious high-end brands chosen every day by thousands of professionals worldwide. Among these, Les Folies du Parfum represents the most artistic and unconventional expression of the Group’s vision. Born from a passion for storytelling and olfactory creation, the brand celebrates iconic figures who challenged conventions and transformed their existence into art. It is a universe where fragrance transcends function to become identity, memory, and emotion. The result is a range of scents that provoke, seduce, and inspire—inviting those who wear them to live an experience rather than simply apply a fragrance. The distinctive design reinforces this philosophy. Ribbed Italian glass bottles, refined finishes, and packaging that elevates every unboxing into a ritual reflect the brand’s commitment to uniqueness and refinement, without excess. Les Folies du Parfum is not just worn. It is lived. A celebration of freedom, creativity, and elegance, it embodies the essence of Maison Esthétique Group : innovation, passion, and beauty without limits.

INTRO_KR: About us MÄNN Skincare is a premium, 100% natural skincare brand designed specifically for the modern man. Founded in the UAE by Kenneth Hoellmann, MÄNN was created to provide high-performance, effective skincare that meets the unique needs of men’s skin. Our products are dermatologically tested , Cruelty-Free , and CosmEthically ACTIVE certified , ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and ethical production. We are committed to sustainability , using eco-conscious packaging and exploring future initiatives like refillable options to reduce waste. Since our launch in 2025, MÄNN has been recognized for its innovation , with features in top beauty publications like Skin Rocks and being named a finalist at the Pure Global Beauty Awards 2025 in multiple categories. MÄNN is on a mission to redefine men’s skincare by offering effective, straightforward solutions that deliver visible results, all while empowering men to embrace self-care , wellbeing , and confidence .

INTRO_KR: About us MISS COP is a French makeup brand created in 2005 by professional makeup artist Sandra Marciano . Since its creation, MISS COP has developed over 5,000 color references and sold more than 50 million products worldwide . The brand’s success lies in its mission to make professional-quality makeup accessible to everyone. As Sandra explains: “Most professional makeup artists who created their own brands offer products at prices that are not affordable for many consumers. I created MISS COP for them — to offer trendy, high-performance makeup at fair prices.” MISS COP is known for its creative, colorful, and trend-driven collections , inspired by the latest looks from fashion and social media. Sandra Marciano continues to work closely with the brand’s creative team — from graphic design to marketing and communication — to develop innovative products that combine quality, style, and affordability . Today, MISS COP is present in many international markets and continues to grow, offering products that celebrate self-expression, confidence, and the joy of makeup .

INTRO_KR: About us Born from the union of French luxury and Korean expertise , MERCY KIM is a young premium beauty brand founded in 2025 by Wendy, a French beauty influencer, and JuneSuk, whose family has been devoted to hair artistry since 1981 . The brand was created in honor of JuneSuk’s mother, Mrs. Kim Soonhyun, an extraordinary woman who, after the Korean War , raised her 2 younger siblings alone at the age of 12, and built a hairdressing empire from nothing. Guided by her passion and kindness, she founded her salon “Mercy Hair”, a symbol of strength, resilience, and shared beauty. The name “ MERCY KIM ” pays tribute both to her salon, Mercy Hair, and to her family name, Kim, keeping her spirit alive through every creation. The color of the logo also reflects the original emblem of her first salon, opened in 1981, a timeless reminder that behind each product lies a story of love, family, and devotion. Today, MERCY KIM continues her legacy by crafting exceptional haircare products made in Korea, where innovation meets heritage to reveal the natural beauty of every strand. At MERCY KIM , beauty begins with heritage. Our first professional haircare line, Renaissance , embodies the essence of renewal : a complete routine designed for all hair types , targeting hair loss while cleansing, hydrating, and strengthening both hair and scalp. Our new and star products are already gaining remarkable success in professional salons in South Korea: the 25 Botanicals & Black Truffle Extract Solution Shampoo and the 27 Botanicals & Black Truffle Extract Solution Treatment Both represent the perfect balance between Korean innovation and French luxury. Each formula is powered by 11 innovative peptides that help stimulate hair growth and fortify the scalp , combined with a refined blend of 25 and 27 botanicals inspired by the Korean herbal pharmacopoeia , renowned for their purifying, soothing, antioxidant, and balancing properties . Enriched with Black Truffle extract , rich in antioxidants and essential nutrients , our products deeply hydrate, protect against pollution and UV , and promote scalp regeneration , revealing stronger, healthier, and more radiant hair.

INTRO_KR: About us Australia’s 1st Clinically Proven Natural Sleep Perfume – Where Nature Meets Science for Restful Nights. At Miracle Plant, we believe that better sleep is the foundation of better living. Born in Melbourne, Australia, and proudly 100% Australian-made and owned, our brand is pioneering a new category in wellness and fragrance: Deep Sleep Natural Perfumes . Unlike conventional sleep aids that are oral, addictive, or cause grogginess, Miracle Plant has developed a safe, non-oral, and non-addictive solution that combines the sensory luxury of natural fragrance with the proven science of aromatherapy. Each spray is carefully formulated with 100% natural, pure essential oils and purified water – with absolutely no alcohol, no synthetics, and no harmful additives. Clinically Proven & Oxford-Backed Miracle Plant’s formulations are not just inspired by nature – they are clinically proven. Our research, led by an Oxford scientist and published in the International Federation of Aromatherapists’ official journal, Aromatherapy Times, demonstrated that over 94% of participants fell asleep faster and experienced deeper, more restful sleep. Tested on more than 250 candidates , our Deep Sleep Natural Perfumes stand apart from typical wellness sprays or pillow mists by offering scientifically validated results. This scientific validation provides distributors, retailers, and customers with complete confidence that Miracle Plant products are effective, trustworthy, and professional. Award-Winning Recognition Our innovation has already been recognised globally with multiple prestigious awards, including: Best Pillow Mist for Kids 2024 – Beauty Shortlist Mama & Baby Awards (UK) Editor’s Choice Awards 2024 – Beauty Shortlist (UK) for For Her, For Him, For Mature, For Every Body Natural Health Beauty Awards 2024 (UK) – Silver and Bronze category wins Naturally Good Awards 2025 (Australia) – Finalist in Best Beauty & Personal Care Category These accolades demonstrate that Miracle Plant is not just a newcomer – but a world-class clean beauty and wellness brand trusted by international experts. Tailored Solutions for Every Age & Lifestyle Sleep is not one-size-fits-all. That’s why Miracle Plant has developed a complete range of five tailored Deep Sleep Natural Perfumes , each designed for specific demographics and needs: For Kids (2+ years): Gentle, safe, and nurturing blends that help children settle into a calming bedtime routine. For Every Body: A unisex all-rounder blend perfect for families and general use. For Her: Soft, floral, soothing notes tailored for women seeking balance and relaxation. For Him: Fresh, grounding, and woody, ideal for men needing stress relief and better rest. For Mature: A comforting, deeper blend that supports older adults in achieving restorative sleep. This level of personalisation sets Miracle Plant apart from global competitors who offer more generic sleep solutions. Multi-Purpose, Easy-to-Use Our perfumes are designed with versatility and convenience in mind: Spritz on the body (pulse points), pillow, bed linen, or into the room. Use before bed to create a soothing sleep environment , or during the day when feeling stressed, anxious, or mentally fatigued. Compact 9ml, 30ml, and 100ml sizes make them perfect for travel, retail gifting, hotel amenities, and personal wellness rituals. Eco-Conscious & Ethical Miracle Plant is more than a wellness brand – it’s a community with purpose. We are proudly: Vegan & cruelty-free Sustainably packaged with FSC-certified kraft boxes and recyclable materials Trusted by Health & Wellness Professionals Miracle Plant is rapidly gaining trust across the professional community: Endorsed by osteopaths, sleep consultants, nutritionists, and aromatherapists who use and recommend our products in their clinics. Distributed across pharmacies, health food stores, spas, gift shops, clean beauty boutiques, resorts, and book stores in Australia, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Korea, and Japan – with new markets opening across the Middle East, Europe, and North America. INTRO_KR: About us MIRACULUM is a Polish cosmetics company with a rich history dating back to 1924, when it was founded by Dr Leon Luster. The founder wanted to create the miraculous cosmetic products therefore he gave the company name MIRACULUM , being the miracle in the market since the XX century. Initially focused on the production of luxury cosmetics, today it is a major player in the Polish cosmetics market, offering a wide range of face and body care products, makeup, perfumes and depilatory products under 11 brands, such as Miraculum, JOKO , iconic Pani Walewska or exclusive Chopin. The company is renowned for its innovative solutions and commitment to creating high-quality products based on its own, original formulas. Founded in 1924, MIRACULUM was one of the first cosmetic companies in Poland.  The company survived difficult times, including World War II and all the political transitions within 100 years, maintaining its market position. The company values ​​tradition, but also strives for innovation and development. It is known for combining medical knowledge with a passion for cosmetology, which was evident in its first products, such as face loose powders for which already in 1931 the company was awarded at the World Exhibition in Paris, winning the Grand Prix. MIRACULUM has a modern laboratory in Krakow, where cosmetic formulas are developed. It is focused on innovation and technical advancement, introducing to its products advanced and deeply supporting ingredients such as Alfa-arbutin, Mel[o]stem™ , Growth Factors EGF/FDF, Rose Stem Cells, Pentavitin, Hyaluronic Acid 5D presented in newest Anti-Pigmentation and EXO-SOME Regenesis Clinic Effect lines. JOKO brand dedicated for makeup celebrates women individuality and diversity, offering makeup products for a diverse customer base. The company believes that beauty is for everyone and strives to provide products that meet the needs of customers of all ages. JOKO brand proudly presents its newest Serum Foundations with biomimetic and neuropeptides, XTend Mascara with hydrolyzed wheat protein & keratin or velvety-textured Face Contour Palettes with mirror. The company places great emphasis on the quality of its products and the use of natural ingredients. Majority of JOKO and Miraculum products respecting nature and ecology are vege, with even up to 98% of ingredients of natural origin. MIRACULUM is known for being driven by passion, commitment and a pursuit of beauty, which is reflected in its products and activities. The Company aims to expand into international markets, offering its products already in more than 30 countries in Europe (UK, Spain, Germany, Finland, Cyprus…), North America (USA, Canada),  Africa and Asia... Currently the company policy is focused into Middle East markets, already distributing to Jordan, Iraq, Israel, Palestine, Qatar, Kuwait and building its market in Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates. Feel invited into miraculous MIRACULUM's world of beauty...

INTRO_KR: About us Miron is a trusted partner for businesses seeking premium glass packaging solutions that preserve the integrity of natural products. We manufacture, distribute, and sell a wide range of unique violet glass packaging for natural products, offering jars and bottles with matching closures, pumps, pipettes, and other accessories to customers in more than 80 countries worldwide. Thanks to its unique properties, Miron glass protects products from the harmful effects of sunlight while acting as a barrier to preserve their bioenergetic values. This ensures that natural products maintain their quality, potency, and freshness for longer - without preservatives. Our packaging is ideal for natural cosmetics, essential and esoteric oils, olive oil, honey, tea, spices, water, flower essences, superfoods, vitamin supplements, homeopathic medicines, and many other natural products. Calaso supplies high-quality glass packaging that elevates your brand and tells your story at first glance. Designed for discerning labels in cosmetics, wellness, luxury food, and home décor, our solutions blend timeless aesthetics with modern functionality. As an official Estal partner, we make exceptional, design-forward packaging accessible to brands of every size. Our Services Include Low Minimum Order Quantities (MOQs): Flexible solutions for start-ups and SMEs. In-Stock Products: A wide range of items ready for immediate delivery, ensuring fast lead times. Technical Expertise: In-depth guidance to perfectly match your product with the ideal packaging solution. Total Packaging Solution: From closures and accessories to decoration services, we provide end-to-end support. Reliable Logistics: Strategically located warehouses and a streamlined supply chain ensure smooth, timely delivery worldwide.

INTRO_KR: About us Monreale Parfums, launched in 2022, is an international niche fragrance brand, with a collection of 21 luxury fragrances, designed for him and her by Givaudan Perfumers. Each essence was crafted to have a ‘character’; to express a mood, feeling or emotion. We invite our wearers to ‘be classic, be timeless, be daring, be joyful, be confident, be bold’. INSPIRATION Our brands founder, Thomas Tsavdaridis, visited the Monreale Cathedral, located near Palermo in Sicily, which is where he began to dream about turning the visit into a tangible expression of the emotions and memories of the experience – for which fragrance was the perfect medium. The Monreale Cathedral is globally renowned for its breathtaking fusion of Norman, Byzantine, and Islamic architectural and artistic styles, a blend that reflects Sicily’s rich history as a crossroads of cultures during the Middle Ages and remains a timeless and connective tale of humanity woven through centuries. Myth meets nature, serenity meets grandeur, and classical meets spiritual as you pass through the bronze doors into a moment of history. NEW OUD COLLECTION In 2024 we are introducing our new ‘Ouds’ collection, to join our 21 current fragrances, with 4 expressive and compelling creations designed by independent perfumer Ilias Kakis. Oud is a fragrant resin derived from the agarwood tree, a species native to Southeast Asia. It's prized for its deep, warm, and complex aroma, often described as having notes of wood, earth, and a subtle sweetness. Due to its rarity and high demand, oud is one of the most expensive ingredients in the world of perfumery. Perfumers describe the ingredient as both comforting and sophisticated with a strong sillage that can last for hours on the skin. We celebrate this luxurious ingredient in 4 new fragrances; Shadow Oud, Oud Delight, Alhambra and 1001 Nights. Each fragrance is composed to showcase new facets of this prized, resinous wood; from sweet and smoky to dark and compelling. DISCOVERY SETS Delve into the world of Monreale Parfums and timeless fragrances with our discovery collections. You can choose 3 scents to complement each other with our vial pack or a completely customisable 7 scent discovery kit, which is ideal to explore more of the collection or send as a gift. Finally, our ultra luxurious mahogany presentation box is for the ultimate fragrance connoisseur with 21 scents, packaging to create a travel pack of vials and 2 x 100ml full size bottles of your choice inlaid in the opulent interior. These sets offer you the chance to explore the notes that resonate with you and how you want to express your personality, your character, your essence, your mood, your dreams, your aspirations. We invite you to ‘discover the exception’ and open the door to the exploration of a new fragrance wardrobe that you can design for yourself, or gift to a loved one or fellow fragrance explorer.

INTRO_KR: About us MTM Industries is a dynamic Polish company with 15 years of experience exporting its car fresheners to over 60 countries worldwide. Apart from our key line ‘Aroma Car Fresheners’ we also work with exclusive lines of licensed products such as Euro 2012, 2016 and 2020 under a UEFA license, a line for the World Cup 2018 under a FIFA license, a line for the British TV show ‘Top Gear,’ as well as  Batman and Superman lines under license from Warner Bros. We have also recently acquired Mattel, Hot Wheels and  Pepsi license. 5 years ago we launched our range of Aroma Home air fresheners and are expanding the line continually due to  rapid growth in demand across the board. Not limiting ourselves to just fresheners, in 2019 we added the Eco Ventis range of dehumidifiers to our offer, these have proven to be extremely popular, especially in the UK. As you can see from our constantly increasing portfolio, we truly are a dynamic, rapidly expanding company- welcome to Poland! Our key solution is the satisfaction of the needs of recipients from different target groups. We have introduced a cross-category offer that consists of combining both brands: Aroma Home and Aroma Car. An example of this combination is Home Herbarium, Gradient, Happy Spring, One Line Combo, Typography, Simplicity, One Day Trip, Modern Fruit and Paint Your Reality collections (car and home fragrances) which provides an ideal solution for both target groups. A method for disseminating products to both groups is positioning them in stores next to each other. Thanks to this, when a potential customer enjoys a given fragrance, he will have the opportunity to buy the same fragrance for a different space (house/car). The number of technologies that We produce allows them to develop this type of offer, which has already been implemented in retail chain stores.  We tries to widely satisfy various needs of customers, putting them in a good mood and allowing them to rest in a corner of their own homes. We  also offers the best quality while caring for the environment, constantly looking for new technological solutions and different ways of product development. We only source the highest quality components for our products, such as exclusive fragrances from France or glass containers from Italy. The unique fragrances combined with innovative design provide an outstanding offer of high quality car and home fresheners available at competitive prices. We are continuously testing and developing new products and shelf designs, in an effort to be 2 steps ahead of our competitors. We consider short term profit, using hard data to make planning decisions. We also think strategically, using neuroscience to predict future trends in our specific market. We are efficient today and equally effective tomorrow. We understand how to increase your total sales and profitability through: a custom made shelf for all Air Freshener products your own brand of constantly evolving products a clear strategic look into the future of this rapidly growing market segment Aroma Car and Home air fresheners are known worldwide, they are sold on 4 continents in more than 50 countries. Such a global presence allows us to easily adapt to clients’ expectations, and our extensive range of air fresheners ensures a wide choice and the complete satisfaction of clients from all over the world. All of  this is possible due to the highly developed technology used in our production processes which allows MTM Industries to produce an ever increasing variety of car and home perfumes. INTRO_KR: About us NANI MAKANI means “beautiful wind” in Hawaiian, a name that captures the essence of lightness, elegance, and quiet grace. Out of this experience, the idea for NANI MAKANI fans was born, a way to hold a breeze, a moment, a feeling. Each fan is both functional and symbolic, reflecting the beauty, joy, and spirit of the islands. At NANI MAKANI, sustainability begins with intention. We believe that true beauty carries responsibility. That is why we carefully select high-quality, natural materials and work with trusted partners who share our values of care, craftsmanship, and environmental awareness. From the sourcing of every thread to the design of our packaging, we aim to create with purpose and longevity in mind. Each detail reflects our deep respect for nature and our commitment to thoughtful, lasting design. We believe that legance is not only how something looks, but how it is made. NANI MAKANI is more than a brand. It is a story, a feeling, and an invitation to live with intention and grace.

INTRO_KR: About us NANOBIOSYSTEM CO., LTD. is a biotechnology company specialising in nano-biomaterial–based regenerative therapeutics and advanced skincare solutions. With over 25 years of R&D expertise led by our CEO, Professor Jangho Kim, we have developed innovative technologies that mimic the Extracellular Matrix (ECM) using precise nano-patterning techniques to enhance cellular regeneration and tissue recovery. Our core portfolio includes biodegradable membranes, nano-patterned regenerative patches, and exosome-based ampoules, all designed to bridge the gap between medical science and skincare. By integrating cutting-edge nanotechnology with clinically proven biomaterials, NANOBIOSYSTEM aims to redefine global standards in tissue regeneration, wound healing, and anti-aging innovation. We are expanding our global footprint through partnerships in Malaysia, Taiwan, Vietnam, and the United States, and are committed to becoming a world-leading company with a corporate value exceeding KRW 10 trillion within the next decade. Our Mission: To improve human life through the convergence of nanotechnology and bioscience, delivering safer, smarter, and more sustainable regenerative solutions.

INTRO_KR: About us ETEREA Cosmesi Naturale is a brand of biotechnological phytocosmetics. Our mission is to create Made in Italy cosmetics and enhance the territory, offering innovative formulas and high performing natural and organic products. Our fundamental principles are: · BIOTECHNOLOGICAL INNOVATION : we use innovative and sustainable procedures. Ours is 100% active cosmetics. Biotechnology allows us to formulate products that provide a more structured and complete penetration of the active ingredients. This guarantees strong qualitative effectiveness. · EXCELLENT PHYTOCOSMETICS : through intense research, we consciously choose high quality plant and organic extracts and active ingredients, to guarantee powerful, rich and pure products, which stand out from conventional ones. · INTERNAL PRODUCTION : We strongly value the integrity of the production process. Each phase, from research to production, takes place internally, ensuring that each product fully reflects Eterea values and standards. Our factory is ISO 22716:2008 certified. INTRO_KR: About us Nature’s Secrets - Skin Care, Hair Care, Gifts, Wellness Wild Beauty - A Legacy of Forest Healing At Nature’s Secrets, we believe that forests are sanctuaries of healing and renewal. Their therapeutic essence, deeply rooted in Sri Lankan heritage for millennia, inspires us to craft beauty that nurtures your wellness and confidence. Crafted within our own biodiversity-rich botanical sanctuary, which conserves over 50% of our island’s medicinal plant varieties, each product is infused with nourishing, lush botanicals that honor nature’s wild heart and its timeless power. With every product, you join our conservation & reforestation efforts in preserving nature’s wild beauty and its healing legacy. We grow and source our natural ingredients from our own organic certified lands , GAP - certified farms and medicial botanical sancturary -ensuring purity and care from the very beginning. We also partner with trusted suppliers who work with local farmer communities , supporting ethical sourcing and sustainable livelihoods. Pioneers in Sustainability Since its inception, the company has been committed to sustainability, aiming to become the world’s most environmentally friendly cosmetic manufacturer. Its initiatives are aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, particularly Goal 6 (Clean Water & Sanitation), Goal 12 (Responsible Consumption & Production), and Goal 15 (Life on Land). Award Winning Quality Since inception, the company has aspired to establish Sri Lanka’s finest and most advanced personal care product manufacturing facilities. Today, it stands as the country’s most hygienic, eco-friendly, and sought-after cosmetics manufacturer, with quality standards that surpass international benchmarks. Equipped with ultra-clean production facilities certified under ISO 22716 GMP hygienic standards , ISO 9001:2015 quality management system and ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management System , the company maintains an unwavering commitment to quality and excellence. Its achievements have been nationally recognized with Sri Lanka’s highest environmental honors — the Presidential Environment Award (Gold) and the National Green Award (Gold) — for outstanding efforts in environmental conservation. Additionally, the company was awarded the Sri Lanka Corporate Health & Productivity Award (Gold) for fostering a secure and supportive workplace.

INTRO_KR: About us In 1904, on India’s vibrant soil, a jeweller named F. Chand discovered more than just gemstones. One day a client brought him ambergris — a rare, waxy marine-scented material long valued in perfumery. Intrigued, he blended it in more than 150 experiments with wild vetiver and Mysore sandalwood until a signature essence emerged: Vergis. In 1905, as jeweller to a royal family of Punjab, he presented Vergis to the royals in an emerald-cut bottle — a fragrance that became their bespoke ritual. For four generations his jewellery house crafted luxury, bespoke scents for royalty. In 2014, the fifth-generation heir returned from Australia to oversee the family business — but his heart was drawn not just to gold and diamonds, but to that hidden legacy of fragrance creation. He teamed up with internationally acclaimed master perfumers and launched the first modern editions: Haute Tobacco and Luxe Hayat. These bold, enduring fragrances carried forward that 100-plus-year tradition in a contemporary form. The name and design reflect that dual legacy: the shard-shaped bottle is inspired by the same emerald-cut octa-faceted jewel motifs that the family’s jewellery house used for royalty from 1904 onward. The precious-metal accents on label and cap, the care in blending — every detail speaks to craftsmanship, refinement and personal expression. At NEESH, we believe that perfume isn’t just a product. It’s an extension of identity — a personal signature — crafted without compromise. Every scent is made with the finest materials, no cheap fillers, and full respect for the art of perfumery. NEESH — where a heritage of jewellery and artisanship meets the timeless power of fragrance.

INTRO_KR: About us NEW IDEA S.r.l. is a global cosmetic services company, specialized in the supply of primary and secondary packaging and in the research and development of new cosmetic formulations for face and body. With its dynamic team of formulation and commercial experts sharing a common passion for innovation and quality, NEW IDEA S.r.l. since 2002 has been committed to offering high-quality, tailor-made complete cosmetic solutions to meet the ever-evolving needs of the cosmetics industry. In the field of primary and secondary packaging, NEW IDEA S.r.l. offers cutting-edge packaging solutions to meet the specific needs of its clients, including the supply or feasibility study of high-quality plastic bottles and tubes, plastic and glass jars with a particular focus on increasingly eco-sustainable new materials. In the field of research and development of new cosmetic formulations, NEW IDEA S.r.l. is engaged in the research and development of innovative cosmetic formulations for face and body, with constant attention to new ingredients and cutting-edge technologies to create products that meet the needs and desires of customers/consumers who are attentive to new market trends. In the field of consulting and technical assistance, NEW IDEA S.r.l. offers comprehensive consultancy and technical assistance to help clients develop and optimize their cosmetic formulations. As a pure third-party contractor, it provides personalized support at all stages of the creative process of a cosmetic product, from the ideation phase to final production and marketing/sales. NEW IDEA S.r.l. puts quality at the heart of its philosophy and every product and service it offers undergoes rigorous quality controls and complies with international standards and cosmetic industry regulations. ____________________________ NEW IDEA S.r.l. ist ein globales Unternehmen für kosmetische Dienstleistungen, das auf die Lieferung von Primär- und Sekundärverpackungen sowie auf die Forschung und Entwicklung neuer kosmetischer Formulierungen für Gesicht und Körper spezialisiert ist. Mit seinem dynamischen Team aus Formulierungs- und Geschäftsexperten, die eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für Innovation und Qualität teilen, hat sich NEW IDEA S.r.l. seit 2002 der Bereitstellung maßgeschneiderter, hochwertiger Komplettlösungen für Kosmetikprodukte verschrieben, um den sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Bedürfnissen der Kosmetikindustrie gerecht zu werden. Im Bereich der Primär- und Sekundärverpackungen bietet NEW IDEA S.r.l. innovative Verpackungslösungen an, um den spezifischen Anforderungen seiner Kunden gerecht zu werden, einschließlich der Lieferung oder Machbarkeitsstudien von hochwertigen Plastikflaschen, -tuben sowie Kunststoff- und Glasgefäßen, wobei ein besonderer Fokus auf zunehmend umweltfreundliche Materialien gelegt wird. Im Bereich der Forschung und Entwicklung neuer kosmetischer Formulierungen ist NEW IDEA S.r.l. in der Forschung und Entwicklung innovativer kosmetischer Formulierungen für Gesicht und Körper tätig. Dabei wird ständig auf neue Inhaltsstoffe und Spitzentechnologien geachtet, um Produkte zu schaffen, die den Bedürfnissen und Wünschen von Kunden und Verbrauchern entsprechen, die sich für neue Markttrends interessieren. Im Bereich Beratung und technische Unterstützung bietet NEW IDEA S.r.l. umfassende Beratung und technische Unterstützung, um Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung ihrer kosmetischen Formulierungen zu helfen. Als reiner Auftragshersteller bietet das Unternehmen personalisierte Unterstützung in allen Phasen des kreativen Prozesses eines Kosmetikprodukts, von der Ideenfindung bis hin zur Endproduktion und Vermarktung/Vertrieb. NEW IDEA S.r.l. stellt die Qualität in den Mittelpunkt ihrer Philosophie, und jedes von ihr angebotene Produkt und jede Dienstleistung unterliegt strengen Qualitätskontrollen und entspricht den internationalen Standards und Vorschriften der Kosmetikindustrie.
