INTRO_KR: About us NICHE AND CO: The Art of Italian Perfumery Niche and Co is not simply a fragrance house—it is a philosophy, a vision, and above all, an enduring love for the artistry of scent. Founded in 2014 by Giorgio Biella and Emilia Armida Chinigò , the company was born from a deep passion for olfactory creation and a belief that perfume should transcend trends, becoming instead an intimate, timeless expression of individuality. From the beginning, Giorgio and Emilia envisioned Niche and Co as more than a brand. It was conceived as a curator of stories, emotions, and journeys—translated into fragrances that speak to the soul. They understood that the art of perfumery is not only about raw materials or technical mastery, but about weaving together history, culture, and imagination to create something deeply personal. At the heart of Niche and Co lies a commitment to celebrating individuality through scent . Each creation is carefully developed to embody authenticity and creativity, guided by the refined sensibility of Italian craftsmanship. Fragrance, for Niche and Co, is not just an accessory; it is an experience—an invisible signature that resonates with the inner self, creating a dialogue between memory, emotion, and identity. Since its foundation, the house has earned recognition as a trusted partner in the world of artistic perfumery , collaborating with visionary perfumers and artisans who share its dedication to excellence. Every collection blends tradition and innovation , respect for heritage and bold experimentation, while never compromising on quality. Through this approach, Niche and Co has built a reputation as a guardian of olfactory artistry, curating brands that invite discovery and inspire a profound appreciation of beauty. A Philosophy of Time, Beauty, and Refinement In a world dominated by speed and instant gratification, Niche and Co embraces a different rhythm. The company believes that true luxury lies not in accumulation, but in time itself —time to create, to refine, to perfect. Its philosophy is rooted in patience, attention to detail, and the pursuit of harmony, qualities that are reflected in every stage of its creative process. Minimalist in aesthetic yet rich in meaning, Niche and Co’s approach to perfumery is one of refinement and restraint . Beauty, they believe, is found in subtlety, in the delicate balance of notes, in the nuance of raw ingredients carefully chosen for their rarity and expressive power. This attention to detail elevates each fragrance into something greater than the sum of its parts: a story sculpted in scent, waiting to be discovered. The Collections Over the years, Niche and Co has given life to three distinct brands, each with its own identity, inspiration, and universe. Together, they form a trilogy of projects that embody the company’s values and celebrate the richness of human creativity, history, and imagination. ONYRICO – Timeless Emotions ONYRICO is an homage to the artistic and cultural legacy of Italy—a country where beauty has always been intertwined with daily life, and where art, history, and craftsmanship have shaped the very essence of identity. The name ONYRICO evokes dreams and timeless emotions, capturing the idea of fragrance as a bridge between the visible and the invisible, the present and the eternal. Each perfume in the ONYRICO collection is more than a scent; it is a narrative shaped by centuries of Italian genius. Inspired by masterpieces of art, architectural wonders, and the poetic resonance of history, these fragrances seek to translate cultural heritage into an olfactory experience. To underline this connection between scent and art , every ONYRICO fragrance is crowned with a unique handcrafted marble cap , each one different depending on the perfume it seals. Marble, a material intimately tied to Italy’s artistic tradition, symbolizes permanence, elegance, and authenticity. No two pieces are alike, making every bottle a small work of art and a collectible object in its own right. The ONYRICO collection thus becomes an olfactory gallery , where each creation invites the wearer on a journey through time and imagination. From the grandeur of Renaissance ideals to the subtle beauty of Italian landscapes, ONYRICO is a tribute to a country where art and life are inseparable. ANIMA MUNDI – Secrets of Ancient Times Where ONYRICO looks to Italy, ANIMA MUNDI turns its gaze to the wider world, drawing inspiration from the great civilizations of antiquity. From Egypt to Mesopotamia, from India to the Mediterranean, these were the cultures that first understood the mysterious power of raw materials and the ability of scent to elevate ritual, connect with the divine, and preserve memory. The name ANIMA MUNDI, meaning “soul of the world,” reflects this vision: a collection dedicated to the origins of perfumery and the wisdom of those who discovered the secrets of nature long before modern science. Each fragrance pays homage to a civilization that contributed to the history of scent, weaving together stories of gods, myths, and rituals with the finest raw ingredients. Rare essences—resins, spices, flowers, and woods—are selected with care to echo the treasures once transported along ancient trade routes. INTRO_KR: About us NUKLA is a high-performance, sustainable skincare brand that exclusively utilizes pure, natural seed extracts. Inspired by ancient Mediterranean traditions, NUKLA emphasizes a holistic approach to beauty—nourishing the skin with nature's offerings while maintaining a commitment to environmental responsibility. Brand Philosophy The name "NUKLA" is derived from "nucleus," symbolizing the seed—the essence of life. The brand's mission is to reconnect individuals with nature by offering skincare solutions that are both effective and eco-friendly. NUKLA's products are crafted without chemicals, preservatives, or synthetic additives, ensuring purity and safety for the skin ([Nukla][1]). Ingredients & Extraction Method NUKLA's formulations are based on high-quality seed oils extracted using the Privileged Supercritical CO₂ method. This advanced technique preserves the integrity of the oils, ensuring maximum potency and effectiveness. The seeds used are sourced from sustainable practices, including by-products from fruit juice production (e.g., pomegranate, peach, apricot, sour cherry), wheat germ, rice bran, sesame, and pumpkin seeds from contracted farmers ([Nukla][1]). Sustainability & Packaging Emphasizing environmental consciousness, NUKLA packages its products in biophotonic glass bottles. These violet-colored containers not only protect the oils from harmful light but are also 100% recyclable and reusable, contributing to a circular economy. The brand's commitment extends to using sustainable agricultural practices and minimizing waste in its production processes ([Nukla][1]). Recognition & Awards In 2024, NUKLA was recognized as a finalist for the "New Skincare Brand of the Year" at the Destination Deluxe Awards, highlighting its innovative approach and dedication to quality ([Destination Deluxe][2]). For more information or to explore NUKLA's product offerings, visit their official website: [nuklaskincare.com](https://www.nuklaskincare.com). INTRO_KR: About us OFBASE is a next-generation K-beauty skincare brand where Korean nature meets modern science . We believe that true beauty begins with finding the skin’s natural rhythm and balance — what we call “Gyeol.” Discovering this natural Gyeol is the most essential part of skincare, and it represents the real spirit of K-Skin . For us, Gyeol means more than smooth texture. It reflects harmony — between hydration, balance, and emotion — within the skin. Using pure ingredients grown in Korea and advanced Tanin Exosome technology , we create routines that help skin regain its natural strength and clarity. At the point where Korean heritage and scientific precision come together, OFBASE defines the beauty of K-Skin through the art of Gyeol. At this year’s exhibition, OFBASE presents its new Exosome skincare collection inspired by the balance of Korean nature and science. The lineup includes Rice Exosome Brightening , designed to refine skin tone and texture through rice-derived exosomes; Bamboo Exosome Moisturizing , offering deep hydration and barrier support from bamboo’s natural moisture energy; and PDRN Cica Exosome Firming , formulated to calm and firm sensitive skin while refining pores. Our journey is a testament to the power of Oud—the golden thread that weaves together the past, present, and future.

INTRO_KR: About us PALSONS DERMA is an Indian dermatological company founded in 1984. We have our head quarters and state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Kolkata. In this journey of four decades, we chose to specialize in skincare formulations since 1993. Our manufacturing facility at Kolkata got the coveted IDMA Quality Excellence Award in the year 2006 followed by ISO : 9001:2008 certification and then the ISO 22716:2007 certification which is a recognition for following the International Standards for Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics. We are a 100 Cr+ company with a strong 500+ member passionate team all working together for common goal of Leadership in Dermatology sharing the core values of Integrity, Retention, L&D, Innovation & Focus. We have dermatological formulations covering a wide span of skin concerns spanning from eczema, psoriasis, vitiligo, urticaria, fungal skin problems, etc., to cosmetic skin concerns like acne, pigmentation, dry skin, aging skin, etc. Our products are trusted by 8000+ dermatologists pan India and have been able to earn their goodwill as we have been able to consistently provide them with quality solutions for their patients with every product of ours ! At Palsons Derma, quality is a way of life. All our products are manufactured ensuring zero product contamination. All operations, right from raw material sampling, dispensing, manufacturing, filling and packing are done under controlled environment i.e., under dedicated HVAC system (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning System), hence we ensure no microbial contamination. All our products are marketed/ manufactured based on Pre Marketing Stability Study & Post Marketing Stability Study. Most of our active ingredients are imported from world’s renowned manufacturer. We carry out analysis of raw materials, intermediates and also the finished products in our State of the Art Laboratory. Every finished product churning out from our plant has undergone more than 100 tests – for ensuring highest quality assurance. Our passion for dermatology has carved the path for bringing to patients a world-class speciality skin & hair clinic called Wizderm in 2011. Wizderm, A Palsons Derma Initiative has now 5 centers and now expanding rapidly for a national presence by 2026. Wizderm exists to provide complete solutions to all aesthetic and dermatological needs. At Wizderm, the team of expert dermatologists ensures the best treatment and care for one’s skin and hair. Wizderm is one of the outstanding approved learning centers of dermatology by the national association of dermatologists. Going ahead we are committed to set up a Learning Center in Dermatology in Kolkata, called Wizderm College of Dermatology (WCD), a training center for budding dermatologists so that the treatments offered to those aspire for quality treatments pan India gets the best of services and care! Our Mission: To attain leadership position in the field of dermatology. To formulate products, which are unique & first time in the country. Tie-up with international dermatological companies for marketing their unique formulations. Create a manufacturing facility of international standard to cater unique formulations across the globe. Initiate a centre of excellence in dermatology. Our Product Category: SUNSCREEN MOISTURIZING LOTION / CREAM SKIN LIGHTENING ANTI AGEING ANTI- ACNE HAIR CARE FACE WASH

INTRO_KR: About us Parfums Parour is a Parisian family company that has punctuated the history of modern perfumery with olfactory works as inventive as they are rigorous. Inspired by both innovation and the French spirit of pure refinement, La maison Parfums Parour expresses its own concept of luxury in all its forms. It combines the pinnacle of know-how and the rarest raw materials in perfumery. Our vocation is perfumery, dreaming up olfactory designs, translating the ethereal and fleeting beauty of these fragrances, revealing the mysteries and secrets of this alchemy, mastering the mixes, and controlling proportions. We dedicate a hymn to a woman, an infinitely assured woman preferring today's desires to tomorrow's dreams. We exist solely for her, the incarnation of contemporary elegance and timeless style. Boldly and generously, we celebrate each day the beauty and charm of men and women the world over. As witnesses and players involved in the changing fashions, we take inspiration, innovate, and tame this invisible but eternally present finery : perfume. Our main purpose is to live up to our ambitions while continuously reinventing and offering brilliant collections in line with our brands. We dare to mix materials, ranging from elegant to inspiring. Therefore, it is not surprising that we count many stars among our fans. Internationally renowned, Parfums Parour also creates perfumes for well-known personalities, and their perfumes continue to be talked about. With our intense passion, we make the dream and mystery of Perfume available to the general public.

INTRO_KR: About us Perfums Bachs was founded in 1965. Located in Girona, we create, produce, manufacture and sell quality perfumes and cosmetics under our own brand or for private label. Our extensive experience in the perfumery sector gives us a consolidated know-how that allows us to produce a wide variety of cosmetic products for different countries, always focusing on target, market needs and current law. As a manufacturer, we can produce all kinds of products according to the target needs or guidelines of a project. From the luxury or niche market, to the mass market, from large companies to small, up-andcoming artesans, from a personal fragrance to an extensie home diffuser collection... we alsways work under one strict parametre: QUALITY. We are completing the fi nal procedures into order to obtain ISO 22716 standard (GMP guidelines) WE CARE We take great care with each project, whether our own or that of a client, and are involved from the fi rst briefi ng to the fi nal production, if requested. We get involved at the level the project needs or the client requires. That’s why we work with the best suppliers for bottles, caps, packaging, embellishes, accessories ... allowing us to offer a full service. Our premises consist of 5,000 square metres, divided into sectors and equipped with the security facilities required by current law, as well as two external logistics warehouses to offer production storage and custody. OFFICES Our offi ces include management, sales, marketing, accounting, human resources, logistics and customer service departments. We are a team consisting of highly skilled professionals, working toward the same goal of quality and service. MANUFACTURING AREA · Capacity for 90,000 litres of storage or soaking. · Equipment for the production of demineralised and decalcifi ed water. · Equipment for fi ltration and refrigeration. · Underground tanks with a capacity for storing 30,000 litres of alcohol. · Delimited zone for alcohol unloading. PACKING AREA · 7 packaging lines for bottled products between 1ml and 250ml · 2 lines for fi lling bottles of 500ml – 1000ml · 2 lines for the deodorant manufacturing · 8 labeling machines as well as coding and shrink-wrapping machines · manipulation areas at the end of the production line or in separate areas LABORATORY Equipped with the necessary instruments for the quality control of raw materials, semi-fi nished and fi nished products. Our technical department is at your disposal both for the development of new products and for any advice on formulas or legislation. Under our own brand label, PERFUMS BACHS, we sell a wide range of products that include perfumes, fragrances for children, products for the home and cosmetics. We have different collections in the market, designed and created according to the target and the type of market for its launch. We know the laws and properties of each market and we adapt our collections to suit them. After years of hard work, we are proud of having good clients around the world who trust in our own brand and sell or distribute our own collections. Offering quality products and a specifi c service allows us to count on the confi dence of leading companies in the sector that entrust their product manufacturing to us. From niche, limited-production collections, to the manufacture of a range of products to supply all of an international chain’s stores, our work always accompanies the external projects and we offer our clients all of our knowledge, commitment and confi dentiality. It’s not being a producer, it’s loving to produce

INTRO_KR: About us PGP Glass Pvt Ltd. Company Profile PGP Glass Pvt Limited is a global leader in the design, production and decoration of sustainable and premium glass packaging. With over 50 years of experience, we have a proven track record of delivering innovative and high-quality solutions to our customers in the cosmetics & perfumery, food & specialty liquor, and pharmaceutical industries. We have one of the largest dedicated production capacities for cosmetics and perfumery. PGP Glass has the largest market share in colour cosmetics, and a customer portfolio consisting of world's top global brands. We are a market leader in the key specialty markets in the USA and a leading supplier of molded flint and amber glass containers. Our Purpose : To enhance the value of our clients by providing specialty glass packaging produced in an increasingly sustainable environment. We are the largest specialty glass player in Asia and have been the fastest growing glass company in the world for over a decade. We are one of the only significant players from Asia with a strong presence in the premium segment. Our Capabilities include: Manufacturing: We have state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities that are equipped with the latest technology. We can produce glass packaging in a wide range of sizes, shapes, and colors to meet your specific requirements. Design and Engineering: We have world-class in-house design studio and one of the largest product portfolios. We also take pride in our in-house bottle and mold design and manufacturing capabilities, as well as a creative design and innovation studio. We can help you develop the perfect glass packaging solution for your product, from concept to final commercialization. Decoration: We offer integrated decoration services in all types of glass bottles/jars, including printing (ceramic, organic, and pad in one or multiple colors), coating (lacquering), hot-foil stamping, rinsing (frosting), decal, fitment/gluing, and external metallization. Sustainability: We are committed to sustainability and have implemented several initiatives to reduce our environmental impact. These include using recycled glass, energy-efficient manufacturing processes, and water conservation measures. We are proud to be a leading provider of specialty glass packaging solutions in over 50 countries globally, with offices and warehousing facilities in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, UK, USA, Brazil, India, UAE, and Sri Lanka. We are focused on strengthening our leadership position while providing our customers with the highest quality premium products and services.

INTRO_KR: About us PĒLION Natural Luxury was born in the heart of Pelion (GR), where nature remains pure and untouched. It is a Greek natural cosmetics company that aims to fuse the purity of nature with the proven power of science in every product. The founder of the company, Panagiotis Iliopoulos, grew up in Athens (GR) and lived for many years in Pelion. He is the visionary and driving force behind the brand. In collaboration with the University of Thessaly and leading Greek chemists, he created the brand’s core innovation: a face cream in which water was replaced by 100% organic goat milk. This breakthrough inspired the launch of the brand’s bestselling line, PĒLION G.O.A.T. Greatest of All Time*. Since the very beginning, each of our formulas has remained true to our mission: to offer daily care that respects the skin, the environment, and our Greek heritage. Our vision is to become the most trusted ambassador of Greek nature in the world of modern skincare to highlight the value of clean, effective, and ethical cosmetics, creating products that care for people, honor our homeland, and never compromise on quality. Our Core Values: Naturalness : Use of natural and organic raw materials Scientific Integrity : Evidence-based formulas with real efficacy Greek Production : Sourcing from Greek producers using local ingredients Aesthetic Purity : Minimal design, luxurious experience Ethics & Sustainability : Cruelty-free, vegan-friendly options, recyclable packaging However, PĒLION is more than a natural cosmetics brand, it is a way of life, one that is committed to giving back to society. This commitment led to the creation of our Corporate Social Responsibility program, Pelion for You, a platform for meaningful actions and initiatives that aim to support: The local community of Pelion Vulnerable social groups Public awareness on green resource use Education and engagement of younger generations on environmental protection Because true care starts from within and radiates outward.

Sothys owns plantations where plants used in product formulations are grown to maintain skin's youth and beauty. The company has its own laboratory where unique formulas are developed, as well as branded salons worldwide, highlighting its high level of recognition. Wherteimar (Switzerland) : A professional cosmetics brand based on the use of thermal water from Swiss glaciers. Wherteimar cosmetics help to intensively moisturize the skin, fill it with energy, and slow down aging processes. The products are free from aggressive components, making them suitable even for sensitive skin. The brand's range includes various care lines that meet the needs of different skin types. Inspira Cosmetics (Germany) : A German professional cosmetics brand focused on individual care. Inspira Cosmetics products are based on exclusive developments from their own laboratory and the use of natural components in a bioavailable form. The brand's lines are suitable for both professional and home use, providing quality skincare and meeting diverse needs. Progress Beauty Training Center is an educational platform that combines the best practices and technologies of world leaders in the beauty industry. Our goal is to help beauty industry professionals improve their qualifications and develop the skills necessary to achieve the best results in aesthetics. We pay special attention to practical classes, allowing course participants to master the necessary techniques and be confident in their application in practice. Individual approach : We understand that each client has unique needs. That's why our training center focuses on developing personalized service skills, helping masters offer individual solutions for each client. Economic benefit : Understanding the business advantages of working with premium brands is an important component of training. We help our students understand how professional care can become an important part of a successful business. International level : Our training program meets international standards, and upon completion, participants receive internationally recognized certificates, opening up new opportunities in the professional sphere. Masters who have completed the training possess anti-aging body and facial massage skills that show impressive results after the very first procedure. Why do clients choose Progress Beauty? Wide range of products : We offer comprehensive solutions for skin and hair care, including premium and specialized products suitable for any client's needs. Flexible discount system : We value cooperation and are always ready to offer favorable conditions for regular partners, including flexible discounts and special offers. Professional team : Our employees are not only managers and sales specialists but also practicing aestheticians who understand perfectly what beauty industry professionals need. Timely deliveries : We guarantee established and timely product deliveries, allowing our clients to work without interruptions and provide high-quality service. Personal manager : We provide each client with a personal manager who ensures full support at all stages of cooperation. Sothys products are developed taking into account the skin's needs for deep hydration, nourishment, and protection, providing not only visible but also long-lasting results. Inspira Cosmetics (Germany) - high-quality cosmetics developed using exclusive formulas created based on natural components. A wide range of products allows for selecting individual care that perfectly suits each client's specific needs. Be assured that by working with us, you will receive the highest quality products, professional support, and the opportunity to become part of the global beauty industry at the highest level.

INTRO_KR: About us SAPONIFICIO ZENI DAL 1938 We have been making soap since 1938. Company was founded by Giuseppe Zeni, followed by his children and grandchildren, and we began as true artisans, performing the saponification process of raw materials in a boiler. In 1985, his son Diamante, to keep pace with market changes and the modern needs of customers, now oriented towards the use of vegetable pasta, decided to switch to purchasing and processing the basic shavings and to introduce new machinery to realize this project. Today, we are equipped with two production lines, several packaging machines, and, for some products, we still perform manual packaging as in the past. The passion and enthusiasm we put into our work are reflected in the quality of our products, because every stage of the process is followed with attention and care. Today, the company is led by Federica and her staff with the same passion as always. Thanks to the contribution and experience of three generations, we are able to offer a wide range of constantly evolving products with multiple customization options for both the soap and packaging. Each line, each formula is the result of technical expertise honed over time. We know every production phase in-depth, with the precision of a craftsman and the strength of an industry looking to the future. Our triple-milled refining process enhances each formula, resulting in firmer, smoother, and longer-lasting soaps. The result is an optimal consistency and superior perceived quality. We handle large volumes without compromising quality, meeting every deadline thanks to an advanced and continuously optimized production process. For almost a century, we have interpreted Made in Italy with industrial expertise and artisanal care. Each soap is made in our factories in Italy, guaranteeing traceable quality, a short supply chain,and recognized authenticity over time.

INTRO_KR: About us Incense for the Soul Sarathi Group is a manufacturer and exporter of premier quality incense sticks, cones, burners, and fragrance oils from India. All the Agarbatti brands launched by the group have become synonymous with class and perfection. This reputation is earned through decades of hard work and the Sarathi Group’s dedication to business ethics. We at Sarathi Group are the forerunners in the manufacturing and wholesale suppliers of premier-quality incense sticks from India , since 1945. Driven by the aspirations of our consumers from all over the world, All the Agarbatti brands that we have launched resonate with sheer perfection and class. The global recognition that Sarathi Group celebrates is an outcome of the unwavering commitment to hard work and adherence to our disciplinary conventions. There is a deep history involved in the use of agarbatti for cultural rituals. Before beginning the venerable practices, as a means of creating right conditions and to purify the air, incenses are used. This is an excellent way of conditioning the individual to associate the smell within for being time to offer worship. Sarathi products creates a pleasant environment with a splendid aroma during diverse and multi functional activities including meditation, yoga, pujas, prayers and other occasions of worship. We focus on creating magnificent fragrances by assuring highest quality standards. We manufacture wide range of agarbatti products capturing the fascinating range of fragrances. In focus of saturating the the consciousness of humankind towards devotion, we produce mesmerizing breeze through our agarbatti products to carry a pleasant aroma from flowers and other natural ingredients. BEST QUALITY INCENSE At Sarathi, quality is not just something that we strive towards; it is a work philosophy that is so deeply ingrained in us that it has become an integral part of our tradition. Quality is our first priority at every stage of the production process because we understand that the final product can be of excellent quality only if satisfactory checks have taken place at each and every stage of incense manufacturing and wholesale . Our expert team of professionals works tirelessly to ensure quality at every stage, from sourcing the raw material to documentation and shipping of our products . Our aim is also to preserve the originality and authenticity of each and every piece of incense. Indian culture and heritage are part of this authenticity, which can be shared with the world only if we preserve purity. They evoke emotions and memories of a rich and beautiful culture. It is with pride that we are able to share this culture with the world in the form of unique fragrances that each tell a story and share a memory.

INTRO_KR: About us Sarvari Paris was born from the journey of Omar Sarvari, a man whose life was shaped by the five sacred elements: Spirit, Fire, Air, Water, and Earth. Born in the golden triangle of trade between Afghanistan, Dubai, and Saudi Arabia, Omar’s early years were peaceful, filled with the vibrant scents of spices and the warmth of family. However, when war broke out in Afghanistan, his family was forced to flee, leaving behind their home and everything they knew. In the midst of uncertainty, they found solace in the simplest of things, a shared bottle of perfume that became a symbol of their unbreakable bond, a reminder of love and resilience even in the darkest of times. Years later, after settling in the Netherlands, Omar became a successful businessman. Yet, his heart remained tied to the rich heritage of his homeland. Inspired by his past, he dreamed of bringing the exotic spices and elements of Afghanistan to a place where beauty, art, and culture converge, Paris, the City of Lights.

INTRO_KR: About us Mission: Picardy is dedicated to providing a one-stop solution, providing exceptional skincare and personal care products that nourish, enhance, and preserve individuals' health, beauty, and overall well-being worldwide. Vision: Picardy aims to export skincare and personal care products to become a globally recognized leader in the industry, known for our innovative products, unwavering commitment to quality, and dedication to customer satisfaction. We aim to empower individuals to feel confident, radiant, and empowered in their own skin, while fostering sustainable practices and promoting a positive impact on the environment and society. Our Story Picardy has been dedicated to transforming the beauty and self-care industry. With a global vision, we set out to provide an extensive range of skincare and personal care products in Pakistan and worldwide. Our catalog serves as a testament to our commitment to excellence, showcasing a diverse collection of luxurious and effective formulas that cater to the unique needs of individuals. Each product is carefully crafted using premium ingredients and advanced scientific research, from beauty creams and lotions to soaps and sunblocks. Our mission extends beyond beauty, as we prioritize sustainability and ethical practices, forging partnerships with local communities and implementing eco-friendly packaging solutions. Embracing our legacy of over three decades, we continue to empower individuals to embrace their natural beauty and experience the transformative power of self-care, positively impacting lives across borders. Our Values: Picardy promises to provide G.L.O.W to the customers by keeping the following brand values: Genuine: We, as Picardy, are committed to being authentic and transparent in everything we do. We believe in genuine interactions, honest communication, and providing promising products to customers. Luxury: As Picardy, we strive to create a luxurious experience for our customers. From carefully selected ingredients to elegant packaging, we aim to provide a sense of indulgence and pampering that enhances their self-care routines. Optimal: We strive for optimal skincare and personal care product results. Picardy is committed to formulating products that deliver effective and noticeable outcomes, ensuring our customers can achieve their desired skincare goals and experience the best possible results. Wellness: Picardy values the holistic well-being of our customers. Skincare and personal care should contribute to overall wellness. Our products are designed to nourish, rejuvenate, and enhance self-care’s physical and emotional aspects. Embodying these G.L.O.W. brand values, we aim to create a trusted and beloved brand that promotes genuine, luxurious, organic and wellness-oriented personal care products.

INTRO_KR: About us Sostar S.A. is a cosmetic producer, located in Greece. The office and industrial facilities of the company spread within an area of 2.000sqrm. All of our facilities follow the strict European Regulations. We produce a wide range of high quality products for face care, body care hair care etc. Our products are enriched with natural extracts and essences, which makes them skin friendly while following the latest beauty trends. We produce products under our own brand, or Private Labeling. High quality and Safety is really important for us. We want to be sure that our products will fully satisfy you and are safe for your skin. And we need proofs. - We are proud that National Organization for Medicines has provided us with a GMP certificate that ensures the best quality, not only for the manufacturing process, but also for the final product as well. - All the products are tested by European external laboratories that checks and validates every single batch production before dispatching in order to ensure the best quality. - We are certified by British Lloyd’s Register LRQA with ISO 22716 for the production and packing, and storage procedure. Innovation Our company, developed an unique and innovative range of cosmetics enriched with organic donkey milk. Donkey milk, an ingredient well known since 5,000 BC, was used in ancient Greece by Hippocrates for wound healing and skin regeneration. In Egyptian antiquity, donkey milk was used for both alimentary and cosmetic purposes; it was broadly used for both internal and external inflammation, as well as an nutritious drink for children and infants. In Ancient Rome, it was used as a drink for the aristocracy. Women, fully aware of its beauty enhancing properties, used it in order to retain youth. It is said that Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt , took baths in donkey milk to preserve the beauty and youth of her skin. Our suppliers are organic certified local farms that carry out microbiological and physicochemical controls on each batch in order to ensure the excellent quality of the milk. Recently we launched 3 new products with great skin effects and high sales. Those are 3 Boosters which have high concentration in active ingredients such as Retinol, Peptides and Vitamin C. You can see the attachment for further details. They are easily absorbed by all skin types and have visible results, making them top sales products. The quality standards and Product Sterilization during the packaging process, make for top quality products.

INTRO_KR: About us Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio combines science, nature, and authentic beauty in the art of perfumery. Founded in Florence in 1989 by Dr. Giovanni Di Massimo , the maison brings together pharmacological expertise, Renaissance heritage, and artisanal craftsmanship to create fragrances that embody memory, history, and timeless elegance. Each perfume is conceived not just as a scent, but as an olfactory journey capable of awakening emotions, recalling places, and telling stories. The origins of Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio can be traced back to the 1960s , in the small Alpine village of Corvara. There, a young pharmacist named Giovanni Di Massimo began his professional journey in a modest pharmacy that soon became a point of reference for locals and tourists alike. From the beginning, Giovanni was fascinated not only by the healing power of plants but also by their evocative aromas. This dual curiosity for the therapeutic and the sensorial planted the seeds of a philosophy that would later shape his work as a perfumer. In the 1980s , Giovanni returned to Florence, a city that had shaped the history of perfumery since the Renaissance. Florence was not only the cradle of painting, sculpture, and architecture, but also the birthplace of modern perfume-making. The Florentine court of Catherine de’ Medici had carried its knowledge of essences and distillation to France, laying the foundations of European haute parfumerie. Apothecaries and alchemists of the time, known as muschieri, created blends for courts and churches, merging art with science. Manuscripts such as Caterina Sforza de’ Medici’s Experimenti and Giovanventura Rosetti’s Notandissimi Secreti de l’arte Profumatoria preserved recipes, techniques, and the symbolic role of fragrance in Renaissance life: a language of power, devotion, and beauty. Giovanni immersed himself in this tradition, studying these rare texts and reviving an ancient practice with modern eyes. These discoveries connected him directly to the origins of perfumery and provided the intellectual and cultural framework for his own creations. In 1989 , Giovanni founded Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio . A year later, in a 300-year-old Florentine workshop next to Palazzo Vecchio, he opened a laboratory and boutique. From the start, the brand was distinct: perfumes were created in-house, guided by research, artistry, and authenticity. The first fragrance, Caterina de’ Medici, was a tribute to the woman who symbolized Florence’s role as cradle of European perfumery. This fragrance was more than a dedication; it was a declaration of intent: to anchor the maison’s work in history while speaking to the present. It marked the beginning of a catalogue of fragrances rooted in memory, history, and natural raw materials . Over the years, Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio has built a reputation for its in-house perfumery approach : every creation is imagined, formulated, and produced entirely within the maison. Nothing is outsourced; every stage is part of the same artisanal cycle. The olfactory portfolio is grouped under I Profumi di Firenze – Dottor Di Massimo , a registered trademark since 2013. These collections, Collezione Antica Vintage and Collezione Rinascimento , feature Eau de Parfum and Eau de Toilette, each blending flowers, woods, spices, resins, and fruits with the precision of a pharmacist and the intuition of an artist. Thirty years of partnerships with trusted suppliers guarantee the highest quality of essences— vanilla from Madagascar, pepper from Kerala, sandalwood from Malaysia —carefully chosen for their purity, richness, and complexity. The inspiration behind the fragrances is guided by pillars that define the maison’s identity . At the heart of Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio lies a vision of perfumery where nature, history, memory, and art intertwine . Fragrances are born from the authenticity of natural elements, translated into compositions that capture the vitality of landscapes and the intimacy of emotions. The heritage of the Florentine Renaissance provides a cultural framework, where art and science merge into a refined language of beauty. Tuscany and its capital offer endless inspiration, with their gardens, vineyards, and atmosphere, while memory transforms every perfume into a living archive of experiences and identity . Music and artistic collaborations further expand this universe, turning sounds, colors, and ideas into olfactory form. Together, these inspirations create perfumes that are not mere accessories, but cultural expressions : a way to connect with oneself, with history, and with the universal language of emotion. Florence itself is an essential character in the maison’s philosophy. It is the city of contrasts and harmony, where the Renaissance spirit is still alive. Walking through its streets means encountering the scent of lilies, vineyards, wet stone after rain, leather from artisan workshops, and incense rising in churches. This multisensory atmosphere is embedded in every creation. Just as Florentine masters once pursued perfection through harmony of proportions, Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio seeks to create fragrances that balance natural authenticity with emotional resonance . Perfume here becomes a language of emotions, capable of preserving memories, evoking places, and narrating personal stories. It is also a craft: formulas are not abstract concepts, but carefully measured compositions, where every raw material is weighed, macerated, and blended by hand with artisanal care. This commitment to artigianato is what makes the maison’s fragrances unique: they are born from knowledge, patience, and the human touch. Today, his daughter Francesca continues this path, enriching it with new perspectives while preserving the artisanal rigor that defines the brand. This generational dialogue is at the core of the maison’s philosophy: the father’s scientific knowledge, discipline, and devotion to tradition meet the daughter’s creativity, innovation, and cultural openness. Francesca, with her background in phytotherapy and training in Parisian perfumery schools, has brought the maison into dialogue with contemporary art and international culture, expanding its resonance beyond Italy. In perfumery, this continuity means formulas conceived and produced entirely in-house, crafted with carefully selected natural raw materials and balanced compositions that unfold with elegance over time. True luxury, for Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio, lies not in excess but in authenticity, heritage, and the family bond that transforms artisanal perfumery into a timeless act of care. It is a brand where Florence’s Renaissance past meets the creative present , where the intimacy of family transmission becomes the guarantee of integrity, and where every fragrance is a story: born from Florence, carried through memory, destined for the world.

Francesca, with her background in phytotherapy and training in Parisian perfumery schools, has brought the maison into dialogue with contemporary art and international culture, expanding its resonance beyond Italy. In perfumery, this continuity means formulas conceived and produced entirely in-house, crafted with carefully selected natural raw materials and balanced compositions that unfold with elegance over time. True luxury, for Spezierie Palazzo Vecchio, lies not in excess but in authenticity, heritage, and the family bond that transforms artisanal perfumery into a timeless act of care. It is a brand where Florence’s Renaissance past meets the creative present , where the intimacy of family transmission becomes the guarantee of integrity, and where every fragrance is a story: born from Florence, carried through memory, destined for the world.

INTRO_KR: About us * Company Overview Sugentech , a KOSDAQ-listed Korean manufacturer of IVD medical devices, has built a strong portfolio in lab tests, POCT, home tests, and Femtech healthcare. Each serum is scientifically formulated to support skin balance across the four hormonal phases — menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, and luteal — promoting healthier, more radiant skin every day. Moreover, we have expanded our Femtech-based wellness portfolio with a health supplement line including Glutathione, 'Liposome Glutathione Signature 9S' and Multivitamin, ' SUREVITA' designed to enhance beauty and health from within. * Product Line - Cycling Beauty Serum (4-Step) : Tailored serums designed for each hormonal phase. 1. Week 01 (Sensitive Phase - Hyal Vita-C) When the skin is driest and most fragile, hydration is key. Enriched with sea buckthorn extract and hyaluronic acid, this serum delivers deep and clear moisture. 2. Week 02 (Golden Phase - PRDN Peptide) During the skin’s regeneration peak, focus on glow and firmness . Formulated with rose water, peptides, ceramides, collagen, and PDRN for resilient, luminous skin. 3. Week 03 (Imbalance Phase - Coenzyme Zinc) When oil-water balance breaks down, calm and protect the skin. Infused with coconut water, Zinc PCA, CoQ10, and niacinamide to control sebum and prevent breakouts. (Clinically proven pore improvement: 33.85% area / 16.96% depth / 26.28% visible pores) 4. Week 04 (Breakout Phase - Centella Tea Tree) At its most sensitive stage, the skin needs soothing care . Combines Centella leaf water, tea tree extract, and madecassoside to restore calm and balance. (Clinically proven to reduce redness by 70.54% after irritation) - SUREVITA : A high-potency multivitamin formula designed to boost immunity, featuring the market’s highest doses of B vitamins (B1, B2, B6, B12, and Biotin). Presented as a 30mL ampoule with 2 tablets, it delivers up to 5,020% of the recommended daily allowance for maximum vitality. - Liposome Glutathione Signature 9S : A premium glutathione formula (90% purity) enhanced with liposomal technology for superior body absorption. Offers comparable quality at nearly 70% lower cost than similar products on the market.

INTRO_KR: Über uns 2014 was a momentous year for Szabolcs Szerencsés as it marked the beginning of his enchantment with the mesmerizing world of Turkish perfumed oils. Though this passion has remained a pivotal part of his life, his name had already gained recognition in the domestic and European fashion realm long before that. For five years, Szabolcs was a trailblazer in the men's fashion industry, achieving extraordinary success with his brand, "SERAPH." Through his website, he sold over 500,000 men's apparel items across seven countries, solidifying his position as a leading player among Hungarian online stores catering to men's clothing. In 2017, he embarked on a two-year journey to Turkey, where he not only immersed himself in the realm of Turkish scents but also forged connections with perfume manufacturers in Paris, London, Dubai, and Egypt. Leveraging his expertise in the perfume industry, he established his own production line and founded his brand, "SUPERZ. Perfume," in 2021. Following meticulous testing and screening that spanned several months, SUPERZ. Budapest perfumed oils were born, becoming the pillars of their product lineup. Szabolcs's primary objective is to create a product crafted from the purest and highest-quality carrier materials derived from organic sources, adhering to European standards. This ensures that customers can indulge in wearing scents that are not only of top-notch quality but also unique and exceptionally long-lasting. The yearning for unparalleled excellence bore fruit in the form of pure perfume oils, with some of the Extrait de Parfum collections proudly bearing the NATURIX® seal, guaranteeing the reliability of their product composition and manufacturing process for customers. The founder's offerings consist of 100% perfume oils, carefully curated and made from organic ingredients. The sillages are exceptionally intense, as no alcohol or other liquids are blended with the oils. Their 50ml Extrait De Parfum product boasts one of the highest concentrations of perfume oil, meeting stringent European Union standards. Some scents are the result of meticulously balanced combinations of over 69 ingredients, each subjected to individual testing for several months before being embraced under the banner of the SUPERZ brand and made available for sale. With over a hundred ingredients sourced diligently from five continents and more than 35 countries, every Superz. Budapest product is composed of 100% pure perfume oils. All scent components originate from organic and certified sources, ranging from the Madagascan Ylang Ylang to Sri Lankan cinnamon and the agarwood extracted from the tropical forests of Thailand. The master perfumer boasts an illustrious 50-year career in perfume-making and cultivates the primary ingredients for his creations on his own land, including the renowned Isparta Turkish rose oil. The direct sourcing from producers and the scent molecules invented at their perfume academy make replication of their fragrances an insurmountable task. The masterpieces are the result of the combined expertise and craftsmanship of over 20 perfumers and chemical engineers, guaranteeing the unmatched quality and artistry behind each scent. Superz. Budapest currently stands as Hungary's most beloved perfume brand, having earned this esteemed title not solely based on the quality of their products, but also due to their unwavering commitment to user experience and excellence in all aspects.

Born from precious beginnings and built on achievements aplenty, our chapters are drawn from the drama and grandeur of the East and inspired by the power and dynamism of the West.

INTRO_KR: About us Viage Fragrances: A Global Olfactory Journey . Viage Fragrances is a niche perfume house from Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The oriental character is characterized by warm, sensual notes, vanilla musk spices, and amber. The brand's commitment to quality and selection of ingredients and the artistry, involved in crafting each fragrance. Viage Fragrances offers a unique experience for fragrance lovers, with exquisite blends, luxurious aromas, and cultural inspiration, Viage Fragrances invites you to embark on a sensory journey around the world. Whether you're a seasoned fragrance collector or simply seeking a new olfactory experience, Viage Fragrances are sure to captivate your senses and transport you to new distant lands. Viage Fragrances Essence of Adventure.

INTRO_KR: About us TIRELLI was established in 1957 as a modest company specialising in electrical installations. In the 1980s, following the successful production of its first labelling machine, the company broadened its technology portfolio by manufacturing filling and capping machines , catering to the comprehensive packaging needs of the cosmetics, home & personal care and chemical industries . Today, TIRELLI’s advanced technologies are available as both standalone units and complete packaging lines. TIRELLI has installed over 5,580 machines in 118 different countries worldwide. Following the acquisition of KTF Engineering in 2021, TIRELLI expanded its product portfolio to include high-speed weighing machines, blowing/rinsing machines and equipment designed for handling home care products with corrosive and/or abrasive properties. In 2023, the acquisition of the BRB Globus Srl business unit further strengthened TIRELLI’s offerings, enabling the company to better meet the increasing demand for labelling machines tailored to medium- and low-speed production lines in the home & body care sector.

INTRO_KR: About us TREEANNSEA focuses on the survival energy of plants and microorganisms that thrive in extreme environments such as deserts, the Arctic, Madagascar, and the sea. These organisms endure harsh conditions—strong UV rays, high salinity, extreme cold, and dryness—by naturally producing highly concentrated protective compounds such as polyphenols, saponins, minerals, and amino acids. By delivering these extreme survival mechanisms to the skin, TREEANNSEA develops skincare that protects, soothes, and restores the skin exposed to external irritation and stress. This philosophy is based on the scientific concept that the life force born in harsh nature enhances the skin’s natural resilience. The brand collaborates with premium partners such as Banyan Tree, Hyatt, Sheraton, Shilla Stay, Lotte Hotels, BMW, Maserati, Asiana Airlines, and T’way Mall, and continues to share its philosophy of “Extreme Nature Skincare” on global stages, including Cosmoprof Bologna, Miami, Hong Kong, and Dubai 2025.

INTRO_KR: About us Founded in 2011, TREELISS is a brand that combines innovation, science, and nature to develop high-performance hair care cosmetics designed to transform the routine of beauty professionals. Treeliss understands that every hair type has its own needs, which is why we offer a complete line of hair treatments developed with the latest in technology and natural ingredients. Our products are formulated not only to protect but also to revitalize hair from the very first use, delivering visible results in health, shine, and strength. Our commitment goes beyond aesthetics: we believe that hair health is essential for beautiful hair. That's why we create solutions that deeply treat hair, respecting the structure of the strands and the well-being of the scalp. Each product is designed to ensure the satisfaction of those seeking professional results, with the care and gentleness that hair deserves. With a continuously expanding portfolio, Treeliss has established itself as a trusted brand, present in Brazil and the international market. We are constantly investing in research and development to offer the best in innovation, from hair straightening to specialized hair treatments. Our recently launched hair perfumes are yet another example of how we seek new ways to surprise and delight our customers. We invite you to explore our products and discover how Treeliss can transform hair and elevate the level of your hair care routine. German: Gegründet im Jahr 2011, ist TREELISS eine Marke, die Innovation, Wissenschaft und Natur kombiniert, um leistungsstarke Haarpflegekosmetik zu entwickeln, die darauf abzielt, die Routine von Schönheitsprofis zu revolutionieren. Treeliss versteht, dass jedes Haar unterschiedliche Bedürfnisse hat. Deshalb bieten wir eine vollständige Palette an Haarbehandlungen an, die mit modernster Technologie und natürlichen Inhaltsstoffen entwickelt wurden. Unsere Produkte sind so formuliert, dass sie das Haar nicht nur schützen, sondern es ab der ersten Anwendung revitalisieren und sichtbare Ergebnisse in Bezug auf Gesundheit, Glanz und Stärke liefern. Unser Engagement geht über die Ästhetik hinaus: Wir sind überzeugt, dass die Gesundheit der Haare für ihre Schönheit von entscheidender Bedeutung ist. Deshalb entwickeln wir Lösungen, die das Haar tiefenwirksam pflegen, die Struktur der Haare respektieren und das Wohlbefinden der Kopfhaut fördern. Jedes Produkt ist darauf ausgelegt, die Zufriedenheit derjenigen zu gewährleisten, die professionelle Ergebnisse suchen, dabei aber die sanfte Pflege, die das Haar verdient, nicht außer Acht lassen. Mit einem ständig wachsenden Portfolio hat sich Treeliss als vertrauenswürdige Marke etabliert, die sowohl in Brasilien als auch auf dem internationalen Markt präsent ist. Wir investieren kontinuierlich in Forschung und Entwicklung, um das Beste an Innovationen anzubieten, von Haar-Glättungen bis hin zu spezialisierten Haarbehandlungen. Unser kürzlich eingeführtes Haarparfum ist ein weiteres Beispiel dafür, wie wir immer wieder neue Wege finden, unsere Kunden zu überraschen und zu begeistern. Wir laden Sie ein, unsere Produkte kennenzulernen und zu entdecken, wie Treeliss Ihr Haar verwandeln und Ihre Haarpflegeroutine auf das nächste Level bringen kann.

INTRO_KR: About us Ultra Standard Distributors over 40 years of experience as the industry leader in the distribution of multicultural hair and beauty care products. Vision & Direction To go beyond the technology — and become a global brand centered on emotion and philosophy. Expanding into the Middle East, Europe, and North America, UNNOT aims to establish itself as a high-end line bridging emotional color cosmetics and functional skincare.

INTRO_KR: About us About Us – VACO Retail VACO Retail is a recognized leader in the Polish market and one of the most dynamically developing companies in Central and Eastern Europe in the field of repellents, insecticides, and household chemical solutions. With many years of proven expertise, a modern production infrastructure, and a strong orientation towards sustainable growth, VACO Retail has established itself as a reliable partner for international distributors, retailers, and business clients. Market leadership and expertise Our position as the leading producer and provider of repellents and insecticides in Poland is the result of consistent investment in quality, innovation, and regulatory compliance. VACO Retail combines an in-depth understanding of consumer needs with advanced research and product development. Our portfolio reflects the expectations of demanding markets where both efficiency and safety are key. By building long-term partnerships, we have become a brand trusted not only by individual consumers but also by business clients who value reliability, flexibility, and compliance with international standards. Regulatory compliance and product safety Operating in the highly regulated European Union environment, we ensure that every product meets stringent EU requirements regarding safety, environmental impact, and labeling. All formulations are developed in accordance with REACH and biocidal product regulations, and our production facilities are audited and certified to maintain the highest standards of quality. This commitment to compliance not only safeguards our clients and end-users but also guarantees smooth entry into even the most demanding markets. Wide portfolio tailored to customer needs VACO Retail offers a comprehensive portfolio covering: Repellents : sprays, lotions, and other solutions designed for effective protection against mosquitoes, ticks, midges, and other insects, including ranges developed for children and sensitive users. Insecticides : advanced formulations for the control of flying and crawling insects, designed to ensure safety, effectiveness, and ease of use both indoors and outdoors. Household chemicals : powders, liquids, and cleaning agents that meet the highest consumer expectations for performance and safety. Eco-friendly line : a growing part of our portfolio is dedicated to environmentally responsible solutions. These products use carefully selected active ingredients and packaging to reduce environmental impact while maintaining high levels of efficiency. Our modular product offer is designed to allow retailers, distributors, and private-label clients to select the right mix for their markets. We provide both branded VACO products and tailor-made solutions developed in cooperation with our business partners. Modern production capabilities As a producer, we operate a modern and effective production line equipped with state-of-the-art technology. This infrastructure enables us to guarantee consistent product quality, flexibility in order volumes, and the ability to respond quickly to individual requirements. Our facilities allow for the adaptation of formulations, packaging, and labeling according to specific market regulations and consumer expectations. This production agility makes VACO Retail not only a manufacturer but also a solution provider capable of delivering competitive advantages to our clients. Innovation and continuous improvement Experience has given us stability, but innovation drives our growth. We are constantly investing in R&D to develop new formulations, improve safety, and reduce environmental impact. Our development team cooperates with leading research institutes and raw material suppliers, ensuring that VACO Retail is always at the forefront of product and market trends. Whether it is the expansion of eco-friendly lines, the application of new packaging technologies, or the integration of digital tools to support sales, we treat innovation as a permanent element of our corporate DNA. Global outlook, local reliability Although VACO Retail is deeply rooted in the Polish market, our ambitions are global. We already export to a wide range of countries and are expanding our presence in new regions, including the Middle East, where demand for safe, reliable, and high-quality repellents and insecticides continues to grow. Our participation in Beautyworld Dubai is a natural step in strengthening our international presence. At the same time, we remain attentive to the specific needs of each market. We know that cultural differences, climatic conditions, and consumer habits vary significantly between regions. Therefore, we approach each project individually, offering tailored solutions that combine our global expertise with local relevance. Commitment to sustainability As a forward-looking company, we recognize that business growth must be combined with responsibility. Sustainability is not a slogan but a guiding principle. Our eco-friendly portfolio is only one element of our broader strategy to minimize environmental impact across the entire value chain. From responsible sourcing of raw materials to optimized packaging and logistics, we continuously seek ways to reduce our ecological footprint. By doing so, we help our clients respond to the growing consumer demand for green and ethical products. Partnership-driven approach For VACO Retail, every distributor, retailer, and business partner is more than a client. We build long-term partnerships based on trust, transparency, and shared objectives. We understand that our success depends on the success of our partners. That is why we offer not only high-quality products but also comprehensive support, including: market entry strategies regulatory expertise marketing and branding assistance customized production and private-label options This holistic approach ensures that our partners can focus on their markets while we deliver reliable and compliant solutions. Why choose VACO Retail Market leader in repellents and insecticides in Poland Decades of expertise combined with innovation Compliance with all EU regulations Extensive and diverse portfolio, including eco-friendly lines Modern production facilities with flexibility for customization Global reach with local adaptation Partnership model focused on long-term growth Our mission and vision Our mission is clear: to provide effective, safe, and sustainable solutions that protect people, households, and communities from insects and pests while respecting the environment. Our vision is to be the preferred global partner for repellents and insecticides, recognized for innovation, responsibility, and reliability. In summary : VACO Retail stands at the intersection of tradition and innovation, experience and flexibility, responsibility and growth. We are proud to be the market leader in Poland and ready to bring our solutions to global partners. For distributors and retailers looking for a producer that combines EU-level compliance, production excellence, and an eco-conscious mindset, VACO Retail offers a partnership that delivers long-term value.

INTRO_KR: About us The Bottica brand was born out of a passion for wine and the earth. When composing our cosmetics, we spend a lot of time carefully selecting ingredients to create active and unique formulas with proven effectiveness. In the manufacturing process, we use only natural and vegan raw materials, which we source from our grapevines and from reliable suppliers. We believe that in this manner, a drop of our cosmetics gives a sense of being close to nature, and is an invitation to enjoy the best of life. In our innovative laboratory, we combine state-of-the-art technology with expert knowledge of the cultivation and use of the grapevine. We have searched for a long time for the most effective method to extract the most valuable ingredients from the fruit that could be added to our cosmetics. We are committed to obtaining the best possible results, so we cooperate with qualified institutions from the cosmetic, chemical and medical sectors. All our dermatological studies are based on tests on a selected group of testers under the supervision of a dermatologist, during which the testers use the cosmetic for a specified length of time and complete properly designed questionnaires that allow us to check whether the product's performance is adequate. INTRO_KR: About us XATION CO., LTD. – Redefining K-Beauty Through Science and Scent Founded in Seoul, Xation Co., Ltd. is a leading Korean beauty company that merges advanced biotechnology, dermatological expertise, and aesthetic design to deliver innovative personal care brands loved across Asia and beyond. With over a decade of experience in the beauty and healthcare industry, Xation has grown into a trusted manufacturer and brand house whose philosophy centers on efficacy, safety, and sensorial experience. At Xation, we believe that true beauty lies in the balance between clinical performance and emotional satisfaction . Innovation & Research Xation operates an integrated R&D and production system that upholds international standards such as ISO 22716 (Cosmetic GMP) and EWG Green Grade Ingredient Safety . Our laboratories focus on the synergy between active ingredients and sensorial delivery—developing water-in-oil capsule technology, multi-functional emulsions, and microbiome-friendly formulations. The company continuously invests in clinical validation to ensure product credibility. From scalp health studies to long-term hydration testing, Xation’s commitment to measurable results has built a foundation of trust among dermatologists, distributors, and consumers alike. Global Presence Xation’s brands are now distributed in over 15 countries , including Korea, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and the United Arab Emirates , with growing expansion into Europe, GCC, and Latin America . The company collaborates closely with local retail leaders and digital commerce platforms to tailor brand messaging and product lines to each market’s culture and climate. Through strategic partnerships with regional distributors, Xation maintains a balance between global identity and local adaptation —ensuring that each consumer, no matter where they live, experiences the essence of Korean innovation. Brand Portfolio GRAFEN – Professional Hair & Scalp Care for All Grafen, Xation’s flagship brand, began with a simple vision: to make professional salon-level haircare accessible to everyone. Today, Grafen is recognized as one of Korea’s most reputable haircare and styling brands, available at all 1,300 Olive Young stores nationwide and awarded by Watsons Singapore for product excellence. Grafen offers a wide spectrum of products—from hair tonics and scalp shampoos to styling waxes and body care—crafted through meticulous clinical testing and data-backed formulation. Every Grafen product combines functional innovation with sensorial appeal, ensuring users can enjoy both visible results and a refreshing experience. Unlike conventional men’s grooming brands, Grafen positions itself as a gender-neutral, performance-driven brand that celebrates individuality and confidence. Its minimalist design and unisex fragrance palette allow both men and women to enjoy clean, functional, and effective care solutions. Grafen’s continuous global expansion has led to strong partnerships with major retailers such as Guardian Malaysia, Watsons Singapore, and leading online platforms throughout Southeast Asia, Japan, and the Middle East. With proven results and loyal consumer recognition, Grafen stands as a symbol of “Smart Grooming Science”—a blend of technology, care, and timeless confidence. JULYME – Fragrance Meets Beauty Julyme was born from a desire to turn daily routines into sensorial rituals. Each product embodies the harmony between fragrance and function, delivering perfume-inspired hair and body care that lingers throughout the day. Rather than focusing on packaging colors, Julyme highlights its signature scent compositions—a curated palette ranging from crisp citrus to romantic florals and warm musks. The brand’s unique “Scent Layering System” allows users to mix and match products, expressing personal identity through fragrance. Julyme’s popularity has extended far beyond Korea, with remarkable sales performance on Japan’s Q10, Southeast Asian e-commerce platforms, and selective global retail partners. It represents a new wave of “emotional K-beauty”, where fragrance becomes the language of self-expression and confidence. Vision for the Future Xation envisions a global beauty ecosystem that connects science, culture, and sustainability. Our future roadmap includes expanding into derma-cosmetics, fragrance design, and scalp-focused innovation. The company’s moto—“Driven by change, inspired by youth, and dedicated to creating new culture, we aim to go beyond Korea and establish ourselves as a leading global brand house.”—continues to drive every innovation, collaboration, and partnership we pursue. With a growing global community of consumers who trust the performance and integrity of our brands, Xation Co., Ltd. is poised to redefine K-beauty for a new generation that values authenticity, transparency, and sensorial satisfaction.

Now, we are able to produce the products complying with the requirements of GS, CE, CB, IMQ, RoHS, ETL, REACH, EUP, INMETRO, ISO9001, etc. Though our relentless efforts, we believe that we can offer excellent goods to customers.

INTRO_KR: About us Introduction to Zhejiang Yanxi Cosmetics Co., Ltd Zhejiang Yanxi Cosmetics Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer specializing in the production and R&D of cosmetic products for beauty and makeup. The company boasts advanced management concepts, a strong R&D team, and a comprehensive product testing system. The factory environment is elegant, and the company boasts excellent production conditions, standardized workshops, extensive experience in cosmetics manufacturing, advanced production equipment, and strong technical capabilities. It is equipped with a research and development laboratory, physical and chemical testing lab, and microbial culture room.  The company primarily focuses on cosmetics production and aims to become the leading professional makeup brand in both domestic and international markets. We have a team of skilled professionals specializing in the research, development, and production of high-quality makeup products. Our main offerings include lipstick, lip gloss, lip gel, lip balm, eyeliner, mascara, powder, concealer, compact powder, blush, eyeshadow, pressed powder, pressed blush, and over 20 other varieties. Currently, the company operates multiple production lines and utilizes advanced equipment, sourcing materials from renowned global suppliers such as Germany's Kahl and Merck, as well as the U.S.'s Sun Chemical. Our products are sold worldwide, including in Europe, America, Southeast Asia, Russia, China, and other regions. While we primarily focus on domestic sales, our products are highly favored by consumers. The company adheres to a people-oriented philosophy and upholds the shared values of employees and the enterprise, consciously fulfilling its social responsibilities. Committed to advancing the development of the industry, we embrace management innovation and continuous improvement as our guiding principles. With proactive efforts and relentless progress, we warmly welcome more talented individuals to join Yanxi, working together to build a win-win development platform and strive toward the grand goal of becoming a world-class OEM factory for cosmetic products!
